2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on 8 April 2024 at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland, at the age of 94, following a short illness. He had shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics with François Englert for the theoretical prediction of the Higgs mechanism, which was confirmed by the discovery of the Higgs boson at CERN in 2012.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye** won Senegal's most recent presidential election that I know of, held on March 24, 2024. The opposition candidate, backed by Ousmane Sonko and the PASTEF party, won outright in the first round with about 54% of the vote, defeating the ruling coalition's candidate, Amadou Ba.

Faye was sworn in on April 2, 2024, becoming Senegal's youngest president at age 44, and he appointed Sonko as prime minister.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped aside. He announced his resignation as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach on 20 March 2024, citing both personal and political reasons and saying he felt he was no longer the best person for the job.

Simon Harris succeeded him as Fine Gael leader on 24 March 2024 and was elected Taoiseach by the Dáil on 9 April 2024. Varadkar stayed on as a backbench TD but did not contest the November 2024 general election, which ended his time in elected politics.

Following that election, Micheál Martin of Fianna Fáil became Taoiseach in January 2025, with Harris serving as Tánaiste.

Varadkar served two terms as Taoiseach, from 2017 to 2020 and from December 2022 to April 2024.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at age 76, in Las Vegas, Nevada. His family announced that he died of cancer; it had been reported earlier that year that he was being treated for prostate cancer.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
**Simon Harris** succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach. Varadkar announced his resignation in March 2024, and Harris, who replaced him as Fine Gael leader, was elected Taoiseach by the Dáil on 9 April 2024, becoming the youngest person to hold the office.

Harris is no longer Taoiseach, though. After the November 2024 general election, **Micheál Martin** of Fianna Fáil became Taoiseach in January 2025, with Harris serving as Tánaiste (deputy prime minister) in the coalition government.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer prime minister of Haiti. He took office in July 2021, shortly after President Jovenel Moïse was assassinated, and governed without an electoral mandate.

In early March 2024, while he was abroad (he had travelled to Kenya to arrange a multinational security mission), gangs launched coordinated attacks in Port-au-Prince and demanded his ouster. Unable to return, he was stranded in Puerto Rico. Under pressure from CARICOM and the United States, he announced on March 11, 2024 that he would resign once a transitional presidential council was in place.

He formally resigned on April 25, 2024, when the Transitional Presidential Council was sworn in. Finance minister Michel…

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on 5 May 2024, at the age of 79. He was best known for playing King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*, as well as Yosser Hughes in the British TV drama *Boys from the Blackstuff*.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No, Humza Yousaf announced his resignation on 29 April 2024, after the power-sharing agreement between the SNP and the Scottish Greens collapsed, and formally left office on 7 May 2024. John Swinney succeeded him as SNP leader and First Minister, and to my knowledge still holds the post.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini has died. He passed away on May 7, 2024, at age 61, after suffering a heart attack at Electrical Audio, his recording studio in Chicago.

His death came shortly before the release of *To All Trains*, the final album by his band Shellac, which came out later that month. Albini was known for fronting Big Black and Shellac, and for recording landmark albums such as Nirvana's *In Utero*, Pixies' *Surfer Rosa*, and PJ Harvey's *Rid of Me*.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin has died. His death was reported on May 22, 2024; he was 58. According to his family, he slipped and fell in the shower while house-sitting for a friend in Brussels, Belgium. His body was found when the friend returned, so I'm not sure of the exact date of death, but it was in May 2024.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ resigned in late April 2024, when the Communist Party's Central Committee accepted his resignation over violations of Party regulations and his responsibility as a leader. This came amid an anti-corruption investigation that had led to the arrest of his assistant. The National Assembly formally dismissed him on May 2, 2024.

Trần Thanh Mẫn, who had been the standing Vice Chairman, took over as acting leader and was elected Chairman of the National Assembly on May 20, 2024. As far as I know, he still holds the post.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye is the president of Senegal. He won the March 24, 2024 presidential election in the first round with about 54% of the vote, defeating the ruling coalition's candidate, Amadou Ba, and was sworn in on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

A few notable details:

- **Youngest president:** At 44, he became the youngest president in Senegal's history.
- **Party:** He was the candidate backed by PASTEF (African Patriots of Senegal for Work, Ethics and Fraternity), standing in for party leader Ousmane Sonko, who had been barred from running.
- **Dramatic rise:** Faye was released from prison only about ten days before the election, following an amnesty law.
- **Prime minister…

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton has died. He passed away on May 27, 2024, at age 71, after a prolonged battle with cancer (reported as colon cancer). The NBA announced his death that day.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova** became the first female president of North Macedonia. A law professor backed by the VMRO-DPMNE party, she won the presidential runoff in May 2024, defeating incumbent Stevo Pendarovski, and was inaugurated on 12 May 2024.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at age 30 (he was born October 1, 1993). His death came one day after he withdrew during the second round of the Charles Schwab Challenge in Fort Worth, Texas. His parents confirmed in a statement the following day that he had died by suicide.

Murray was a two-time PGA Tour winner, having won the 2017 Barbasol Championship and the 2024 Sony Open in Hawaii, the latter just a few months before his death. He had spoken openly about his struggles with alcohol, anxiety, and depression.

If you or someone you know is struggling, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988 in the US) is available 24/7.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish stepped down as CEO of Paramount Global on April 29, 2024, amid tensions with controlling shareholder Shari Redstone during merger negotiations with Skydance Media.

Rather than naming a single successor, the company created an "Office of the CEO" shared by three executives:

- **George Cheeks**, president and CEO of CBS
- **Chris McCarthy**, head of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks
- **Brian Robbins**, head of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

That arrangement lasted until the Skydance merger closed in August 2025. The combined company, Paramount Skydance, is led by David Ellison as chairman and CEO, with Jeff Shell as president. Of the three …

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée has died. She passed away on 18 June 2024 at her home in Paris, aged 92. She was best known for her roles in *La Dolce Vita*, *8½*, *Lola*, and *A Man and a Woman*, the last of which earned her an Academy Award nomination.

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
**John Swinney** is the First Minister of Scotland, as far as I know. The SNP leader took office in May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf.

My information may be out of date, though. A Scottish Parliament election was due by May 2026, so it's worth checking a current source.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi has died. He was killed on May 19, 2024, when the helicopter carrying him crashed in a mountainous, foggy area of Iran's East Azerbaijan province, near Varzaqan. He was returning from a ceremony inaugurating a dam on the border with Azerbaijan.

The wreckage was found the next day, May 20, with no survivors. Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian and several others on board, including the provincial governor, also died.

Iranian investigations attributed the crash of the Bell 212 helicopter mainly to bad weather, including dense fog, and reported no evidence of sabotage or attack.

First Vice President Mohammad Mokhber became acting president. Masoud Pezeshkian won the subse…

2024-06-death-mays.r:
Willie Mays has died. He passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93, in the San Francisco Bay Area; the cause was reported as heart failure.

His death came just two days before a Major League Baseball game held in his honor at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama, where he had played as a teenager with the Birmingham Black Barons of the Negro Leagues.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
Bill Cobbs has died. He passed away on June 25, 2024, at his home in Riverside, California, just days after turning 90 (he was born June 16, 1934). His family announced that he died peacefully of natural causes.

Cobbs was known for roles in films such as *The Hudsucker Proxy*, *The Bodyguard*, *Night at the Museum*, *Demolition Man*, and *Air Bud*, along with many television appearances.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**Tô Lâm** was elected President of Vietnam by the National Assembly on 22 May 2024, following Võ Văn Thưởng's resignation in March 2024. He had previously been Minister of Public Security. Vice President Võ Thị Ánh Xuân served as acting president in the interim.

Tô Lâm became General Secretary of the Communist Party in August 2024, and Lương Cường succeeded him as President in October 2024.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
Martin Mull has died. He passed away on June 27, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles at the age of 80, following a long illness. His daughter, Maggie Mull, announced his death the next day.

Mull was known for his roles in *Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman*, *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne*, *Arrested Development*, *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, and the film *Clue*, in which he played Colonel Mustard.

2024-05-office-peloton.r:
This could refer to either of two events, as Peloton has had two CEOs step down amid layoffs:

- **John Foley**, the co-founder, stepped down as CEO in February 2022, when Peloton announced a restructuring and cut about 2,800 jobs. He became executive chair and was replaced by Barry McCarthy.
- **Barry McCarthy** stepped down as CEO in May 2024, when Peloton announced it was cutting about 15% of its workforce (roughly 400 jobs) as part of a further restructuring.

If you mean the most recent departure, the answer is Barry McCarthy; if you mean the original 2022 shake-up, it is John Foley.

2024-06-death-west.r:
Jerry West has died. He passed away on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86. The Los Angeles Clippers, for whom he was working as an executive consultant, announced his death.

West was a Hall of Fame guard for the Los Angeles Lakers and later a highly successful executive. His silhouette is widely recognized as the basis for the NBA logo.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r:
Donald Sutherland has died. The Canadian actor passed away on June 20, 2024, in Miami, Florida, at the age of 88, following a long illness. His death was announced by his son, actor Kiefer Sutherland.

He was known for films such as *MASH*, *Klute*, *Don't Look Now*, *Ordinary People*, and *The Hunger Games* series.

2024-05-office-solomon.r:
**Jeremiah Manele** was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands on 2 May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare after the April 2024 general election. Manele, previously the foreign minister, won the parliamentary vote against Matthew Wale after Sogavare chose not to stand again.

Sogavare served several separate terms, so his earlier successors were Allan Kemakeza (2001), Derek Sikua (2007), and Rick Houenipela (2017).

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to succeed Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General. The North Atlantic Council confirmed his appointment in June 2024, and he took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on 1 June 2024. She took about 34% of the vote, ahead of former prime minister Katrín Jakobsdóttir (about 25%) and Halla Hrund Logadóttir (about 16%). She took office on 1 August 2024, succeeding Guðni Th. Jóhannesson, and is the second woman to serve as Iceland's president, after Vigdís Finnbogadóttir.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's presidential election on June 2, 2024, becoming the first woman elected president of the country. She ran for the Morena party and its allies, defeated opposition candidate Xóchitl Gálvez by a wide margin with roughly 59–60% of the vote, and took office on October 1, 2024, succeeding Andrés Manuel López Obrador.

2024-07-death-duvall.r:
Shelley Duvall has died. She passed away on July 11, 2024, at her home in Blanco, Texas, at age 75. The cause was complications from diabetes, according to her longtime partner, Dan Gilroy.

She was best known for her roles in *The Shining*, *Popeye*, and several Robert Altman films, including *3 Women* and *Nashville*.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall has died. He passed away on July 22, 2024, at his home in California, at the age of 90. Often called the "Godfather of British Blues," he led the Bluesbreakers, a band that helped launch the careers of Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor, among others.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: Sheila Jackson Lee has died. She passed away on July 19, 2024, at age 74, after announcing in June 2024 that she had been diagnosed with pancreatic cancer. She had represented Texas's 18th Congressional District, based in Houston, since 1995.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart has died. He passed away on July 18, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles at the age of 94, following a series of short illnesses. He was best known for his deadpan stand-up comedy and for starring in *The Bob Newhart Show* and *Newhart*, as well as later roles in *Elf* and *The Big Bang Theory*.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Jacoby Jones has died. He passed away on July 14, 2024, at his home in New Orleans, just days after turning 40 (he was born July 11, 1984). A medical examiner's report later attributed his death to hypertensive cardiovascular disease.

Jones was a wide receiver and return specialist, best known for his time with the Houston Texans and Baltimore Ravens. With the Ravens he caught the "Mile High Miracle" touchdown in the 2012 playoffs and returned a kickoff 108 yards for a touchdown in Super Bowl XLVII.

2024-06-office-india.r:
Assuming you mean the most recent general election (April–June 2024), Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime Minister on 9 June 2024, beginning his third consecutive term.

His party, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), did not win an outright majority on its own. It won 240 of the 543 Lok Sabha seats, short of the 272 needed. It formed the government through the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), which together won about 293 seats, relying on allies such as the Telugu Desam Party and the Janata Dal (United).

If you meant an earlier election, the answer differs: the BJP won a majority on its own in both 2014 (282 seats) and 2019 (303 seats), with Modi sworn in each time.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: **Sir Keir Starmer**, leader of the Labour Party, was appointed Prime Minister by King Charles III on 5 July 2024. This followed Labour's landslide victory in the general election of 4 July 2024, which ended 14 years of Conservative-led government and saw Rishi Sunak resign.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
**Cyril Ramaphosa** was re-elected President by the National Assembly on 14 June 2024, and **the ANC did not keep its majority**.

In the May 2024 general election the ANC won about 40% of the vote (159 of 400 seats), losing its outright majority for the first time since 1994. Ramaphosa secured his second term through a coalition deal, a "Government of National Unity" with the Democratic Alliance, the Inkatha Freedom Party and other smaller parties. He defeated the EFF's Julius Malema in the parliamentary vote, 283 to 44.

If you mean the 2019 election, Ramaphosa was also chosen by parliament then, and the ANC did keep its majority that time, with about 57.5% of the vote.

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024, following weeks of pressure from within the Democratic Party after his poor debate performance against Donald Trump in late June. He endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris the same day.

Harris went on to become the Democratic nominee, with Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate. She lost the November 2024 general election to Donald Trump.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: **Masoud Pezeshkian** won the election. After Ebrahim Raisi died in a helicopter crash in May 2024, Iran held a snap presidential election on June 28, 2024. No candidate won a majority in the first round, so a runoff was held on July 5, 2024. Pezeshkian, a reformist-backed heart surgeon and former health minister, defeated hardline conservative Saeed Jalili with roughly 53–54% of the vote. He took office later that month.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. The fitness personality passed away on July 13, 2024, at his home in the Hollywood Hills area of Los Angeles, one day after his 76th birthday.

The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner ruled his death accidental. It was caused by complications from recent falls, with heart disease (arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease) as a contributing factor. He had reportedly fallen at home in the day or so before his death and declined to seek medical attention at the time. His housekeeper found him unresponsive the next morning.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon has died. He passed away on 18 August 2024 at the age of 88, at his home in Douchy, France. His family announced the death, and he had been in declining health since a stroke in 2019.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was assassinated on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran, where he had traveled to attend the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

He was killed in the early hours of the morning at a guesthouse in northern Tehran run by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. One of his bodyguards also died. Accounts of the method differ. Iranian officials said he was killed by a short-range projectile fired from outside the building. The New York Times and other Western outlets reported that an explosive device had been hidden in his room well in advance and detonated remotely.

Iran and Hamas immediately blamed Israel. Israel did not comment at first, but in Decembe…

2024-07-office-france.r:
The New Popular Front (Nouveau Front Populaire), a left-wing alliance, won the most seats in France's 2024 snap National Assembly election, held on 30 June and 7 July. It took roughly 180 of the 577 seats, well short of the 289 needed for a majority.

President Macron's centrist Ensemble alliance came second with around 160 seats, and the far-right National Rally and its allies came third with around 140, despite having led after the first round. The result was a hung parliament.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean is dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at age 60, after being diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia. At the time of his death he was Major League Baseball's Senior Vice President for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and a special assistant to the commissioner.

He played in the majors as an outfielder for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Dodgers, and San Diego Padres between 1987 and 1995. He came out as gay in 1999, after his playing career ended.

He should not be confused with Billy Beane, the longtime Oakland Athletics executive of *Moneyball* fame, who is still alive as far as I know.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki, the former CEO of YouTube, has died. She died on August 9, 2024, at age 56, after living with non-small cell lung cancer for about two years. Her husband, Dennis Troper, announced her death publicly.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Graham Thorpe has died. He passed away on 4 August 2024, aged 55, just days after his birthday on 1 August.

His family later said he had taken his own life after several years of severe depression and anxiety. He was struck by a train at Esher railway station in Surrey, and an inquest in 2025 recorded a conclusion of suicide. He had also been seriously ill in hospital in 2022 following an earlier attempt on his life.

Thorpe played 100 Tests for England between 1993 and 2005, scoring over 6,700 runs, and later worked as a batting coach with the England team.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, in Fort Collins, Colorado, at the age of 76, after a battle with cancer. His final appearance as Taggart came in *Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F*, released earlier that year.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: **Brian Niccol** was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks in August 2024, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. Niccol had been CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill, and he took up the Starbucks role in September 2024. Starbucks CFO Rachel Ruggeri served as interim CEO in the meantime.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop (born Isaac Freeman III) has died. He collapsed on stage on August 30, 2024, while performing at a free concert at Hamden Town Center Park in Hamden, Connecticut. People at the venue attempted CPR, and he was taken by ambulance to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. He was 53.

Connecticut's chief medical examiner later ruled that he died of hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, meaning heart disease, and that the manner of death was natural.

He was best known for his 1999 club hit "Be Faithful" and for his features on Missy Elliott's "Lose Control" and Mariah Carey's "It's Like That."

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones has died. He passed away on September 9, 2024, at the age of 93, at his home in Pawling, New York. He was best known for voicing Darth Vader in *Star Wars* and Mufasa in *The Lion King*, as well as for a long, acclaimed career on stage and screen.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on September 28, 2024, at his home in Maui, Hawaii, at the age of 88. His family announced that he died peacefully, surrounded by loved ones; no cause of death was given.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
**Paetongtarn Shinawatra** succeeded Srettha Thavisin. The Constitutional Court removed Srettha on 14 August 2024, and parliament elected her two days later. She is the Pheu Thai Party leader and daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra, and she became Thailand's youngest prime minister.

She is no longer in office, though. The Constitutional Court suspended her in July 2025 over a leaked phone call with Cambodia's Hun Sen and removed her on 29 August 2025. As far as I know, **Anutin Charnvirakul** of the Bhumjaithai Party was then elected prime minister in September 2025, but the situation may have changed since my information was last updated.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on September 15, 2024, at age 70.

He reportedly suffered a medical emergency, believed to be a heart attack, while traveling by road from New Mexico to Oklahoma. He was taken to a hospital in Gallup, New Mexico, where he was pronounced dead. The heart attack account came from a family friend and former manager, Steve Manning, and I'm not certain an official cause of death was publicly confirmed.

His sons TJ, Taj, and Taryll (of the group 3T) announced his death. He had still been performing with his brothers as The Jacksons shortly before he died.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is no longer a U.S. Senator. He resigned his New Jersey seat effective August 20, 2024, after a federal jury in Manhattan convicted him on July 16, 2024, on all 16 counts in a corruption case. The charges included bribery, extortion, honest services wire fraud, obstruction of justice, conspiracy, and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt.

Prosecutors showed he had accepted gold bars, cash, a Mercedes-Benz convertible and other bribes from New Jersey businessmen in exchange for using his office to benefit them and the governments of Egypt and Qatar. He had stepped down as chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee when he was indicted in September 2023. After the convi…

2024-08-office-sinwar.r:
**Yahya Sinwar** was chosen. Hamas announced him as head of its political bureau on August 6, 2024, about a week after Ismail Haniyeh was assassinated in Tehran on July 31, 2024. Sinwar had been Hamas's leader in Gaza and was regarded as a chief architect of the October 7, 2023 attack.

Sinwar was himself killed by Israeli forces in Rafah on October 16, 2024. After his death, Hamas was reported to be run by a temporary leadership committee rather than a single named successor. Its reported members included Khalil al-Hayya and Khaled Meshaal.

2024-09-death-rose.r:
Pete Rose has died. He passed away on September 30, 2024, at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada, at age 83. The Clark County coroner attributed his death to hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, with diabetes as a contributing factor.

Rose remains MLB's all-time hits leader with 4,256. In May 2025, several months after his death, MLB Commissioner Rob Manfred removed him from the permanently ineligible list, making him eligible for Hall of Fame consideration.

2024-08-office-yunus.r:
**Muhammad Yunus**, the Nobel Peace Prize-winning economist and founder of Grameen Bank, leads Bangladesh's interim government as chief adviser. He was sworn in on 8 August 2024, a few days after Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled to India on 5 August 2024 amid mass student-led protests.

The interim government was meant to serve only until a national election, which was planned for early 2026. I can't confirm whether that election has taken place, so an elected government may have since replaced it.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on 27 September 2024 at the age of 89, in hospital in London. Her death was announced by her sons, Toby Stephens and Chris Larkin.

She was best known for roles in *The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie*, the *Harry Potter* films (as Professor McGonagall), and *Downton Abbey* (as the Dowager Countess of Grantham).

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on 27 September 2024 in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters in the Haret Hreik area of Dahiyeh, the southern suburbs of Beirut. Israel announced his death the next day, 28 September, and Hezbollah confirmed it that same day.

The strike reportedly involved dozens of heavy bunker-buster bombs, which leveled several residential buildings above the command complex. Others killed included Ali Karaki, a senior Hezbollah commander, and Abbas Nilforoushan, a deputy commander in Iran's Revolutionary Guards.

Nasrallah had led Hezbollah since 1992. His presumed successor, Hashem Safieddine, was killed in another Israeli strike in early …

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister on 5 September 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal. Barnier, a veteran politician from the centre-right Les Républicains and the EU's former chief Brexit negotiator, was named after the snap legislative elections of summer 2024 produced a hung parliament.

His tenure was short: his government fell to a no-confidence vote in December 2024, and he was succeeded by François Bayrou.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
Assuming you mean the most recent election, in September 2024, the winner was **Anura Kumara Dissanayake** of the National People's Power (NPP) alliance. He defeated the incumbent president, Ranil Wickremesinghe, and opposition leader Sajith Premadasa.

If you meant the 2015 election, the answer is **Maithripala Sirisena**, who defeated the incumbent Mahinda Rajapaksa.

2024-09-office-hill.r: **Elliott Hill** was named to replace John Donahoe as president and CEO of Nike, Inc. Nike announced the change in September 2024, and it took effect on October 14, 2024. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who had retired from the company in 2020 after more than 30 years there.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor has died. She passed away on October 17, 2024, in Los Angeles at the age of 93, reportedly of natural causes. She was best known for playing Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film version of *South Pacific*.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh has died. He passed away on October 25, 2024, at the age of 84. His death was announced on his official social media accounts, which said he died peacefully surrounded by family. No cause of death was given, though he had faced health problems over the years, including a liver transplant in 1998 and bouts with prostate and bladder cancer.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No, Sheikh Hasina is no longer Prime Minister of Bangladesh. She resigned and fled to India on 5 August 2024 after weeks of mass protests.

- **Why she fell:** Student protests began in mid-2024 over a quota system for government jobs. After a violent crackdown by security forces, they grew into a nationwide uprising against her 15-year rule. A UN human rights report estimated that up to about 1,400 people may have been killed.
- **Her departure:** As crowds marched on her residence in Dhaka, she left by military helicopter for India, where she has remained in exile.
- **Who replaced her:** An interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus, as Chief Adviser, took office on 8 August …

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr has died. She passed away on October 29, 2024, in Los Angeles at the age of 79, from complications of multiple sclerosis, a disease she had lived with for decades and publicly disclosed in 2002.

She earned an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress for *Tootsie* (1982). Besides *Young Frankenstein* (1974), she was known for *Close Encounters of the Third Kind* and *Mr. Mom*.

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond has died. He died on 12 October 2024, aged 69, after suffering a heart attack while attending a conference in Ohrid, North Macedonia.

He served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and led the Scottish National Party for two periods, before later founding and leading the Alba Party.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on October 9, 2024, at the age of 86, at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, where he had been admitted a few days earlier. He was given a state funeral in Mumbai the following day. His half-brother Noel Tata succeeded him as chairman of Tata Trusts.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
The question doesn't say which election, so I'll assume you mean the most recent one I know of. **Sanae Takaichi** won the Liberal Democratic Party leadership election on October 4, 2025, defeating Shinjiro Koizumi in a runoff. She succeeded Shigeru Ishiba as party leader and became Japan's first female prime minister later that month.

If you meant the September 2024 election, that was won by **Shigeru Ishiba**, who beat Takaichi in the runoff and succeeded Fumio Kishida as prime minister.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: **Shigeru Ishiba** succeeded Fumio Kishida. He won the Liberal Democratic Party leadership election on September 27, 2024, defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff, and was elected Prime Minister by the National Diet on October 1, 2024.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on October 22, 2024, in Los Angeles at the age of 63. His death came just days before the Dodgers began the 2024 World Series against the New York Yankees. He had stepped away from his job as a Dodgers Spanish-language broadcaster shortly before to focus on his health. The cause of death was not disclosed at the time of the announcement.

Valenzuela was best known for "Fernandomania" in 1981, when he won both the NL Rookie of the Year and Cy Young awards and helped the Dodgers win the World Series. The team retired his number 34 in 2023.

2024-10-office-nike.r: **Elliott Hill** is Nike's president and CEO. A longtime Nike veteran who had retired in 2020 after more than 30 years with the company, he returned to succeed John Donahoe, taking over in October 2024.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne has died. He died on October 16, 2024, aged 31, after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palermo Hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The autopsy found the cause of death was multiple traumas with internal and external bleeding from the fall. Toxicology reports indicated he had alcohol, cocaine, and a prescription antidepressant in his system at the time.

Argentine authorities later charged several people in connection with his death, including over the supply of drugs, though some of the charges were subsequently dropped. His funeral was held in England in November 2024 and was attended by his former One Direction bandmates.

2024-11-death-west.r: Timothy West has died. He passed away on 12 November 2024, aged 90. His family, including his wife, the actress Prunella Scales, announced his death.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones has died. He passed away on November 3, 2024, at the age of 91, at his home in the Bel Air neighborhood of Los Angeles, surrounded by his family. The cause was later reported as pancreatic cancer.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on 24 November 2024 at her home in New York City, aged 91, following a short illness.

Born in Leeds, England, on 10 May 1933, she became one of the world's best-selling novelists. Her 1979 debut, *A Woman of Substance*, sold tens of millions of copies. She was appointed an OBE in 2007 for her contributions to literature.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
Judith Jamison has died. She passed away on November 9, 2024, in New York City at the age of 81, reportedly after a brief illness.

Jamison was a star dancer with the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater, famous for her performance in Ailey's solo "Cry" (1971). She served as the company's artistic director from 1989 to 2011, succeeding Alvin Ailey after his death.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024, at age 26.

The San Francisco Office of the Chief Medical Examiner ruled his death a suicide, and police said they found no evidence of foul play. His parents have publicly disputed that conclusion. They commissioned a private autopsy, called for further investigation, and pursued legal action seeking more information.

Balaji worked at OpenAI for about four years before leaving in 2024. He drew attention in October 2024 when he told The New York Times he believed the company's use of copyrighted material to train its models violated copyright law. He had also been named as a person with potentiall…

2024-11-office-trump-election.r:
Donald Trump, the Republican candidate, won the most recent U.S. presidential election that I know of, held in November 2024. He defeated the Democratic candidate, Vice President Kamala Harris, winning 312 electoral votes to her 226, and was inaugurated for his second term in January 2025.

Harris became the Democratic nominee after President Joe Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Nikki Giovanni has died. She passed away on December 9, 2024, in Blacksburg, Virginia, at age 81, from complications of lung cancer. She had been a longtime professor at Virginia Tech and was one of the most prominent voices to emerge from the Black Arts Movement.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
It depends on which transition you mean:

- **2024 (second term):** President-elect Trump announced Pete Hegseth, a Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran, as his pick in November 2024. Hegseth was confirmed in January 2025.
- **2016 (first term):** President-elect Trump chose retired Marine Corps General James Mattis, who was confirmed in January 2017.

If you're asking about the most recent transition, the answer is Pete Hegseth.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar is dead. He was killed by Israeli forces on October 16, 2024, in the Tal al-Sultan area of Rafah in southern Gaza.

- **How it happened:** It was a chance encounter rather than a targeted assassination. Israeli soldiers on a routine patrol, reportedly from the Bislamach Brigade, spotted several militants moving between buildings and engaged them. Sinwar fled alone into a damaged building, which was hit with tank fire. Israeli drone footage showed a wounded, masked man, later identified as Sinwar, sitting in an armchair and throwing a stick at the drone shortly before he was killed.
- **Cause of death:** The Israeli pathologist who performed the autopsy said he died from a gunsho…

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Based on my knowledge, the most recent general election in Mauritius was held on 10 November 2024. **Navin Ramgoolam**, leader of the Labour Party and the Alliance du Changement coalition, became prime minister after his alliance won a landslide, taking 60 of the 62 directly elected seats. He replaced **Pravind Jugnauth** of the Militant Socialist Movement, who had been prime minister since 2017.

This is Ramgoolam's third stint in the office, after serving from 1995 to 2000 and from 2005 to 2014. If an election has taken place since my information was last updated, this answer may be out of date.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Jimmy Carter has died. He passed away on December 29, 2024, at his home in Plains, Georgia, at the age of 100. He was the longest-lived U.S. president in history and had been in hospice care since February 2023. His state funeral was held on January 9, 2025, at Washington National Cathedral, and he was buried in Plains next to his wife, Rosalynn, who died in November 2023.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Greg Gumbel has died. He passed away on December 27, 2024, at age 78, from cancer. His family announced his death in a statement released through CBS Sports, where he had worked for many years as a studio host and play-by-play announcer, notably on NFL and NCAA March Madness coverage. He had missed the 2024 NCAA Tournament because of what were described at the time as family health issues.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson has died. He passed away on December 20, 2024, at age 65, just a few days before his 66th birthday on December 25. Reports at the time indicated he had been suffering from pneumonia and died in the Oakland area.

Henderson, inducted into the Hall of Fame in 2009, is MLB's all-time leader in stolen bases (1,406) and runs scored (2,295), and is widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter in baseball history.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
**Matt Gaetz, and no, he never held the office.** After winning the 2024 election, President-elect Trump announced in November 2024 that he would nominate Gaetz, then a Florida congressman, as Attorney General. Gaetz withdrew about a week later, on November 21, 2024, amid Senate opposition and scrutiny over sexual misconduct allegations and a House Ethics Committee investigation. Trump then chose former Florida Attorney General Pam Bondi, whom the Senate confirmed in February 2025.

If you meant Trump's first term, his first pick as President-elect in 2016 was Senator Jeff Sessions of Alabama. Sessions was confirmed and served as Attorney General from February 2017 until he resigned at Trump…

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
**It lost its majority.** In the general election of October 27, 2024, the LDP won 191 seats and Komeito 24, for a total of 215. That was short of the 233 needed for a majority in the 465-seat House of Representatives. It was the coalition's first loss of its lower-house majority since 2009, and Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba continued at the head of a minority government.

That is the last election the LDP-Komeito coalition contested together. Komeito left the coalition in October 2025, and Sanae Takaichi became prime minister with the LDP in partnership with Nippon Ishin no Kai.

I am less sure about what came after. I believe Takaichi then called a snap election for February 2026, which th…

2025-01-death-faithfull.r: Marianne Faithfull has died. She passed away on 30 January 2025 in London, at the age of 78.

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Manmohan Singh has died. He passed away on 26 December 2024 at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi, aged 92, after being admitted following a sudden loss of consciousness at home. He had been suffering from age-related health conditions.

He served as India's Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014. The Indian government declared seven days of national mourning, and he was cremated with full state honours in Delhi on 28 December 2024.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
Christian Lindner, the leader of the Free Democratic Party (FDP), was dismissed as finance minister by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on 6 November 2024. The dismissal came after months of disputes over the 2025 budget and economic policy, particularly Lindner's refusal to suspend or loosen the constitutional "debt brake" to allow more borrowing. Scholz publicly accused him of breaking his trust and acting in narrow party interest, while Lindner said Scholz had tried to force him to violate the debt brake.

His firing collapsed the three-party "traffic light" coalition of the SPD, Greens and FDP. The other FDP ministers left the government, except Transport Minister Volker Wissing, who quit the part…

2025-01-death-le-pen.r: Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96, in Garches, near Paris, where he had been receiving care.

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
Brian Thompson has died. He was shot and killed on the morning of December 4, 2024, outside the New York Hilton Midtown in Manhattan, where he was arriving for UnitedHealth Group's annual investor conference. He was 50 years old.

A masked gunman approached him from behind on the sidewalk, fired several times, and fled. Police described it as a targeted attack. After a multi-day manhunt, Luigi Mangione, then 26, was arrested on December 9, 2024, at a McDonald's in Altoona, Pennsylvania. He was charged with murder and related offenses in both state and federal court and has pleaded not guilty.

Thompson had been CEO of UnitedHealthcare, the insurance division of UnitedHealth Group, since 2021…

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
**John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) won Ghana's most recent presidential election, held on December 7, 2024. He defeated Vice President Mahamudu Bawumia of the then-ruling New Patriotic Party (NPP), taking roughly 56% of the vote to Bawumia's roughly 41%. Bawumia conceded the day after the vote.

Mahama, who was previously president from 2012 to 2017, was sworn in on January 7, 2025, succeeding Nana Akufo-Addo. His running mate, Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang, became Ghana's first female vice president.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore has died. He passed away on January 10, 2025, in Coral Gables, Florida, at age 89, reportedly from complications while recovering from surgery.

Moore was the tenor half of Sam & Dave, known for hits like "Soul Man" and "Hold On, I'm Comin'." His partner, Dave Prater, died in a car accident in 1988.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby's tenure as Archbishop of Canterbury ended in resignation. He had held the post since 2013 and announced on 12 November 2024 that he would step down, days after the publication of the Makin Review.

That independent review examined the Church of England's handling of abuse by John Smyth, a barrister who physically and sexually abused more than 100 boys and young men. He had met many of them through Christian summer camps in the UK and later in Africa. The review found that Welby "could and should" have ensured the abuse was properly reported to police after he was informed of it in 2013. Smyth died in South Africa in 2018 without facing trial.

Welby initially said he would not …

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards has died. She passed away on January 20, 2025, at age 67, from glioblastoma, an aggressive brain cancer she had been diagnosed with in 2023.

She led Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018 and was the daughter of former Texas Governor Ann Richards. In November 2024, a couple of months before her death, President Biden awarded her the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at age 86, at his home in New York City, after having bladder cancer for several years.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier's government was brought down by a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly on 4 December 2024, about three months after Emmanuel Macron appointed him in September 2024.

- **Background:** Barnier led a minority government after the snap legislative elections of summer 2024 produced a hung parliament split among the left-wing New Popular Front, Macron's centrists, and Marine Le Pen's National Rally.
- **Trigger:** He used Article 49.3 of the constitution to force through the 2025 social security budget without a vote. The budget was part of an austerity plan to reduce France's large deficit.
- **The vote:** The left-wing alliance filed a no-confidence motion, and the Nation…

2025-01-office-aoun.r: **Joseph Aoun** is the President of Lebanon, as far as I know. The former commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces, he was elected by parliament on January 9, 2025. His election ended a vacancy of more than two years that began when Michel Aoun's term expired in October 2022. The two men are not related.

2025-01-office-salam.r: **Nawaf Salam** was designated Prime Minister of Lebanon on January 13, 2025. A jurist and diplomat, he was serving as President of the International Court of Justice at the time. President Joseph Aoun, himself elected only days earlier, named him after consultations with parliament, and Salam succeeded caretaker Prime Minister Najib Mikati. He formed his government in early February 2025.

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
Bob Uecker has died. He passed away on January 16, 2025, at the age of 90. His family disclosed that he had been privately battling small cell lung cancer since early 2023.

Uecker, known as "Mr. Baseball," was the radio voice of the Milwaukee Brewers for more than 50 years, beginning in 1971. He was also known for his role as announcer Harry Doyle in the *Major League* films, his part in the sitcom *Mr. Belvedere*, and his many appearances on *The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson*.

2024-12-office-romania.r:
Romania's Constitutional Court annulled the first round of the presidential election on December 6, 2024, two days before the scheduled runoff. That round, held on November 24, 2024, had been unexpectedly won by the far-right, pro-Russian independent Călin Georgescu.

The court had initially ordered a recount and validated the results on December 2. It reversed course after declassified Romanian intelligence documents alleged irregularities, including a coordinated social media campaign promoting Georgescu, largely on TikTok, undeclared campaign financing, and signs of foreign (suspected Russian) interference. The court ruled that the integrity of the electoral process had been compromised a…

2025-02-death-flack.r:
Roberta Flack has died. She passed away on February 24, 2025, at the age of 88. She had been diagnosed with ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), which was publicly announced in 2022 and had left her unable to sing.

Flack was best known for hits like "The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face," "Killing Me Softly with His Song," and "Feel Like Makin' Love."

control-alive-messi.r: Yes, as far as I know, Lionel Messi is alive. He was born on June 24, 1987, and has been playing for Inter Miami in Major League Soccer and captaining the Argentina national team. I can't check real-time news, but I have no information suggesting otherwise.

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
David Lynch has died. He died on January 15, 2025, at age 78, a few days before his 79th birthday, and his family announced the death publicly the following day.

He had revealed in 2024 that he had emphysema after decades of smoking. The reported cause of death was cardiac arrest, with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease as the underlying condition. His health reportedly worsened after he was evacuated from his Los Angeles home during the January 2025 wildfires.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
No, Justin Trudeau is no longer Liberal leader or Prime Minister. He announced on January 6, 2025 that he would resign from both roles once the party chose a successor. This followed months of declining poll numbers, pressure from within his caucus, and the abrupt resignation of Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland in December 2024.

Mark Carney won the Liberal leadership race on March 9, 2025 and was sworn in as Prime Minister on March 14, 2025, ending Trudeau's tenure of more than nine years. Carney then led the Liberals to victory in the federal election on April 28, 2025.

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
Gene Hackman has died. He and his wife, Betsy Arakawa, were found dead in their home in Santa Fe, New Mexico, on February 26, 2025. He was 95.

Investigators concluded that he probably died around February 18, 2025, based on data from his pacemaker. The cause was heart disease (hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease), with advanced Alzheimer's disease as a contributing factor. His wife had died about a week earlier of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome.

2025-02-death-johansen.r: David Johansen has died. He passed away on February 28, 2025, at his home on Staten Island, New York, at age 75. Shortly before his death, his family had revealed that he had been living with stage 4 cancer and a brain tumor, and that he had broken his back in a fall. He was the last surviving original member of the New York Dolls and was also known for his alter ego Buster Poindexter.

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r: The Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim al-Hussaini) has died. He passed away on 4 February 2025 in Lisbon, Portugal, at the age of 88. He had been the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957. His eldest son, Prince Rahim al-Hussaini, succeeded him as Aga Khan V, and he was buried in Aswan, Egypt.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler has died. As far as I know, he passed away on February 20, 2025, at his home in Chicago, aged 85, after living with Parkinson's disease.

Butler was the original lead singer of the Impressions ("For Your Precious Love") before a long solo career with hits like "Only the Strong Survive" and "He Will Break Your Heart." He also served for decades as a Cook County commissioner in Illinois.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad's government collapsed on December 8, 2024, ending more than 50 years of Assad family rule in Syria. His father Hafez had taken power in 1970, and Bashar had ruled since 2000.

**How it happened:**
- On November 27, 2024, opposition forces led by the Islamist group Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), alongside Turkish-backed factions and other rebel groups, launched a surprise offensive from northwest Syria.
- Aleppo fell within days, followed by Hama and Homs, while southern rebel groups advanced from Daraa. The Syrian army largely collapsed with little resistance.
- Assad's main backers, Russia, Iran and Hezbollah, were weakened or preoccupied by the war in Ukraine and the conflict…

2025-02-death-kim-sae-ron.r:
Kim Sae-ron has died. She was found dead at her home in Seongdong District, Seoul, on February 16, 2025, at the age of 24. Police found no signs of foul play and treated her death as a suicide.

She was known for her work as a child actress in films such as *A Brand New Life* (2009) and *The Man from Nowhere* (2010). Her career had largely stalled after a drunk-driving incident in 2022.

2025-02-death-paquita.r: Paquita la del Barrio (Francisca Viveros Barradas) has died. She passed away on February 17, 2025, at her home in Veracruz, Mexico, at the age of 77. She was known for songs like "Rata de dos patas."

2025-02-death-spassky.r:
Boris Spassky has died. The tenth world chess champion passed away on February 27, 2025, in Moscow, at the age of 88. His death was announced by the Russian Chess Federation.

Spassky held the world title from 1969 to 1972 and is best remembered for his 1972 "Match of the Century" against Bobby Fischer in Reykjavik.

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:
Angie Stone has died. She was killed on March 1, 2025, at age 63, in a vehicle crash on Interstate 65 near Montgomery, Alabama. She was traveling back to Atlanta after a performance in Mobile when the van she was riding in overturned and was then struck by a truck.

Stone was known as a member of the pioneering female hip-hop trio The Sequence and for solo neo-soul hits like "No More Rain (In This Cloud)" and "Wish I Didn't Miss You."

2025-02-office-german-election.r:
The most recent German federal election I know of was held on 23 February 2025, a snap election called after Olaf Scholz's coalition collapsed. The CDU/CSU (the Union) won the most votes, with about 28.5%, and its chancellor candidate was Friedrich Merz, the CDU leader.

The AfD came second with about 20.8%, and the SPD third with about 16.4%. Merz went on to form a coalition with the SPD and was elected chancellor in May 2025.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r:
Michelle Trachtenberg has died. She was found unresponsive in her Manhattan apartment on February 26, 2025, and was pronounced dead at age 39.

Her family initially declined an autopsy, so the cause was first listed as undetermined. In April 2025, the New York City medical examiner's office ruled that she died of natural causes, from complications of diabetes mellitus. Reports at the time also said she had recently undergone a liver transplant.

She was best known for *Harriet the Spy*, for playing Dawn Summers on *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*, and for playing Georgina Sparks on *Gossip Girl*.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r: Roy Ayers has died. The vibraphonist and composer, best known for "Everybody Loves the Sunshine," died on March 4, 2025, in New York City at the age of 84. His family said he died after a long illness.

2025-03-death-dequenne.r:
Émilie Dequenne has died. She passed away on 16 March 2025, aged 43, at the Gustave Roussy hospital in Villejuif, near Paris. The cause was adrenocortical carcinoma, a rare cancer of the adrenal gland, which she had made public in 2023.

She was best known for *Rosetta* (1999), which won her the Best Actress award at Cannes.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
Yoon Suk Yeol was impeached, removed from office, and criminally prosecuted after declaring martial law on December 3, 2024.

- **Martial law reversed:** The National Assembly voted 190–0 to overturn the decree within hours, and Yoon lifted it about six hours after declaring it.
- **Impeachment:** A first impeachment motion failed on December 7 when his party boycotted the vote. A second passed 204–85 on December 14, suspending him from office.
- **Arrest:** After a failed attempt on January 3, 2025, blocked by his security service, investigators detained him on January 15. He was the first sitting South Korean president to be arrested. He was indicted later that month on charges of leading …

fake-death-keanu-reeves.r:
No, as far as I know, Keanu Reeves has not passed away. I have no record of his death, and he has been active in recent years with projects like *John Wick: Chapter 4* (2023) and his band Dogstar.

He has been the target of celebrity death hoaxes before, including false reports of a snowboarding accident. These spread through social media and fake news sites, so if you saw a claim like this recently, it's very likely another hoax.

My information isn't real-time, so I can't rule out very recent events with certainty. Checking a reliable news source such as AP, Reuters, or the BBC would settle it, since the death of someone that famous would be widely reported.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r:
Eddie Jordan has died. He passed away on 20 March 2025 in Cape Town, South Africa, at the age of 76. He had revealed in December 2024 that he was being treated for an aggressive form of prostate cancer that had spread to his spine and pelvis.

Jordan founded the Jordan Grand Prix team, which raced in Formula One from 1991 to 2005 and gave Michael Schumacher his F1 debut. He later became a well-known television pundit.

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r:
Richard Chamberlain has died. He passed away on March 29, 2025, in Waimānalo, Hawaii, at age 90, two days before his 91st birthday. The reported cause was complications following a stroke.

He was best known for the title role in *Dr. Kildare* and for the miniseries *Shōgun* and *The Thorn Birds*.

2025-03-death-foreman.r:
George Foreman has died. He passed away on March 21, 2025, at the age of 76, in Houston, Texas. His family announced the death on social media, saying he died peacefully surrounded by loved ones.

Foreman was a two-time heavyweight champion and Olympic gold medalist (1968). He was known for the 1974 "Rumble in the Jungle" against Muhammad Ali, and for regaining the heavyweight title in 1994 at age 45, which made him the oldest heavyweight champion in history. He was also famous for the George Foreman Grill.

2025-03-death-mia-love.r:
Mia Love has died. The former Utah congresswoman passed away on March 23, 2025, at age 49, at her home in Saratoga Springs, Utah. She had been diagnosed with glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer, in 2022.

Love served in the US House from 2015 to 2019 and was the first Black Republican woman elected to Congress.

2025-04-death-jean-marsh.r:
Jean Marsh has died. She passed away on 13 April 2025 at her home in London, aged 90, reportedly from complications of dementia.

She was best known for co-creating and starring in *Upstairs, Downstairs*, in which she played the parlourmaid Rose Buck, a role that won her an Emmy Award. She also co-created *The House of Eliott* and appeared in *Doctor Who*, *Willow*, and *Return to Oz*.

2025-03-office-namibia.r: The current President of Namibia is **Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah**, as far as I know. She was sworn in on 21 March 2025 after winning the November 2024 election as the SWAPO candidate, becoming the country's first female president. She succeeded Nangolo Mbumba, who had taken office after President Hage Geingob died in February 2024.

2025-03-office-carney.r: Mark Carney succeeded Justin Trudeau. Carney, a former Governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, won the Liberal Party leadership race on March 9, 2025, after Trudeau announced his resignation in January 2025. He was sworn in as Canada's 24th Prime Minister on March 14, 2025, and went on to lead the Liberals to victory in the federal election held on April 28, 2025.

2025-04-death-vargas-llosa.r: Mario Vargas Llosa has died. He passed away on April 13, 2025, in Lima, Peru, at the age of 89. His family announced the death. The Peruvian novelist won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2010.

2025-04-death-max-romeo.r:
Max Romeo has died. He passed away on April 11, 2025, at the age of 80, in Jamaica, reportedly from heart-related complications.

Born Maxwell Livingston Smith in 1944, he was best known for songs like "Wet Dream," "Chase the Devil," and "War Ina Babylon," the latter two from his 1976 album *War Ina Babylon*, produced by Lee "Scratch" Perry.

2025-04-death-martindale.r:
Wink Martindale has died. He passed away on April 15, 2025, at the age of 91 in Rancho Mirage, California; the cause was reported as lymphoma.

Martindale was best known for hosting game shows such as *Tic-Tac-Dough*, *Gambit*, *High Rollers*, and *Debt*, in a broadcasting career that spanned more than seven decades.

control-alive-obama.r: Yes, as far as I know, Barack Obama is alive. He was born on August 4, 1961, and served as the 44th U.S. president from 2009 to 2017. I can't check real-time news, so I can't confirm events after my knowledge cutoff, but I have no information indicating otherwise.

2025-03-office-greenland.r:
**Demokraatit (the Democrats)** won the most seats in Greenland's most recent general election that I know of, held on 11 March 2025. The centre-right, pro-business party took 10 of the 31 seats in the Inatsisartut (parliament) with roughly 30% of the vote, a major gain on its previous result.

Naleraq came second with 8 seats, ahead of the previously governing Inuit Ataqatigiit (7) and Siumut (4). Demokraatit's leader, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, subsequently became premier at the head of a broad coalition.

2025-04-death-giuffre.r:
Virginia Giuffre has died. She died by suicide on April 25, 2025, at her farm in Neergabby, Western Australia, at the age of 41. Her family announced her death, describing her as a lifelong victim of sexual abuse and sex trafficking and saying the toll of that abuse had become unbearable.

Her memoir, *Nobody's Girl*, was published posthumously in October 2025.

2025-04-death-pope-francis.r:
Pope Francis has died. He passed away on April 21, 2025 (Easter Monday), at the age of 88, at his residence in the Casa Santa Marta in Vatican City. The Vatican reported the cause as a stroke followed by coma and irreversible heart failure. He had been hospitalized earlier that year with double pneumonia.

He was succeeded by Pope Leo XIV (Cardinal Robert Prevost), who was elected on May 8, 2025.

2025-04-death-kilmer.r:
Val Kilmer has died. He passed away on April 1, 2025, in Los Angeles at the age of 65. His daughter, Mercedes Kilmer, said the cause was pneumonia. He had been diagnosed with throat cancer in 2014, and the treatment, including a tracheotomy, permanently damaged his voice.

Kilmer was known for films such as *Top Gun*, *The Doors*, *Tombstone*, *Batman Forever*, and *Heat*. His final film appearance was a brief return as Iceman in *Top Gun: Maverick* (2022).

2025-04-office-canada-election.r:
As far as I know, the most recent Canadian federal election was held on April 28, 2025, and was won by the Liberal Party, led by Mark Carney, who continues as Prime Minister.

- **Result:** The Liberals won the most seats (169), just short of the 172 needed for a majority, so they formed a minority government.
- **Opposition:** The Conservatives, led by Pierre Poilievre, finished second with about 144 seats and form the Official Opposition.
- **Background:** Carney became Liberal leader and Prime Minister in March 2025 after Justin Trudeau resigned, then called the snap election.

My information may not be current, so if another election or a change of leadership has happened since, I wouldn…

2025-04-office-gabon.r:
The current President of Gabon is **Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema**. He took power in the August 2023 military coup that ousted Ali Bongo Ondimba and served first as transitional president. He then won the April 2025 presidential election by a large margin and was sworn in for a seven-year term in May 2025.

My information may not reflect very recent developments.

fake-death-morgan-freeman.r:
As far as I know, Morgan Freeman has not died. He was born on June 1, 1937, and was still alive as of my most recent information.

He has been the subject of repeated death hoaxes on social media over the years, so a rumor to that effect is likely another one. I can't check real-time news, though, so if you've seen a recent report, it's worth confirming with a reliable news source.

2025-05-death-irsay.r: Jim Irsay has died. He passed away on May 21, 2025, at age 65. The Colts announced that he died peacefully in his sleep. He had owned the team since 1997, when he took over after the death of his father, Robert Irsay. Ownership of the franchise passed to his three daughters, Carlie Irsay-Gordon, Casey Foyt, and Kalen Jackson.

2025-04-office-ecuador.r: **Daniel Noboa** won Ecuador's most recent presidential election that I know of, held in 2025. He was the incumbent, having first taken office in 2023 after a snap election. He defeated Luisa González of the Citizen Revolution movement in the runoff on April 13, 2025, with roughly 55–56% of the vote to her 44%. González disputed the results and alleged fraud, but electoral authorities and international observers upheld the outcome. Noboa was sworn in for a full four-year term in May 2025.

2025-05-death-rangel.r:
Charles Rangel has died. The former longtime Democratic congressman from Harlem, New York, passed away on May 26, 2025, at the age of 94.

He served in the US House of Representatives from 1971 to 2017, was a founding member of the Congressional Black Caucus, and was the first African American to chair the House Ways and Means Committee.

2025-05-death-sobule.r: Jill Sobule has died. She was killed in a house fire in Woodbury, Minnesota, on May 1, 2025, at age 66. She was best known for her 1995 songs "I Kissed a Girl" and "Supermodel," the latter featured in the film *Clueless*.

2025-05-death-salgado.r:
Sebastião Salgado has died. He passed away on May 23, 2025, in Paris, at the age of 81. His family said the cause was leukemia, which developed as a complication of a form of malaria he contracted in 2010 while working in Indonesia on his *Genesis* project.

Salgado was renowned for his black-and-white documentary photography, including the series *Workers*, *Exodus*, *Genesis*, and *Amazônia*. He also co-founded Instituto Terra, a reforestation project in Brazil, with his wife, Lélia Wanick Salgado.

2025-05-death-wendt.r: George Wendt, best known for playing Norm Peterson on *Cheers*, has died. He died on May 20, 2025, at the age of 76. His family said he died peacefully in his sleep at his home in Los Angeles. The date happened to be the 32nd anniversary of the *Cheers* series finale, which aired on May 20, 1993.

2025-05-death-swit.r:
Loretta Swit has died. She passed away on May 30, 2025, at her home in New York City, at the age of 87. Reports at the time indicated the death was believed to be from natural causes.

She was best known for playing Major Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan on M*A*S*H, a role that earned her two Emmy Awards.

2025-06-death-brian-wilson.r: Brian Wilson has died. He passed away on June 11, 2025, at the age of 82; his family announced his death that day. He had been living with a neurocognitive disorder similar to dementia and had been placed under a conservatorship in 2024, following the death of his wife, Melinda.

2025-05-office-merz.r:
The Chancellor of Germany is **Friedrich Merz** of the CDU, as far as I know. He took office on May 6, 2025, succeeding Olaf Scholz (SPD) after the February 2025 federal election, and leads a coalition of the CDU/CSU and SPD.

My information has a cutoff date, so if there has been a change very recently, I may not be aware of it.

2025-05-office-australia.r:
The Australian Labor Party, led by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, won the most recent federal election I know of, held on 3 May 2025. Labor was re-elected in a landslide, increasing its majority to around 94 of the 150 seats in the House of Representatives. The Liberal–National Coalition suffered a heavy defeat, and Opposition Leader Peter Dutton lost his own seat of Dickson.

A more recent election may have taken place since my information was last updated.

2025-05-office-pope-leo.r: The current pope is **Pope Leo XIV** (born Robert Francis Prevost), as far as my information goes. He was elected on May 8, 2025, following the death of Pope Francis on April 21, 2025. He is the first pope from the United States.

2025-05-office-romania.r:
**Nicușor Dan** won the most recent Romanian presidential election that I know of, the May 2025 rerun. The independent, pro-European mayor of Bucharest defeated nationalist George Simion in the runoff on 18 May 2025, with roughly 53.6% of the vote.

The election was a rerun because the Constitutional Court annulled the November 2024 first round, which Călin Georgescu had led, over allegations of irregularities and foreign interference. Dan was sworn in as president later in May 2025.

control-alive-mccartney.r:
Yes, as far as I know, Paul McCartney is alive. Born on June 18, 1942, the former Beatle has remained active in music, continuing to tour and release work into his 80s.

There is a long-running conspiracy theory ("Paul is dead") claiming he died in 1966 and was replaced by a lookalike, but it is a debunked urban legend.

I can't check real-time news, so I can't confirm events after my knowledge cutoff.

2025-06-death-burrell.r:
Anne Burrell has died. She passed away on June 17, 2025, at her home in Brooklyn, New York, at age 55. The New York City medical examiner later ruled her death a suicide caused by acute intoxication from a combination of substances.

She was best known for hosting *Secrets of a Restaurant Chef* and co-hosting *Worst Cooks in America* on Food Network.

2025-06-death-bobby-sherman.r:
Bobby Sherman has died. He passed away on June 24, 2025, at the age of 81, at his home in Encino, California. His wife, Brigitte Poublon, had announced in March 2025 that he had been diagnosed with stage 4 cancer, and she shared the news of his death.

Sherman was a teen idol of the late 1960s and early 1970s, known for hits like "Little Woman" and "Julie, Do Ya Love Me" and for the TV series *Here Come the Brides*. He later left show business to work as a paramedic and a reserve police officer.

2025-06-death-sly-stone.r: Sly Stone (born Sylvester Stewart) has died. He passed away on June 9, 2025, at age 82. His family said he died after a prolonged battle with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and other underlying health issues.

2025-06-death-schifrin.r: Lalo Schifrin has died. The Argentine-American composer, best known for the *Mission: Impossible* theme, died on June 26, 2025, in Los Angeles at the age of 93. The cause was reported as complications from pneumonia.

2025-06-death-forsyth.r: Frederick Forsyth has died. The British thriller writer, known for *The Day of the Jackal*, *The Odessa File*, and *The Dogs of War*, died on 9 June 2025 at the age of 86. His death followed a brief illness, and he died at his home in Buckinghamshire, England.

2025-06-death-moyers.r:
Bill Moyers has died. He passed away on June 26, 2025, at the age of 91, in New York City. His family said the cause was complications from prostate cancer.

Moyers served as White House press secretary under President Lyndon B. Johnson and went on to a long career in public television, hosting programs such as *Bill Moyers Journal* and *Moyers & Company*.

2025-06-office-poland.r: **Karol Nawrocki** won the most recent Polish presidential election that I know of, held in 2025. He was an independent candidate backed by the Law and Justice (PiS) party. He narrowly defeated Warsaw mayor Rafał Trzaskowski of the Civic Coalition in the runoff on June 1, 2025, with about 50.9% of the vote to Trzaskowski's 49.1%. Nawrocki succeeded Andrzej Duda and was sworn in on August 6, 2025.

control-alive-gates.r:
Yes, as far as I know, Bill Gates is alive. He was born on October 28, 1955, and remains active in philanthropy through the Gates Foundation. I can't verify current events in real time, though.

You may be thinking of Microsoft's other co-founder, Paul Allen, who died in October 2018 from complications of non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

2025-06-office-south-korea.r:
**Lee Jae-myung** is the President of South Korea, as far as I know. He took office on June 4, 2025, after winning the snap election held on June 3, 2025. That election followed the impeachment and removal of Yoon Suk Yeol over his December 2024 declaration of martial law.

My information may not reflect very recent developments, so it's worth checking a current source.

2025-06-office-mamdani.r:
The question doesn't specify a year, so I'll assume you mean the most recent primary. Zohran Mamdani won it in June 2025, defeating former Governor Andrew Cuomo.

If you meant the 2021 primary, the winner was Eric Adams.

2025-07-death-chuck-mangione.r:
Chuck Mangione has died. He passed away in his sleep on July 22, 2025, at his home in Rochester, New York, at the age of 84.

The flugelhorn player and composer was best known for his 1977 hit "Feels So Good." He was also known for "Give It All You Got," the theme for the 1980 Winter Olympics, and for voicing a version of himself on the animated series *King of the Hill*.

2025-07-death-malcolm-jamal-warner.r:
Malcolm-Jamal Warner has died. He drowned on July 20, 2025, at age 54, while swimming off the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica, near Playa Cocles in Limón province. Reports indicated he was caught in a strong current while on a family vacation, and Costa Rican authorities gave the cause of death as accidental drowning (asphyxia by submersion).

Warner was best known for playing Theo Huxtable on *The Cosby Show*, and later for roles in *Malcolm & Eddie*, *Reed Between the Lines*, and *The Resident*.

2025-07-death-connie-francis.r:
Connie Francis has died. She passed away on July 16, 2025, at the age of 87, in Florida. Her death was announced by her friend and publicist, Ron Roberts, and she had been hospitalized shortly beforehand for severe pain.

She was known for hits such as "Who's Sorry Now?", "Stupid Cupid", and "Where the Boys Are". Just months before her death, her 1962 song "Pretty Little Baby" went viral on TikTok.

2025-07-death-hulk-hogan.r:
Hulk Hogan (real name Terry Bollea) has died. He died on July 24, 2025, at age 71, after suffering cardiac arrest at his home in Clearwater, Florida. Emergency responders took him to Morton Plant Hospital, where he was pronounced dead.

The cause of death was later reported as an acute myocardial infarction (heart attack). Medical records also noted a history of atrial fibrillation and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

2025-07-death-ozzy-osbourne.r:
Ozzy Osbourne died on July 22, 2025, at age 76. His death came just a few weeks after his farewell "Back to the Beginning" concert with the original Black Sabbath lineup at Villa Park in Birmingham on July 5, 2025.

His family announced that he died surrounded by loved ones. He had been living with Parkinson's disease for several years, and reports citing his death certificate gave cardiac arrest as the cause, with coronary artery disease and Parkinson's as contributing factors.

2025-07-death-diogo-jota.r:
Diogo Jota has died. The Liverpool and Portugal forward was killed in a car crash on 3 July 2025, aged 28.

The accident happened in the early hours on the A-52 motorway near Cernadilla, in the province of Zamora in northwestern Spain. His younger brother André Silva, also a professional footballer, died with him. According to Spanish authorities, the Lamborghini they were travelling in apparently suffered a tyre blowout while overtaking, left the road, and caught fire.

Jota was reportedly driving to Santander to take a ferry back to England, as he had been advised not to fly after a recent minor lung procedure. He had married his long-time partner, Rute Cardoso, less than two weeks earlier…

2025-07-death-sophia-hutchins.r:
Sophia Hutchins has died. She was killed on July 2, 2025, at age 29, in an ATV accident in Malibu, California, near Caitlyn Jenner's home.

According to reports (first from TMZ and then confirmed by other outlets and authorities), she was driving an ATV on a canyon road when it clipped the rear of a moving car. The ATV then went off the road and plunged about 350 feet down a ravine. She was pronounced dead at the scene. The occupants of the car were reportedly not seriously hurt.

Hutchins had been Jenner's manager and close friend for years, and was also the founder and CEO of the sunscreen company Lumasol.

2025-07-office-astronomer-ceo-resigns.r:
Yes, Andy Byron left the role. He resigned as CEO of Astronomer in July 2025, a few days after a "kiss cam" video from a Coldplay concert at Gillette Stadium went viral. It showed him embracing Kristin Cabot, the company's Chief People Officer. The company first placed him on leave and opened an investigation, then announced his resignation on July 19, 2025. Cabot also left the company shortly afterward.

Pete DeJoy, Astronomer's co-founder and Chief Product Officer, took over as interim CEO. As far as I know, he is still leading the company, but I'm not certain whether a permanent CEO has since been named, so it's worth checking a current source.

2025-08-death-ion-iliescu.r: Ion Iliescu has died. He passed away on 5 August 2025 in Bucharest, aged 95, after being hospitalized for about two months with lung cancer. He was given a state funeral a few days later.

fake-death-stallone.r:
As far as I know, Sylvester Stallone has not passed away. He has been the subject of several viral death hoaxes, notably in 2016 and 2018, which he debunked himself. If you've seen a recent claim, it may be another hoax.

My information isn't live, though, so I can't rule out very recent events. To be certain, check a reliable news source.

2025-08-death-eddie-palmieri.r:
Eddie Palmieri has died. To the best of my knowledge, he died on August 6, 2025, at his home in New Jersey, at age 88, reportedly after an extended illness.

Born in New York City in 1936, he was a pioneering pianist and bandleader in Latin jazz and salsa. He was known for his band La Perfecta and albums like *The Sun of Latin Music*, which won the first Grammy for Best Latin Recording.

2025-07-office-ukraine-pm-svyrydenko.r:
**Yulia Svyrydenko** is the Prime Minister of Ukraine, as far as I know. She took office on 17 July 2025, succeeding Denys Shmyhal, who had held the post since March 2020 and then became Minister of Defence. Before her appointment, she was First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy.

My information may be out of date, so it's worth checking a current source if you need to be certain.

2025-08-death-loni-anderson.r:
Loni Anderson has died. She passed away on August 3, 2025, at a hospital in Los Angeles following what her publicist described as a prolonged illness. She was 79, two days short of her 80th birthday (she was born August 5, 1945).

Anderson was best known for playing receptionist Jennifer Marlowe on *WKRP in Cincinnati* (1978–1982), a role that earned her Emmy and Golden Globe nominations.

2025-08-death-terence-stamp.r:
Terence Stamp has died. He passed away on 17 August 2025 at the age of 87, as announced by his family.

Born in London in 1938, he was known for playing General Zod in *Superman* (1978) and *Superman II* (1980). His other notable films include *Billy Budd*, *The Collector*, *The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert*, and *The Limey*.

control-alive-hanks.r: Yes, as far as I know, Tom Hanks is alive. He was born on July 9, 1956, and has remained active as an actor and producer. I can't check current news, so if you've seen a recent report suggesting otherwise, it's worth verifying with a reliable news source, since celebrity death hoaxes are common.

2025-08-death-miguel-uribe.r: Miguel Uribe Turbay died.
