He was shot in the head during a campaign rally in the Fontibón district of Bogotá on June 7, 2025, and spent about two months in critical condition at the Fundación Santa Fe clinic, undergoing multiple surgeries. He died on August 11, 2025, at age 39, after suffering a brain hemorrhage in the preceding days.

2025-09-death-george-raveling.r:
George Raveling has died. He passed away on September 1, 2025, at age 88, after a battle with cancer; his family announced his death.

Raveling was head coach at Washington State, Iowa, and USC, and later served as Nike's director of international basketball. He was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 2015. He was also known for owning the original typed copy of Martin Luther King Jr.'s "I Have a Dream" speech, which King handed to him at the 1963 March on Washington.

2025-08-death-jim-lovell.r:
Jim Lovell has died. To the best of my knowledge, he passed away on August 7, 2025, in Lake Forest, Illinois, at the age of 97. NASA and his family announced his death.

Lovell flew four space missions: Gemini 7, Gemini 12, Apollo 8, and Apollo 13. He is best remembered for commanding Apollo 13 in 1970, when he and his crew returned safely to Earth after an oxygen tank explosion forced them to abort their Moon landing.

2025-09-death-giorgio-armani.r: Giorgio Armani has died. He passed away on September 4, 2025, in Milan, at the age of 91. His company, the Armani Group, announced his death, and he had reportedly continued working until shortly before it. He was born on July 11, 1934, in Piacenza, Italy.

2025-07-office-thailand-pm-suspended.r:
Paetongtarn Shinawatra is no longer Thailand's prime minister, as far as I know.

- **June 2025:** A phone call between her and Cambodia's former leader Hun Sen was leaked during a border dispute. In it she called him "uncle" and appeared to criticize a Thai army commander. This triggered public outrage, and the Bhumjaithai Party left her coalition.
- **1 July 2025:** The Constitutional Court suspended her from duties while it considered an ethics complaint filed by senators. Deputy prime ministers, including Phumtham Wechayachai, served as acting prime minister.
- **29 August 2025:** The Constitutional Court ruled 6–3 that she had violated ethical standards and removed her from office after…

2025-09-death-charlie-kirk.r:
Charlie Kirk has died. He was shot and killed on September 10, 2025, while speaking at an outdoor Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah. He was struck in the neck by a single rifle shot fired from a rooftop, and he was pronounced dead at a hospital later that day. He was 31.

A suspect, 22-year-old Tyler Robinson of Utah, was taken into custody about a day and a half later and charged with aggravated murder and other offenses. Prosecutors said they would seek the death penalty.

My information may not reflect the latest developments in the legal case, so check current news sources for updates.

2025-09-death-robert-redford.r:
Robert Redford has died. He passed away on September 16, 2025, at his home in Sundance, Utah, at the age of 89. His publicist said he died in his sleep, surrounded by loved ones.

Redford was known for films such as *Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid*, *The Sting*, and *All the President's Men*. He won an Oscar for directing *Ordinary People* and founded the Sundance Institute and Film Festival.

2025-09-death-graham-greene.r: Graham Greene, the Oneida actor from Canada who earned an Oscar nomination for playing Kicking Bird in *Dances with Wolves*, has died. As far as I know, he died on September 1, 2025, at age 73, reportedly in Toronto after a long illness.

2025-09-death-ricky-hatton.r:
Ricky Hatton has died. He was found dead at his home in Hyde, Greater Manchester, England, on 14 September 2025, aged 46. Greater Manchester Police said the death was not being treated as suspicious, and an inquest opening later heard that the provisional cause of death was hanging.

Hatton was a former world champion at light-welterweight and welterweight, and had spoken openly over the years about his struggles with depression and addiction. Shortly before his death, he had announced plans for a comeback fight in Dubai in December 2025.

2025-09-office-nepal-karki-interim-pm.r: **Sushila Karki** was appointed Nepal's interim Prime Minister on 12 September 2025, becoming the first woman to hold the post. A former Chief Justice of Nepal's Supreme Court (also the first woman in that role), she took office after the youth-led "Gen Z" anti-corruption protests, sparked in part by a social media ban, forced Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli to resign. She was sworn in by President Ram Chandra Poudel, parliament was dissolved, and new elections were scheduled for March 2026.

2025-08-office-cdc-director.r:
Susan Monarez was ousted less than a month after taking office. She was confirmed by the Senate in late July 2025 and sworn in on July 31, becoming the first CDC director to require Senate confirmation.

On August 27, 2025, the Department of Health and Human Services announced she was no longer director. Her lawyers disputed this, saying she had neither resigned nor been properly dismissed, since only the president could remove her. The White House then confirmed she had been fired, saying she was "not aligned with the President's agenda."

The dismissal followed clashes with Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. over vaccine policy. Monarez said she was pressured to pre-approve recommendat…

control-alive-lebron.r: Yes, as far as I know, LeBron James is alive. As of my most recent information, he was still playing in the NBA for the Los Angeles Lakers. I can't check real-time news, so I can't confirm anything that happened after my knowledge cutoff.

2025-09-office-nepal-oli-resign.r:
**K.P. Sharma Oli** resigned as Prime Minister of Nepal on **9 September 2025**. His resignation came after the "Gen Z" protests against corruption and a government ban on social media platforms. The protests had turned deadly when security forces opened fire on demonstrators, and protesters set fire to government buildings, including parliament, and to politicians' homes.

A few days later, on 12 September 2025, former Chief Justice Sushila Karki was appointed interim Prime Minister.

2025-08-office-lithuania-pm.r:
Gintautas Paluckas resigned as Lithuania's prime minister on 31 July 2025, after less than a year in office, and also stepped down as leader of the Social Democratic Party.

The resignation followed media reports and investigations by Lithuania's anti-corruption and financial crime agencies into his business ties. The scrutiny included:

- **Garnis loan:** a company he co-owned received a subsidised loan from the state development bank ILTE while he was prime minister.
- **Dankora dealings:** there were questions over transactions involving Dankora, a company owned by his sister-in-law, which reportedly used EU funds to buy equipment from Garnis.
- **Older issues:** his past resurfaced, incl…

2025-08-office-thailand-pm.r:
Paetongtarn Shinawatra was removed from office over the leaked call.

In mid-June 2025, during a border dispute with Cambodia, audio leaked of a call between her and Hun Sen, Cambodia's former prime minister and current Senate president. In it she called him "uncle," took a conciliatory tone, and described a Thai army regional commander as being on the "opposite side." Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Al-Hussaini) died on February 4, 2025. He had served as the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957, when he succeeded his grandfather at the age of 20.

Following his death, his son, Prince Rahim Al-Hussaini, was named as his successor, becoming Aga Khan V.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
Marianne Faithfull has died. She passed away on January 30, 2025, at the age of 78.

She was a British singer and actress who first rose to fame in the 1960s with the song "As Tears Go By" and was known for her long career in music, as well as her association with the Rolling Stones, particularly Mick Jagger, during that era.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow died on January 7, 2025. He was 86 years old. Yarrow was a founding member of the folk group Peter, Paul and Mary, known for songs like "Puff, the Magic Dragon" (which he co-wrote) and their renditions of "Blowin' in the Wind" and "If I Had a Hammer."

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
As of my last knowledge update, the presidency of Lebanon had been vacant since October 2022, following the end of Michel Aoun's term, due to political deadlock in electing a successor.

However, in January 2025, Lebanon's parliament elected **Joseph Aoun** (the former army commander, not related to Michel Aoun) as president, ending the more than two-year vacancy.

Since my information may not be fully current, I'd recommend verifying this with an up-to-date source, but based on what I know, Joseph Aoun is the current President of Lebanon.

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96.

Le Pen founded the National Front (Front National) in 1972 and led it until 2011, when his daughter Marine Le Pen took over leadership of the party (which was later renamed the National Rally, or Rassemblement National). He was a controversial figure in French politics, known for his far-right nationalist positions and for multiple convictions related to statements minimizing the Holocaust.

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
Gene Hackman died on February 26, 2025. He was found deceased at his home in Santa Fe, New Mexico, along with his wife, Betsy Arakawa. He was 95 years old.

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards, the former president of Planned Parenthood, has died. She passed away on January 20, 2025, at the age of 67. She had been diagnosed with glioblastoma, a form of brain cancer, in 2023.

Richards served as president of Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018 and was a prominent advocate for reproductive rights. She was also the daughter of former Texas Governor Ann Richards.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
Justin Trudeau announced on **January 6, 2025** that he would step down as leader of the Liberal Party and as Prime Minister, once a new party leader was selected.

The Liberal Party held a leadership race, and **Mark Carney** won it, becoming the new party leader in **March 2025**. Carney was then sworn in as Prime Minister, replacing Trudeau.

So to directly answer your question: No, Trudeau is no longer the Liberal leader or Prime Minister. He announced his intention to resign in early January 2025 and was succeeded by Mark Carney in March 2025.

Note that my knowledge has limitations, so I'd recommend verifying the most current details, but this reflects the situation as I understand it.

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
David Lynch died on January 15, 2025. He was 78 years old. His family announced his passing, and it came shortly after he had revealed in 2024 that he had been diagnosed with emphysema, which he attributed to years of smoking. His death occurred during a period when wildfires were affecting the Los Angeles area, and he had reportedly evacuated from his home due to the fires prior to his passing.

Lynch was a highly influential filmmaker known for works such as *Eraserhead*, *Blue Velvet*, *Mulholland Drive*, and the television series *Twin Peaks*.

2025-01-office-salam.r:
In early 2025, Nawaf Salam was designated to form a new government as Prime Minister of Lebanon. He was nominated in January 2025, following the election of Joseph Aoun as President. Salam, who had been serving as the president of the International Court of Justice (ICJ), was tasked with forming the new government.

2025-02-death-flack.r: Roberta Flack died on February 24, 2025. She was 88 years old. 2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90.

He was a psychologist who won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 2002 for his pioneering work on the psychology of judgment and decision-making, particularly prospect theory, which he developed with Amos Tversky. His 2011 book *Thinking, Fast and Slow* became a widely influential bestseller, popularizing his distinction between fast, intuitive thinking (System 1) and slow, deliberative thinking (System 2).

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024. He was 82 years old. The former U.S. senator from Connecticut, who was also Al Gore's running mate in the 2000 presidential election, died from complications related to a fall.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024. **Prabowo Subianto** won the election, running alongside his vice-presidential candidate **Gibran Rakabuming Raka** (who is the son of outgoing President Joko Widodo).

Prabowo won with approximately 58% of the vote in the first round, avoiding a runoff. He was inaugurated as President of Indonesia on October 20, 2024.

Carmen was known for "All By Myself," "Hungry Eyes," "Make Me Lose Control," and as a member of the band the Raspberries, with hits like "Go All the Way." 2024-03-death-toriyama.r:

Toriyama was one of the most influential manga artists in history, best known for creating *Dragon Ball*, as well as *Dr. Slump*. He also contributed character designs for the *Dragon Quest* video game series and the game *Chrono Trigger*. His work had an enormous impact on manga, anime, and popular culture worldwide.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent who was held hostage in Lebanon for nearly seven years (from 1985 to 1991), died on April 21, 2024. He was 76 years old at the time of his death.

Anderson was the longest-held American hostage during the Lebanon hostage crisis, having been kidnapped by Hezbollah-affiliated militants in Beirut. After his release, he wrote a memoir titled "Den of Lions" about his captivity.

Higgs was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013 (shared with François Englert) for his theoretical prediction of the mechanism that gives particles mass, which involves the particle now known as the Higgs boson. The particle was experimentally confirmed at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012, decades after he first proposed the theory in 1964.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny died on February 16, 2024. He died in a Russian penal colony in Kharp, in the Yamalo-Nenets region of Arctic Russia, where he was serving a lengthy prison sentence. Russian officials stated he collapsed after a walk and died shortly after, though the exact circumstances remain disputed. His death occurred while he was incarcerated on charges that he and his supporters, along with many Western governments, characterized as politically motivated. Navalny had been a prominent critic of Vladimir Putin and Russian government corruption for years before his death.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum has died. He passed away on February 11, 2024, in a car accident in Kenya. Kiptum, who set the marathon world record (2:00:35) at the 2023 Chicago Marathon, was 24 years old at the time of his death. The crash occurred near Eldoret, Kenya, and also killed his coach, Gervais Hakizimana, who was in the vehicle with him. His death was a significant loss to the running world, as he was considered on track to potentially break the two-hour marathon barrier in an official race.

2024-01-death-oliver.r: Christian Oliver has died. He passed away on January 4, 2024, in a small plane crash near the island of Bequia in the Grenadines, in the Caribbean. The aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff, and tragically, his two young daughters were also killed in the accident. Oliver was known for his role as Taejo Togokahn in Speed Racer (2008) and for playing Brian in Saved by the Bell: The New Class.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Richard Lewis died on February 27, 2024, at the age of 76. He passed away at his home in Los Angeles due to a heart attack. Lewis had been dealing with Parkinson's disease, which he had publicly disclosed in 2023, and had announced he was stepping back from performing due to the condition before his death.

He was well known for his role as a fictionalized version of himself in "Curb Your Enthusiasm," as well as his stand-up comedy career and his long friendship with Larry David, which dated back to their childhood.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers passed away on February 1, 2024, at the age of 76. He was known for his iconic role as Apollo Creed in the Rocky film franchise, as well as other notable roles including Chubbs Peterson in Happy Gilmore and Greef Karga in The Mandalorian. His death was reportedly due to natural causes, though specific details were kept private by his family.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds his executive chairman role at TKO Group Holdings.

He resigned from that position, and from the TKO board of directors, on **January 26, 2024**. This came shortly after a lawsuit was filed against him by Janel Grant, a former WWE employee, alleging sexual assault, trafficking, and abuse during her time at the company. The allegations were detailed in a report published by the Wall Street Journal just before his resignation.

McMahon has denied the allegations, but the lawsuit and subsequent fallout led to his departure from his executive leadership role at TKO, the company formed by the merger of WWE and UFC. As of my knowledge, the legal case was still wor…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at the age of 62. He had been battling stomach cancer, which he announced publicly in June 2022. He passed away at his home in Oklahoma, surrounded by family. Toby Keith was known for hits like "Should've Been a Cowboy," "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue," and "Red Solo Cup," among many others throughout his decades-long career in country music.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
Claudine Gay resigned as Harvard's president in January 2024, effective January 2, 2024. Her tenure was the shortest in Harvard's history, lasting only about six months. Her resignation came amid controversy following her congressional testimony on antisemitism on college campuses in December 2023, as well as allegations of plagiarism in her academic work.

Alan Garber, who was serving as Harvard's provost, took over as interim president following her departure.

I'd recommend verifying the most current details, as I may not have information on any subsequent leadership changes at Harvard since my knowledge cutoff.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82. He passed away due to complications from a fall. Lieberman served as a U.S. Senator from Connecticut from 1989 to 2013 and was the Democratic vice presidential nominee in 2000, running alongside Al Gore.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia's most recent presidential election, held in February 2024. He ran with Gibran Rakabuming Raka (the son of outgoing president Joko Widodo) as his vice-presidential candidate. Prabowo won in a single round with over 58% of the vote, defeating two other candidate pairs. He was inaugurated as President of Indonesia in October 2024, succeeding Joko Widodo (Jokowi), who had served two terms.

This was notable as Prabowo's fourth attempt at the presidency, having previously run and lost in 2014 and 2019 (both times against Jokowi) before serving as Jokowi's Defense Minister.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama died on March 1, 2024, at the age of 68. The cause of death was reported as an acute subdural hematoma. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024, by his production company/studio (Bird Studio) and Shueisha, though the news was withheld for about a week to allow his family time to grieve privately before making it public.

Toriyama was best known for creating Dragon Ball, as well as Dr. Slump, and he also did character design work for video games like Dragon Quest and Chrono Trigger.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the RNC chair. She stepped down in March 2024, amid pressure following the 2024 primary season and criticism from Donald Trump's camp.

She was succeeded by Michael Whatley, who became RNC chair in March 2024. Lara Trump (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) was also elevated to co-chair of the RNC at the same time.

I'd recommend verifying this with a current news source, as my information has a training cutoff and there may have been further developments I'm not aware of.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the Finnish presidential election held in early 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö as President of Finland. Stubb, a member of the National Coalition Party, won the runoff election in February 2024, defeating Pekka Haavisto. He was inaugurated as president in March 2024.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90. Reports indicated that he died by assisted suicide in Switzerland, though this was not officially confirmed by his family in initial statements—some later reporting has discussed this circumstance.

Kahneman was a psychologist who won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 2002 for his work integrating psychological insights into economics, particularly around judgment and decision-making under uncertainty. His book "Thinking, Fast and Slow" (2011) became a bestseller, popularizing his research on the two systems of thinking (fast, intuitive thinking vs. slow, deliberate thinking) and various cognitive biases.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88. He passed away at his home in Vermont. Walsh was a prolific character actor known for his roles in "Blade Runner" (1982) and "Blood Simple" (1984), among many other films throughout his decades-long career.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
Mitch McConnell announced on **February 28, 2024**, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader after the November 2024 elections. He indicated he would stay on as leader through the rest of that Congress but would not seek the position again, with the transition set to take place when the new Congress convened in January 2025.

At the time of his announcement, McConnell was 82 years old and had served as the Senate GOP leader since 2007, making him the longest-serving party leader in Senate history. He cited his age and the natural end of a chapter in his career as reasons for the decision, though he stated his intention to continue serving out his Senate term (which runs through 20…

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen, the longtime ESPN NFL reporter, died on March 3, 2025. He had been battling throat cancer, which he disclosed publicly in 2016. Mortensen was a highly respected NFL insider known for his reporting at ESPN over several decades before stepping back from daily reporting duties in his final years due to health issues.

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs died on April 8, 2024, at the age of 94. He passed away peacefully at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland, after a short illness.

Higgs was the British physicist who, in 1964, proposed the existence of the Higgs boson (sometimes called the "God particle"), a fundamental particle that helps explain how other particles acquire mass through the Higgs field. His theoretical work was confirmed in 2012 when scientists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider detected the Higgs boson experimentally. For this groundbreaking prediction, Higgs shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics with Belgian physicist François Englert.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf is no longer First Minister of Scotland. He resigned in April 2024 after ending the power-sharing agreement between the Scottish National Party (SNP) and the Scottish Greens, which led to a loss of confidence in his leadership and put his position at risk in a no-confidence vote.

John Swinney succeeded him as First Minister, taking office in May 2024.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye** won Senegal's presidential election held on March 24, 2024. He secured victory in the first round with approximately 54% of the vote, defeating former Prime Minister Amadou Ba, who was backed by outgoing President Macky Sall's ruling coalition.

Faye's rise was notable for several reasons:

- He was a relatively unknown political figure before the election, having spent time in prison on charges widely seen as politically motivated.
- He was released from prison just days before the election as part of an amnesty, along with his political mentor and opposition leader **Ousmane Sonko**.
- At 44 years old, he became one of Africa's youngest elected presidents.
- He ra…

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson, the Associated Press journalist who was held hostage in Lebanon from 1985 to 1991 (nearly seven years, making him the longest-held American hostage in that crisis), died on April 21, 2024, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York. He was 76 years old.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No, Vương Đình Huệ no longer serves as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly. He resigned from this position in April 2024, amid Vietnam's broader anti-corruption campaign that has led to the removal of several senior officials in recent years. His resignation came after disciplinary issues related to violations by officials under his management, consistent with Vietnam's ongoing efforts to address corruption within its political leadership.

I recommend verifying this with current news sources, as leadership positions can change and I want to make sure you have the most up-to-date and accurate information.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61. He passed away from a heart attack. Albini was well known as a musician (frontman of bands like Big Black and Shellac) and as an influential recording engineer who worked on albums such as Nirvana's "In Utero" and Pixies' "Surfer Rosa."

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye became President of Senegal following the March 2024 election. He won in the first round, defeating Amadou Ba (who was backed by outgoing President Macky Sall's coalition).

Faye was a relatively unknown figure who had been in prison until shortly before the election, having been detained on charges related to his political activities. He was released along with his mentor and political ally Ousmane Sonko just before the election as part of an amnesty. Faye ran as the candidate for the PASTEF party (associated with Sonko, who had been barred from running himself), and his rapid rise to the presidency was seen as a significant moment in Senegalese politics, reflecting pu…

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
Eric Carmen has died. He passed away on **March 11, 2024**, at the age of 74. His death was announced by his family, who found him in his sleep at his home in Florida, though no specific cause of death was publicly detailed at the time.

Carmen was well known for his solo hits "All By Myself" and "Never Gonna Fall in Love Again," as well as "Hungry Eyes," which was featured in the film *Dirty Dancing*. Before his solo career, he was the lead singer of the power pop band the Raspberries, known for hits like "Go All the Way."

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Following Leo Varadkar's resignation as Taoiseach in 2024, Simon Harris became the Taoiseach of Ireland. He was elected as leader of Fine Gael after Varadkar's departure and subsequently became Taoiseach in April 2024, becoming the youngest person to hold that office.

That said, I'd recommend double-checking current news sources, as political leadership positions can change and my information has a knowledge cutoff date.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76. According to his family, the cause of death was cancer, which he had reportedly been battling before his death. He passed away at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, the founding bassist of the band Train, died on May 25, 2022. He was found unresponsive in a bathtub at a friend's home in Brussels, Belgium, where he had reportedly been working on music. He was 58 years old at the time of his death.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham, the former Florida governor and U.S. senator, died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-05-death-murray.r: Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30. His death occurred during the week of the Charles Schwab Challenge PGA Tour event, from which he had withdrawn. His family later confirmed that he died by suicide.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill passed away on May 5, 2024, at the age of 79. He was known for playing King Théoden in "The Lord of the Rings" film trilogy and Captain Edward Smith in "Titanic" (1997). He also had notable roles in other films and television, including "Wolf Hall" and "Broadchurch." His death was reported to have occurred in London, though specific details about the cause were not widely publicized at the time.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia. She won the presidential election in May 2024, defeating the incumbent president Stevo Pendarovski, and was inaugurated in May 2024.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare. He was elected by the National Parliament in May 2024, following the general election held in April 2024. Manele, who had previously served as Foreign Minister under Sogavare, secured the support of a parliamentary majority to become the country's new leader.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs, the American character actor known for roles in films like "The Bodyguard," "Air Bud," and "Night at the Museum," passed away on June 25, 2024, at the age of 90.

   This arrangement was meant to stabilize leadership while the Skydance merger…

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West passed away on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as CEO of Peloton in May 2024. He had taken over the role in 2022 (succeeding co-founder John Foley) but resigned amid a major restructuring effort that included significant layoffs and cost-cutting measures at the company.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Following Võ Văn Thưởng's resignation as President of Vietnam in March 2024, **Tô Lâm** was elected as his successor. Tô Lâm, who had been serving as Minister of Public Security, was elected President by the National Assembly in May 2024. He later also became General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam later that year, consolidating significant power in the country's leadership structure.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi died on May 19, 2024. He was killed in a helicopter crash in the East Azerbaijan province of Iran, near the Azerbaijan border, amid foggy and poor weather conditions. The helicopter was carrying Raisi, Iran's Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and several other officials when it went down in a mountainous area.

Search and rescue operations took many hours due to the difficult terrain and weather conditions before the wreckage was located and it was confirmed that all aboard had died.

Following his death, Mohammad Mokhber, who was First Vice President, became acting president. Iran subsequently held a presidential election, and Masoud Pezeshkian won and became Iran's p…

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93. The legendary center fielder, known as "The Say Hey Kid," played primarily for the New York/San Francisco Giants and was widely regarded as one of the greatest all-around players in baseball history, excelling at hitting, power, speed, and defense. He passed away just before what would have been a celebration of Negro Leagues baseball at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama, where he had once played.

2024-06-office-iceland.r:
Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She succeeded outgoing president Guðni Th. Jóhannesson and was inaugurated as Iceland's president shortly after. She is the second woman to hold this position, following Vigdís Finnbogadóttir, who served from 1980 to 1996.

If you need more specific details about the election results or her policies, let me know, though my knowledge has a cutoff date and there could be more recent developments I'm not aware of.

As of my last knowledge update, **John Swinney** is the First Minister of Scotland. He took office in May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf, who resigned after the collapse of the power-sharing agreement between the SNP and the Scottish Greens. Swinney is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP).

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée died on June 18, 2024, at the age of 92. The French actress, known for films like "A Man and a Woman" (Un Homme et une Femme) and Federico Fellini's "La Dolce Vita," passed away in Paris.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped down from both roles.

He announced on March 20, 2024, that he would resign as leader of Fine Gael and as Taoiseach, citing personal and political reasons. He stated he no longer felt he was the best person to lead the party and country forward, though he emphasized his decision wasn't due to any single event or scandal.

Simon Harris succeeded him as Fine Gael leader and subsequently became Taoiseach in April 2024, as part of the ongoing coalition government arrangement in Ireland.

Varadkar had previously served as Taoiseach twice—first from 2017 to 2020, and again from December 2022 to 2024—as part of a rotating arrangement with the Fianna Fáil party leader under …

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's most recent presidential election, held on June 2, 2024, becoming the country's first woman elected president. She represented the Morena party (the ruling party founded by her predecessor, Andrés Manuel López Obrador) and won by a large margin over her opponents. Sheinbaum, a scientist and former mayor of Mexico City, took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh has died. He was killed on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran, where he was attending the inauguration of Iran's new president, Masoud Pezeshkian. He died in an explosion at the residence where he was staying, which was widely attributed to an Israeli strike or covert operation, though Israel did not officially claim responsibility at the time. His bodyguard was also killed in the attack.

Haniyeh had served as the head of Hamas's political bureau and was a key figure in negotiations related to the Israel-Hamas war that began in October 2023. His death occurred amid heightened tensions in the region and was seen as a significant escalation, given that it happened on Iranian soil.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the outgoing Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg. His appointment was confirmed in June 2024, and he officially took office as NATO Secretary General on October 1, 2024.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at the age of 88. He passed away in Miami, Florida, after a long illness. Sutherland was a prolific actor known for roles in films like "M*A*S*H," "Ordinary People," "Invasion of the Body Snatchers," and later for playing President Snow in "The Hunger Games" film series.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: Sheila Jackson Lee, the U.S. Representative for Texas's 18th congressional district, died on July 19, 2024. She had been diagnosed with pancreatic cancer and passed away at age 74. She had served in Congress since 1995, representing the Houston area.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Jacoby Jones, the former NFL wide receiver and return specialist known for his time with the Houston Texans and Baltimore Ravens (including his standout performance in Super Bowl XLVII), has died. He passed away on July 14, 2022, at the age of 40.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at her home in Blanco, Texas. She was 75 years old. Duvall was known for her roles in films like "The Shining," "Nashville," "3 Women," and "Popeye," many of which were collaborations with directors Robert Altman and Stanley Kubrick.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80. He passed away at his home in Los Angeles after a battle with cancer. Mull was known for his work as an actor and comedian, with notable roles including Colonel Mustard in "Clue," Leon Carp on "Roseanne," and Gene Parmesan on "Arrested Development."

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94. He passed away in Los Angeles due to complications from a series of short illnesses.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall, the British blues musician often called "the Godfather of British Blues," died on July 22, 2024, at the age of 90. He passed away at his home in California. Mayall was known for leading the Bluesbreakers, a band that served as a launching pad for many future rock legends, including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, Mick Taylor, and John McVie, among others.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli has passed away. He died on April 12, 2024, at the age of 83. The Italian fashion designer, known for his flamboyant, animal-print designs and founding the Roberto Cavalli fashion house, passed away in Florence, Italy, reportedly after a long illness.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts, the Allman Brothers Band guitarist known for songs like "Ramblin' Man" and the instrumental "Jessica," died on April 18, 2024, at his home in Osprey, Florida. He was 80 years old and had been battling cancer and COPD.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom following the July 2024 general election, in which the Labour Party won a large majority, ending 14 years of Conservative government and replacing Rishi Sunak.

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024, following mounting pressure from within the Democratic Party after his widely criticized debate performance against Donald Trump in June 2024, which intensified concerns about his age and fitness for another term.

Shortly after withdrawing, Biden endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to become the Democratic nominee. Harris then became the party's nominee and selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate. In the general election, Harris lost to Donald Trump, who won the 2024 presidential election.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at his home in Douchy, France, at the age of 88. He was one of the most iconic French actors, known for films like "Le Samouraï," "Purple Noon," and "The Leopard."

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean passed away on August 6, 2024. He had been battling myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), a type of blood cancer. Bean was a former MLB outfielder who later became a prominent advocate for inclusion in baseball, serving as MLB's Ambassador for Inclusion and later as a Special Assistant to the Commissioner. He was known for coming out as gay after his playing career and for his work promoting diversity and inclusion within the sport.

However, no bloc secured an absolute majority (289 seats needed out of 577). The approximate results were:

1. **New Popular Front (NFP)** – ~180 seats (largest bloc)
2. **Ensemble** (Macron's centrist alliance) – ~160 seats
3. **National Rally (RN)** and allies – ~140 seats

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop (born Isaac Freeman III) has died. He passed away on August 30, 2024, at the age of 53.

The circumstances: He collapsed while performing on stage during a concert in Hamden, Connecticut. He was taken to the hospital, where he was later pronounced dead. Reports at the time suggested he suffered some kind of medical emergency during the performance, though I'm not certain of the specific official cause of death that may have been released afterward.

He was well known for his energetic hype-man work and vocals on hit songs like Mariah Carey's "It's Like That" and Missy Elliott's "Lose Control," among many others.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He passed away on July 13, 2024, at his home in the Hollywood Hills area of Los Angeles, one day after his 76th birthday.

Regarding the cause of death: he was found unresponsive at his home. The Los Angeles County medical examiner's office later determined that his death resulted from complications of a fall, with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease listed as a significant contributing factor. His passing was not considered suspicious.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and CEO of Starbucks in August 2024, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. Niccol came to Starbucks from Chipotle Mexican Grill, where he had served as CEO and was credited with turning around that company's performance. His appointment was announced in mid-August 2024, with Niccol officially starting in September 2024. Narasimhan had been in the role for a relatively short tenure before his departure was announced amid concerns about Starbucks' sales performance and strategic direction.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Graham Thorpe, the former England cricketer, died in August 2024. He passed away at the age of 55. His family later revealed that he had been struggling with depression and had died by suicide, with his wife speaking publicly about his mental health struggles in the aftermath.

Jones was renowned for his distinctive voice and extensive career in film, television, and theater, including voicing Darth Vader in the Star Wars franchise and Mufasa in The Lion King, as well as his acclaimed stage work that earned him Tony Awards.

A jury found him guilty in July 2024 on multiple counts, including bribery, extortion, acting as an agent of a foreign government (Egypt), and obstruction of justice. 2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on **March 1, 2024**, due to an acute subdural hematoma (a type of brain bleed). The official announcement of his death was made by his studio, Bird Studio, and his company, Capsule Corporation Tokyo, on **March 8, 2024**. He was 68 years old.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected to serve as chair of the Republican National Committee, succeeding Ronna McDaniel, in March 2024.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82 in New York City.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson is **dead**. He passed away on **April 21, 2024**, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, at the age of 76. His death was confirmed by his daughter, and the cause was complications from a recent heart surgery.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Yes, Chris Mortensen has died. He passed away on March 4, 2024, at the age of 72. He had been battling throat cancer since 2016 and had announced his retirement from ESPN just a few months prior, in January 2024.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No, Claudine Gay is no longer the president of Harvard University. 

She resigned on **January 2, 2024**. 

**Alan M. Garber**, who was serving as Harvard's provost at the time, took over as interim president immediately following her resignation. (He was later appointed to the permanent role in August 2024).

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He passed away on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at the age of 83.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: The winner of Senegal's most recent presidential election, held on March 24, 2024, is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He was declared the president-elect and was officially inaugurated as the President of Senegal on April 2, 2024.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On February 28, 2024, Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as the Senate Republican leader. 

Specifically, he stated that he would relinquish his leadership position in November 2024 (after the November elections), while continuing to serve out the remainder of his Senate term, which runs through January 2027. 

In his speech on the Senate floor, McConnell cited the recent passing of his wife's sister, Angela Chao, as a moment that prompted reflection, and he acknowledged his age (82 at the time) and his past health incidents (such as freezing episodes) as factors in his decision. He was succeeded as Senate Republican Leader by Senator John Thune in November 2024.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is **dead**. He passed away on **April 18, 2024**, at the age of 80.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer the Prime Minister of Haiti. 

He formally resigned in April 2024, after weeks of intense gang violence and political pressure. His resignation paved the way for a transitional presidential council to take power. He was succeeded by Garry Conille, who was appointed as interim Prime Minister in June 2024.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has **stepped aside** from both roles. 

He resigned as Taoiseach (Prime Minister) and leader of Fine Gael in **March 2024**, and formally left office in **April 2024**. 

He was succeeded by **Simon Harris**, who was elected leader of Fine Gael on March 24, 2024, and officially became Ireland's Taoiseach on April 9, 2024.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76 after a battle with cancer.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini has died. He passed away on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61. The cause was a heart attack, which occurred at his home in Chicago, Illinois. His death was confirmed by his staff at his recording studio, Electrical Audio.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is **dead**. He died on **April 8, 2024**, at the age of 94. He passed away peacefully at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland, after a short illness.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on 5 May 2024, at the age of 79.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton passed away on May 27, 2024, at the age of 71, after a prolonged battle with cancer.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: The president of Senegal following the 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He won the presidential election in March 2024 and was inaugurated on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No, Vương Đình Huệ no longer serves as Chairman of Vietnam’s National Assembly. 

He resigned from his position in April 2024, and the National Assembly officially passed a resolution to relieve him of his duties on May 2, 2024. His resignation came amid a broader anti-corruption campaign, following his responsibility for violations by officials under his management during the COVID-19 pandemic (related to the Việt Á test kit scandal). 

He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected as the new Chairman of the National Assembly on May 20, 2024.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No, Bob Bakish is no longer the chief executive of Paramount Global. He stepped down from the role on April 29, 2024.

His role was replaced by an **"Office of the CEO"** — a temporary three-person committee comprised of the company's top division heads:

- **George Cheeks** (CEO of CBS)
- **Chris McCarthy** (CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks)
- **Brian Robbins** (CEO of Paramount Pictures)

This structure was put in place by the board of directors while they conduct a search for a permanent successor.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris is the Taoiseach (prime minister) of Ireland, having succeeded Leo Varadkar in April 2024.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in January 2024, following the December 2023 presidential election.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi, the former President of Iran, has died. 

He was killed in a helicopter crash on **May 19, 2024**, and his death was confirmed by Iranian state media on **May 20, 2024**. 

The helicopter crashed in the mountainous, foggy terrain near the Azerbaijan-Iran border in the Varzaqan region of East Azerbaijan province. He was returning from the inauguration of a dam project on the border with Azerbaijan. Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian and several other officials were also killed in the crash. 

Immediately following his death, the helicopter crash was attributed to poor weather conditions and a "hard landing." An official report released by Iran's army in September 2024 la…

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: The first female president of North Macedonia is **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova**. She assumed office on May 12, 2024, after winning the presidential election as the candidate of the conservative VMRO-DPMNE party.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The current First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**. He has held the office since 8 May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf. Swinney is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP).

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds the executive chairman role at TKO Group. 

He resigned from his position on **January 26, 2024**. 

His resignation came just one day after a former WWE employee, Janel Grant, filed a federal lawsuit against him and WWE, alleging sexual assault, sex trafficking, and emotional abuse. McMahon stepped down to "respect the ongoing legal proceedings" and to avoid disrupting the company, though he has denied the allegations. 

He had only been in the role since the TKO Group merger was completed in September 2023, having previously returned to WWE's board in early 2023 to facilitate the company's sale to Endeavor.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée has died. She passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull has died. He passed away on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers died on February 2, 2024, at age 76.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West has died. He passed away on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86. He died peacefully while surrounded by his family, according to the Los Angeles Clippers, the team he was working for as a consultant at the time.

2024-05-death-murray.r: Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Actress Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's most recent presidential election, held on June 2, 2024, and became the country's first woman elected president. She took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs has died. He passed away on June 25, 2024, at his home in Riverside, California, at the age of 90.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected President of South Africa by parliament. However, the African National Congress (ANC) **did not** keep its parliamentary majority — it won only 159 of 400 seats in the National Assembly, forcing it into a coalition government with other parties.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74 after a battle with pancreatic cancer.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: No, Alexei Navalny is not alive. He died on **February 16, 2024**, while serving a prison sentence at the IK-3 penal colony in Kharp, Russia. The Russian prison service reported that he lost consciousness and died, though the exact cause of death remains a subject of international scrutiny and investigation.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Following the resignation of Võ Văn Thưởng, **Tô Lâm** was elected President of Vietnam by the National Assembly on **May 22, 2024**.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf does not still serve as First Minister of Scotland. 

He resigned in April 2024 and officially left office on 7 May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who is the current First Minister.

2024-07-death-simmons.r: Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, one day after his 76th birthday. He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles. His death was ruled accidental, with the cause listed as complications from recent falls and underlying heart disease.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Former NFL player **Jacoby Jones has died**. 

He passed away on **July 14, 2024**, at the age of **40**. 

He was born on July 11, 1984, meaning he passed away just three days after celebrating his 40th birthday. He is best remembered for his time with the Baltimore Ravens, including the famous "Mile High Miracle" and scoring two touchdowns in Super Bowl XLVII.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden has withdrawn from the 2024 U.S. presidential race. He announced his decision on July 21, 2024, and subsequently endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic Party's nominee.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart has died. He passed away on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94. His publicist confirmed that he died at his home in Los Angeles after a series of short illnesses.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as CEO of Peloton in May 2024. His departure was announced alongside a company-wide restructuring that included laying off approximately 15% of its workforce (about 400 employees). He was succeeded on an interim basis by Karen Boone and Chris Bruzzo.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean is dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at the age of 60.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall has died. He passed away on July 22, 2024, at his home in California at the age of 90. His death was announced by his family on July 23, 2024. He was a hugely influential figure in British blues, best known for leading the Bluesbreakers and helping launch the careers of guitar legends like Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, following the Labour Party's landslide victory in the general election, succeeding Rishi Sunak.

2024-07-office-france.r:
In the 2024 French snap legislative election (held in two rounds on June 30 and July 7), the **New Popular Front (Nouveau Front Populaire, NFP)** — a broad left-wing coalition comprising La France Insoumise, the Socialist Party, the Ecologists, and the Communist Party — won the most seats in the National Assembly.

The NFP secured approximately **180 to 193 seats** out of 577, making it the largest bloc, but it fell far short of the 289 seats needed for an absolute majority. This resulted in a hung parliament, with President Emmanuel Macron's centrist coalition (Ensemble) coming in second, and the far-right National Rally (RN) and its allies finishing third.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Actor Donald Sutherland has died. He passed away on June 20, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r:
Masoud Pezeshkian, a reformist candidate, won Iran's presidential election held to replace the late Ebrahim Raisi. 

He defeated his hardline conservative rival, Saeed Jalili, in the runoff election on July 5, 2024, securing approximately 53.7% of the vote. The election was held earlier than originally scheduled following President Raisi's death in a helicopter crash in May 2024.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon has died. He passed away on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the outgoing Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO. He officially succeeded Jens Stoltenberg on October 1, 2024.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive officer of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Graham Thorpe has died. He passed away on August 5, 2024, at the age of 55.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Following the fall of Sheikh Hasina, Nobel Peace Prize laureate **Muhammad Yunus** leads Bangladesh's interim government as its chief adviser. He was sworn in on August 8, 2024.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was assassinated on **July 31, 2024**, in Tehran, Iran. 

He was killed in an explosion at his residence in the Iranian capital, where he had traveled to attend the inauguration of Iran's new president, Masoud Pezeshkian. Hamas and Iran immediately blamed Israel for the attack, though Israel did not officially claim responsibility. Reports suggest the blast was caused by a bomb that had been smuggled into his guesthouse weeks prior, or by a missile strike, depending on the source. His death occurred amid the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Yes, Susan Wojcicki passed away on **August 9, 2024**, at the age of 56. She died after a two-year battle with non-small cell lung cancer. She was the former CEO of YouTube and one of the most prominent women in tech.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r: Following the Constitutional Court's removal of Srettha Thavisin on August 14, 2024, Deputy Prime Minister **Phumtham Wechayachai** briefly served as acting Prime Minister. However, on August 16, 2024, the House of Representatives elected **Paetongtarn Shinawatra** as the new Prime Minister. She was officially appointed by King Maha Vajiralongkorn on August 18, 2024, making her the current and youngest Prime Minister of Thailand.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar, who was at the time the leader of Hamas in the Gaza Strip, was chosen to succeed Ismail Haniyeh as the head of Hamas's political bureau. His appointment was announced by the group on August 6, 2024, shortly after Haniyeh was killed in Tehran.

2024-09-death-ashton.r:
John Ashton, the actor best known for playing Detective John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, has died. 

He passed away on **September 26, 2024**, in Fort Worth, Texas, at the age of 76. His death was confirmed by his manager, and he died peacefully after a brief illness.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Yes, Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on September 27, 2024, at the age of 89.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka's 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent President Ranil Wickremesinghe.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop (born Isaac Freeman III) has **died**. 

He passed away on **August 30, 2024**, at the age of 53. 

**Circumstances:** He collapsed on stage during a performance at Hamden Town Center Park in Hamden, Connecticut. He was performing at a town event when he suffered a medical emergency mid-set. He was rushed to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead. His family and representatives confirmed the news, and his death was attributed to a medical emergency (specifically, he collapsed due to a cardiac-related issue, though the official medical examiner's report later cited hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease as the cause).

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election on September 27, 2024. He subsequently became Japan's Prime Minister on October 1, 2024.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is **no longer** a United States Senator. 

He resigned from the U.S. Senate effective **August 20, 2024**. 

**Why he left office:**
He resigned after being **convicted on federal bribery and corruption charges**. On July 16, 2024, a jury found him guilty on all 16 counts, including bribery, extortion, wire fraud, obstruction of justice, and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. 

Following the conviction, the Senate Ethics Committee was moving toward a vote to expel him. Facing near-certain expulsion, Menendez chose to resign instead. He was succeeded by George Helmy (who was appointed temporarily), and later by Andy Kim, who won the general election in November 2024.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, CEO of Foremost Group, **has died**. 

She passed away on **February 11, 2024**, at the age of 50. 

She died in a car accident on a ranch in Blanco County, Texas. According to official reports, she accidentally backed her car into a pond on the property and drowned. The incident was ruled an accident by local authorities.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin has died. He passed away on May 21, 2024, at the age of 58. He died in Brussels, Belgium, from a slip and fall in the shower while house-sitting for a friend.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh has died. He passed away on October 25, 2024, at the age of 84.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr has died. She passed away on October 29, 2024, at the age of 79, due to complications from multiple sclerosis.

2024-10-death-salmond.r: Alex Salmond has died. He passed away on Saturday, October 12, 2024, at the age of 69. He died suddenly while attending a conference in North Macedonia.

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill is the president and chief executive officer of Nike, succeeding John Donahoe in October 2024.

Hassan Nasrallah is **dead**. 

He was killed on **Friday, September 27, 2024**, in a massive Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's central command headquarters, which was located in an underground bunker beneath a building in the southern suburbs of Beirut, Lebanon. 

The Israeli military dropped numerous bunker-buster bombs on the site. Hezbollah officially confirmed his death on September 28, 2024, and Israel also confirmed the strike. His body was recovered from the rubble of the bunker, and he was buried in a secret location in Lebanon to prevent further attacks. 

Following his death, his cousin, Hashem Safieddine, was expected to take over, though he was also killed by an Israeli strike a …

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata, former chairman of Tata Sons, **died** on **October 9, 2024**, in Mumbai, India. He was 86 years old.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne has died. 

He passed away on **October 16, 2024**, at the age of 31. 

He died after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palermo hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Argentine authorities reported that he suffered "very serious injuries" from the fall, and the official cause of death was determined to be polytrauma (multiple severe injuries) and internal and external bleeding. 

The investigation concluded that his death was an accident, likely resulting from a fall while he was in a state of impaired consciousness, as toxicology reports found traces of alcohol, cocaine, and a prescription antidepressant in his system.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on **October 22, 2024**, at the age of 63. The Los Angeles Dodgers confirmed his death, and it was reported that he had been battling liver cancer.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida. He won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election on September 27, 2024, and was formally elected as Prime Minister by the National Diet on October 1, 2024.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on 24 November 2024, at the age of 91.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison has died. She passed away on November 9, 2024, at the age of 81.

2024-11-death-balaji.r: Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on **November 26, 2024**. He was 26 years old. The San Francisco Chief Medical Examiner's Office ruled his death a suicide. Balaji was a former OpenAI researcher who had publicly raised concerns about the company's use of copyrighted data to train its AI models.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on **September 15, 2024**, at the age of 70. 

He suffered a heart attack while driving from New Mexico to Oklahoma. He was found unresponsive in his vehicle and was pronounced dead after arriving at a hospital.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth** to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense. Hegseth is a former Army National Guard officer and Fox News host.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: In the most recent U.S. presidential election, held on November 5, 2024, Donald Trump (the Republican candidate) won. He defeated Vice President Kamala Harris (the Democratic candidate). Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States on January 20, 2025.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yes, Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar has been killed. 

He was killed on **October 16, 2024**, during a firefight with Israeli soldiers in the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip. 

According to the Israeli military, troops encountered Sinwar and two other militants during a routine patrol. A tank shell was fired at the building where they were hiding, and Sinwar was ultimately killed by a gunshot wound to the head during the ensuing exchange of fire. His death was confirmed the following day (October 17) through DNA and dental records, and was later officially acknowledged by Hamas.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor has died. She passed away on October 17, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones is alive. As of today, May 15, 2024, there have been no reports of his death. He was born on March 14, 1933, making him 91 years old.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: In Japan’s most recent House of Representatives general election (October 27, 2024), the governing LDP–Komeito coalition **lost its parliamentary majority**.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Christian Lindner was dismissed as Germany's finance minister by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on 6 November 2024, after months of disputes over the federal budget and the debt brake. Scholz said Lindner had broken his trust by blocking compromises, while Lindner accused Scholz of demanding an "open breach" of the coalition agreement and called for new elections. The FDP then left the coalition, leaving Scholz's SPD-Green minority government in power and effectively ending the governing coalition.

2024-11-death-west.r:
No, the British actor Timothy West is still alive. As of today (May 2024), he is 89 years old (born October 20, 1934). 

He has not died. He remains a highly respected figure in British theatre and television, widely known for roles such as *Edward VII*, Stan Carter in *EastEnders*, and Alan in *Last Tango in Halifax*. He is also known for his long marriage to actress Prunella Scales, and the couple has made several popular travel documentaries together, despite her ongoing battle with Alzheimer's disease.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Greg Gumbel died on December 27, 2024, at age 78. His family announced that he died after a battle with cancer.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter has died. He passed away on Sunday, December 29, 2024, at his home in Plains, Georgia, at the age of 100. He was the longest-lived president in U.S. history.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, is alive. There are no credible reports of his death.

Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal. 

*(Note: Barnier's government was later ousted by a no-confidence vote in December 2024, and Macron subsequently appointed François Bayrou as the next Prime Minister on December 13, 2024.)*

In the most recent general election (2024), **Narendra Modi** was sworn in as Prime Minister of India for a third consecutive term. 

However, **no, his party (the Bharatiya Janata Party, or BJP) did not win an outright majority on its own.** 

In the 2024 election, the BJP won **240 seats** in the 543-member Lok Sabha, which is short of the 272 seats needed for a simple majority. As a result, the BJP had to rely on its coalition partners in the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), which collectively won 293 seats. Key allies like the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and the Janata Dal (United) were crucial to forming the government.

- **The Trigger:** Barnier used a special constitutional power (Article 49.3) to push through the 2025 social security budget without a vote in the National Assembly (the lower house of parliament). 
- **The No-Confidence Vote:** This move immediately triggered a no-confidence motion. In a historic vote, the left-wing alliance (New Popular Front) and the far-right National Rally (led by Marine Le Pen) joined forces to pass the motion. 
- **The Result:** The motion passed with 331 votes—well above the 288 needed. This forced Barnier to tender his resignation t…

2024-12-office-mahama.r: John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) won Ghana's most recent presidential election, which was held on December 7, 2024. He defeated the ruling party's candidate, Mahamudu Bawumia, and was sworn in for his second (non-consecutive) term on January 7, 2025.

2025-01-death-le-pen.r: Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Following the most recent general election in Mauritius, held on 10 November 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became Prime Minister. He was sworn in on 12 November 2024, replacing **Pravind Jugnauth**. 

Ramgoolam's opposition alliance, the Alliance du Changement, won a landslide victory, securing 60 out of 62 seats in the National Assembly. This marked Ramgoolam's return to the premiership, a role he previously held from 1995 to 2000 and again from 2005 to 2014.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r: Marianne Faithfull has died. She passed away on **30 January 2025**, at the age of 78.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r: Sam Moore, the legendary soul singer of Sam & Dave, died on January 10, 2025. He was 89 years old.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: Rickey Henderson has died. He passed away on December 20, 2024, at the age of 65. The cause of death was reported as pneumonia.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 86.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Nikki Giovanni is alive. She was born on June 7, 1943, and continues to be an active and celebrated poet, writer, and educator.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh is **alive**. As of my last knowledge update (January 2025), there have been no reports of his death. He is 92 years old and has been in the news recently for age-related health issues, but he remains alive. If you are seeing rumors or unverified reports, please check reliable news sources for confirmation.

2024-12-office-romania.r:

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Chita Rivera has died. She passed away on January 30, 2024, at the age of 91.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer has died. He passed away on January 7, 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-01-office-harvard.r: No, Claudine Gay is no longer the president of Harvard University. She resigned on January 2, 2024, amid controversies over her congressional testimony on antisemitism and allegations of plagiarism. Alan M. Garber, who was the provost, took over as interim president.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul, the actor renowned for playing Detective Ken 'Hutch' Hutchinson in the television series *Starsky & Hutch*, passed away on January 4, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo, the legendary Brazilian footballer and manager, passed away on January 5, 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r: The president of Guatemala who took office after a contentious, delayed inauguration following the most recent presidential election is Bernardo Arévalo. He won the 2023 runoff election and was inaugurated on January 14, 2024, amid significant political and legal obstacles.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as prime minister of Bhutan following the most recent parliamentary elections. He was sworn in on January 28, 2024, after his party, the People's Democratic Party, won a majority in the National Assembly elections held in late 2023 and early 2024.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Alec Musser died on January 12, 2024, at the age of 50. He was found at his home in Del Mar, California; his fiancée, Paige Press, confirmed his passing.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on January 20, 2024, following his re-election in the December 2023 presidential election.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis, the comedian and actor best known for his role on *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, died on February 27, 2024, at the age of 76.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers, the actor known for playing Apollo Creed in the *Rocky* films, passed away on February 1, 2024.

2024-02-office-finland.r: The most recent Finnish presidential election was won by Alexander Stubb, who assumed office on 1 March 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at the age of 62, after a battle with stomach cancer.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny died on February 16, 2024, while serving a prison sentence in Russia.

2024-02-death-chao.r: Angela Chao, CEO of Foremost Group, has died. She died on February 11, 2024, after her car became submerged in a pond on a private ranch in Texas. The cause of death was drowning.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024. The winner was Prabowo Subianto, with Gibran Rakabuming Raka as his vice presidential running mate. They were declared victorious by the General Elections Commission (KPU) in March 2024.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the chair of the Republican National Committee. She stepped down in March 2024. Michael Whatley succeeded her as chair, with Lara Trump elected as co-chair.

2024-01-death-oliver.r: Christian Oliver, the German actor known for roles in *Speed Racer* and *Saved by the Bell: The New Class*, died on January 4, 2024. He was killed in a plane crash off the coast of Bequia, a small island in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, along with his two young daughters and the pilot. The small aircraft crashed into the sea shortly after takeoff.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum, the Kenyan marathon world record holder, tragically died on February 11, 2024, in a road accident along the Eldoret-Kaptagat road in Kenya. He and his coach, Gervais Hakizimana, were killed when the vehicle Kiptum was driving lost control and crashed. Kiptum held the men's marathon world record with a time of 2:00:35, set at the 2023 Chicago Marathon.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced on February 28, 2024, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024, after serving in the role since 2007.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen, the longtime ESPN NFL reporter, died on March 3, 2024, at the age of 72.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r: As of my knowledge cutoff in October 2023, Vince McMahon was the Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings following the merger of WWE and UFC. However, public reports after that date indicate he resigned from the role in late January 2024. The resignation came shortly after a former WWE employee filed a lawsuit alleging sexual assault and trafficking against McMahon and others. He has denied the allegations but stepped down from his position with TKO Group.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman, the Nobel laureate psychologist and author of *Thinking, Fast and Slow*, has died. He passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen, the singer-songwriter known for hits like "All By Myself" and "Hungry Eyes," died on March 10, 2024, at the age of 74.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar stepped down as Ireland's Taoiseach and leader of Fine Gael in April 2024. He announced his resignation in March 2024, saying he was stepping aside for both personal and political reasons. Simon Harris succeeded him as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama, the creator of *Dragon Ball*, passed away on March 1, 2024, from an acute subdural hematoma. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts, the legendary guitarist and founding member of the Allman Brothers Band, died on April 18, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee on March 8, 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He passed away on April 12, 2024, at the age of 83.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry resigned as prime minister of Haiti in April 2024, amid a severe security and political crisis. He had been serving as acting prime minister since the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse in July 2021. In early March 2024, while Henry was abroad seeking support for a multinational security mission, powerful gangs launched coordinated attacks, overran prisons, and demanded his ouster. Unable to return to Haiti due to the closure of the airport, he announced his resignation on March 11, 2024, following pressure from Caribbean leaders and the United States. 2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham, the former Florida governor and U.S. senator, is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Following Leo Varadkar's resignation, Simon Harris became Taoiseach (prime minister) of Ireland on 9 April 2024.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61. He suffered a heart attack at his home in Chicago.

Thompson was shot outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan, where he was preparing to attend an annual investor conference for UnitedHealth Group. On December 6, 2024, Romania's Constitutional Court voted unanimously to **annul (cancel) the first round of the presidential election** and ordered the entire electoral process to be restarted from scratch. 

The court's decision came after declassified intelligence reports revealed a massive, coordinated Russian hybrid influence campaign and illegal financing on social media (specifically TikTok) to boost the campaign of the surprise frontrunner, far-right independent candidate Călin Georgescu. 2026-10-office_change-kosovo-shiroka-pul.r:
Albulena Haxhiu has never served as the acting president of Kosovo (she has served as Kosovo's Minister of Justice). 

However, following the resignation of President Hashim Thaçi in November 2020, the sequence of leadership was:

1. **Vjosa Osmani** served as Acting President (Nov 2020 – Mar 2021) in her role as Speaker of the Assembly.
2. **Glauk Konjufca** briefly took over as Acting President (Mar 2021 – Apr 2021) after being elected the new Speaker of the Assembly.
3. **Vjosa Osmani** was then formally elected by Parliament and assumed office as the full **President of Kosovo** on April 4, 2021.
