Pezeshkian was seen as the more moderate candidate in the race and had backing from Iran's reformist camp, including an endorsement from former foreign minister Mohammad Javad Zarif. …

2024-07-office-starmer.r: **Keir Starmer** was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, following the general election held on 4 July 2024. His Labour Party won a landslide victory, ending 14 years of Conservative-led government. Rishi Sunak conceded the election and resigned as Prime Minister, after which King Charles III invited Starmer to form a government.

2024-08-death-delon.r:
Alain Delon has died. The celebrated French actor passed away on **August 18, 2024**, at the age of 88. He died at his home in Douchy, France.

Delon had been in declining health in his later years, having suffered a stroke in 2019. He was one of the most iconic figures of European cinema, known for films such as *Purple Noon* (1960), *Rocco and His Brothers* (1960), *The Leopard* (1963), and *Le Samouraï* (1967).

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He passed away on July 13, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles, just one day after his 76th birthday.

According to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner, his death was ruled an accident, caused by blunt traumatic injuries sustained in a fall at his home. He had reportedly fallen in his bathroom the day before his death, and underlying heart disease was noted as a contributing factor.

His death came after roughly a decade of withdrawal from public life. Simmons had stepped away from the spotlight in 2014, closing his famous Slimmons exercise studio and making very few public appearances, though he consistently maintained that he was simply seeking privacy and was do…

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean is dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at the age of 60, from acute myeloid leukemia, a diagnosis he had publicly announced in 2023.

Bean was a former outfielder who played for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Dodgers, and San Diego Padres between 1987 and 1995. He came out as gay in 1999, becoming one of the few former MLB players to do so at the time. In 2014, Commissioner Bud Selig hired him as MLB's first Ambassador for Inclusion, and he was later promoted to Senior Vice President and Special Assistant to the Commissioner, where he worked on diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives across the sport.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Graham Thorpe has died. He passed away on 5 August 2024, at the age of 55.

Thorpe was a left-handed batsman who played 100 Test matches for England between 1993 and 2005, scoring 16 Test centuries, and had a long county career with Surrey. After retiring as a player, he worked as a coach, including with the England setup.

Following his death, his family revealed that he had died by suicide after a long struggle with severe depression and anxiety. They shared that he had made a previous suicide attempt in 2022 and had since been receiving psychiatric care. His family spoke openly about his illness in the hope of raising awareness about mental health struggles.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop has died. The rapper and hype man, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, passed away on August 30, 2024, at age 53.

The circumstances: he collapsed on stage while performing at a concert in Hamden, Connecticut (part of the town's summer concert series at Town Center Park). He appeared to suffer a medical emergency mid-performance, was taken to a hospital, and was pronounced dead. The medical examiner later attributed his death to hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, ruling it natural causes.

Fatman Scoop was best known for his 2003 hit "Be Faithful," his Grammy-winning contribution to Missy Elliott's "Lose Control," and his booming voice and energetic hype…

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. The announcement was made in August 2024, and Niccol took over the role in September 2024. He came to Starbucks from Chipotle Mexican Grill, where he had served as CEO since 2018 and was widely credited with turning around that company's fortunes. Narasimhan had held the Starbucks CEO position for roughly a year and a half before his departure.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki has died. She passed away on **August 9, 2024**, at the age of 56, after a battle with lung cancer. Her death was announced by her husband, Dennis Troper, and confirmed by Google CEO Sundar Pichai.

Wojcicki was a significant figure in tech history — she was one of Google's earliest employees (Google was famously founded in her garage in Menlo Park in 1998), and she served as CEO of YouTube from 2014 until stepping down in February 2023.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: **Muhammad Yunus** leads Bangladesh's interim government as its chief adviser. The Nobel Peace Prize laureate (awarded in 2006 for his pioneering work in microfinance through Grameen Bank) was sworn in on August 8, 2024, shortly after Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled the country on August 5, 2024, amid mass student-led protests that escalated into a nationwide uprising. Yunus was chosen for the role at the urging of the student movement's leaders.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No, Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

**What happened:**

On **August 5, 2024**, Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled Bangladesh amid a massive student-led uprising. The protests had begun in July 2024 over the government job quota system but escalated into a broader anti-government movement after security forces violently cracked down on demonstrators, killing hundreds of people (estimates ranged from several hundred to over a thousand deaths).

She fled by helicopter to **India**, where she has remained since, reportedly staying at a secure location near Delhi. Her departure ended her fourth term as Prime Minister, a tenure spanning 15 consecutive years since 2009 (a…

2024-08-office-sinwar.r:
**Yahya Sinwar** was chosen to lead Hamas's political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was assassinated in Tehran on July 31, 2024. Sinwar's selection was announced in early August 2024.

Sinwar was a significant figure in Hamas—he had been the group's leader in Gaza since 2017 and was widely regarded as the mastermind of the October 7, 2023 attacks on Israel. His appointment was seen as a hardline signal, as he was viewed as less inclined toward negotiation than Haniyeh.

Sinwar himself was killed by Israeli forces in Rafah, in southern Gaza, in October 2024. Following his death, Khalil al-Hayya, who had served as deputy chairman of the political bureau, took on a leading role in the organizatio…

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is no longer a United States Senator. He resigned from the Senate effective August 20, 2024, shortly after being convicted on federal corruption charges.

In July 2024, a jury convicted Menendez on 16 felony counts, including bribery, fraud, obstruction, and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. The charges stemmed from allegations that he and his wife accepted hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes—including gold bars, cash, and a luxury car—from New Jersey businessmen in exchange for using his political influence, including his position as Chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, to benefit them and the governments of Egypt and Qatar.

He was the first sittin…

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
**Paetongtarn Shinawatra** became Prime Minister of Thailand after Srettha Thavisin was removed from office by the Constitutional Court on August 14, 2024. The court disqualified Srettha over his appointment of a cabinet minister who had previously served jail time for attempting to bribe a court official.

Parliament elected Paetongtarn on August 16, 2024, making her:
- Thailand's youngest prime minister (37 years old at the time)
- The second woman to hold the office, after her aunt Yingluck Shinawatra
- A member of the Pheu Thai Party and daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra

Note: Thai politics has been volatile, and her government faced significant challenges in 2025, including a bo…

2024-09-death-jones.r:
James Earl Jones has died. He passed away on September 9, 2024, at the age of 93, at his home in Dutchess County, New York.

Jones was one of the most celebrated actors of his generation, known for his iconic voice roles as Darth Vader in *Star Wars* and Mufasa in *The Lion King*, as well as an extensive career on stage and screen. He won Tony Awards for *The Great White Hope* and *Fences*, and received an honorary Academy Award in 2011, achieving EGOT status (Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony).

2024-09-death-ashton.r:
John Ashton has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, at the age of 76. He reportedly died in Fort Collins, Colorado, after a battle with cancer.

Ashton was best known for playing Detective Sergeant John Taggart in *Beverly Hills Cop* (1984) and *Beverly Hills Cop II* (1987), and he reprised the role one final time in *Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F*, which was released on Netflix just a couple of months before his death. He was also well known for his role as Marvin Dorfler in *Midnight Run* (1988) alongside Robert De Niro.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on September 27, 2024, in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters in the Dahieh suburb of southern Beirut, Lebanon. Hezbollah confirmed his death on September 28, 2024.

Nasrallah had led Hezbollah since 1992, making him one of the longest-serving and most influential figures in the Middle East. His killing came amid a sharp escalation in the Israel–Hezbollah conflict in 2024, which had intensified following the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Israel and the ensuing war in Gaza.

Following his death, Hashem Safieddine, a senior figure widely expected to succeed him, was also killed in an Israeli strike in October 2024. Naim Qassem,…

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on September 15, 2024, at the age of 70.

According to reports, he suffered an apparent heart attack while driving from New Mexico toward Oklahoma. He pulled over in Gallup, New Mexico, where he was found unresponsive. His death was announced by his three sons (Taj, Taryll, and TJ, who perform as the group 3T).

Tito was a founding member of the Jackson 5, playing guitar alongside his brothers Jackie, Jermaine, Marlon, and Michael. In his later years, he had also pursued a solo career as a blues artist.

2024-09-death-rose.r:
Pete Rose has died. He passed away on September 30, 2024, at the age of 83 at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada. The cause of death was reported as hypertensive cardiovascular disease.

Rose remains baseball's all-time hits leader with 4,256 career hits, a record he set while playing primarily for the Cincinnati Reds (with stints at the Philadelphia Phillies and Montreal Expos). Notably, he died while still permanently banned from baseball due to gambling violations dating back to 1989, which had kept him ineligible for the Hall of Fame throughout his lifetime.

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal. Barnier, a veteran of the conservative Les Républicains party, was best known internationally as the European Union's chief Brexit negotiator. His appointment came after a lengthy delay following the June–July 2024 legislative elections, which produced a hung parliament.

Notably, Barnier's government was toppled by a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly on December 4, 2024, over his budget plans, making his tenure one of the shortest in modern French history. Macron then appointed François Bayrou as his replacement on December 13, 2024.

2024-09-office-hill.r:
Elliott Hill was named to become the chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe. The announcement was made in September 2024, with Hill taking over as President and CEO effective October 14, 2024.

Hill was a longtime Nike veteran who spent more than 30 years at the company, starting as an intern in 1988 and eventually rising to President of Consumer and Marketplace before retiring in 2020. His return came as Nike faced challenges with slowing sales and sought to refocus on its core business and relationships with retail partners.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on September 27, 2024, at the age of 89. Her death was announced by her sons, actors Chris Larkin and Toby Stephens, who said she died peacefully in hospital in London that morning.

Smith was one of Britain's most celebrated actresses, with a career spanning more than seven decades. She won two Academy Awards (for *The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie* in 1969 and *California Suite* in 1978), multiple BAFTA and Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award. She was perhaps best known to later generations for her roles as Professor Minerva McGonagall in the *Harry Potter* films and as Violet Crawley, the Dowager Countess of Grantham, in *Downton Abbey*. She was made a Da…

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
Mitzi Gaynor has died. She passed away on October 17, 2024, at the age of 93, of natural causes at her home in Los Angeles.

Gaynor was best known for her starring role as Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film adaptation of Rodgers and Hammerstein's musical "South Pacific." She also had a successful career as a performer in film, television specials, and stage shows, becoming particularly famous for her elaborate TV variety specials in the 1960s and 1970s.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
There are two elections this could refer to:

**2024:** Anura Kumara Dissanayake won the September 2024 presidential election, defeating the incumbent president Ranil Wickremesinghe (who finished third) as well as main rival Sajith Premadasa. Dissanayake, leader of the National People's Power coalition, became president amid the country's recovery from its severe economic crisis.

**2015:** Maithripala Sirisena defeated incumbent president Mahinda Rajapaksa, ending Rajapaksa's decade-long rule.

If you're asking about the most recent election, the answer is Anura Kumara Dissanayake. If you have a specific year in mind, let me know and I can provide more detail.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r:
Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on September 28, 2024, at the age of 88, at his home in Maui, Hawaii. His family announced that he died peacefully, surrounded by family.

Kristofferson was a legendary figure in country music, known for writing classics like "Me and Bobby McGee," "Help Me Make It Through the Night," and "For the Good Times." He was also a member of the country supergroup The Highwaymen alongside Johnny Cash, Waylon Jennings, and Willie Nelson. As an actor, he appeared in films such as "A Star Is Born" (1976), for which he won a Golden Globe, and "Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid."

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond has died. He passed away on **12 October 2024** at the age of 69, while attending a conference in Ohrid, North Macedonia. He reportedly suffered a heart attack during the event.

Salmond served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and led the Scottish National Party (SNP) through the 2014 independence referendum. After stepping down following the referendum result, he later founded the Alba Party in 2021.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
Based on my knowledge, **Shigeru Ishiba** won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) presidential election held on September 27, 2024, defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff. He subsequently became Japan's Prime Minister on October 1, 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida, who had announced he would not seek re-election as party leader.

However, please note that my information has a cutoff date, and if you're asking about a more recent LDP leadership election, I may not have details about it. If an election occurred after early 2025, I'd recommend verifying with a current news source.

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr has died. She passed away on October 29, 2024, at the age of 79, in Los Angeles. Her death was attributed to complications from multiple sclerosis, a disease she had lived with for many years after being diagnosed in 1999.

Garr had a distinguished career in comedy, with memorable roles in *Young Frankenstein* (1974), *Close Encounters of the Third Kind* (1977), *Mr. Mom* (1983), and her Academy Award-nominated performance as Sandy Lester in *Tootsie* (1982). She also appeared frequently on late-night talk shows and had a recurring role on the sitcom *Friends* as Phoebe's mother.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on **October 9, 2024**, at the age of 86 at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, India. He had been admitted to the hospital for age-related health issues, and his condition became critical before his death.

His passing prompted an outpouring of grief across India, with tributes from political leaders, business figures, and ordinary citizens. He was accorded a state funeral in recognition of his contributions to Indian industry and society.

Ratan Tata led the Tata Group as chairman of Tata Sons from 1991 to 2012, during which the conglomerate expanded dramatically through major acquisitions like Tetley, Corus, and Jaguar Land Rover. He also served briefly as…

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: **Shigeru Ishiba** succeeded Fumio Kishida as Prime Minister of Japan. Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election in September 2024 and was formally elected Prime Minister by the Diet on October 1, 2024, after Kishida announced he would step down and not seek re-election as party leader.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on October 22, 2024, at the age of 63. His death came just as the Los Angeles Dodgers were beginning their World Series matchup against the New York Yankees, and the team honored him throughout that series, which they went on to win. Valenzuela had stepped away from his role as a Spanish-language broadcaster for the Dodgers earlier in 2024 due to health issues.

Valenzuela was a beloved figure in baseball, famous for sparking "Fernandomania" in 1981 when, as a rookie, he won both the National League Cy Young Award and Rookie of the Year, and helped the Dodgers win the World Series that year. He pitched for the Dodgers from 1980 to 1990 and also pl…

2024-10-death-lesh.r:
Phil Lesh has died. He passed away on October 25, 2024, at the age of 84. His death was announced by his representative, who said he passed away peacefully.

Lesh was the bassist for the Grateful Dead for the band's entire 30-year run (1965–1995) and was one of its founding members. After the Grateful Dead ended following Jerry Garcia's death in 1995, he continued performing with projects such as Phil Lesh and Friends, The Dead, and Furthur, and he operated the venue Terrapin Crossroads in San Rafael, California. He had faced several health challenges over the years, including a liver transplant in 1998 and treatment for bladder cancer in 2015.

2024-10-office-nike.r: **Elliott Hill** became Nike's president and chief executive officer in October 2024, succeeding John Donahoe. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who spent more than 30 years at the company before retiring in 2020, having previously served in senior leadership roles including president of consumer and marketplace. His appointment was announced in September 2024 as Nike faced slowing sales and sought to refocus on its core business and relationships with retail partners.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne has died. He died on October 16, 2024, at the age of 31 in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He fell from the third-floor balcony of the CasaSur Palermo Hotel, where he had been staying. The fall resulted in fatal injuries, and he was pronounced dead at the scene.

Payne had been in Argentina attending concerts by his former One Direction bandmate Niall Horan in the days before his death. In the aftermath, Argentine authorities investigated the circumstances surrounding his death, including whether individuals had supplied him with drugs prior to the fall.

His death prompted an outpouring of tributes from fans and fellow musicians around the world, including from his One Direction bandmat…

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison has died. She passed away on November 9, 2024, at the age of 81, in New York. Her death was announced by the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater, the company she had joined as a dancer in 1965 and later led as artistic director from 1989 until her retirement in 2011. She was widely celebrated for her powerful performances, most famously in Alvin Ailey's solo "Cry" (1971), and for her leadership in shaping the company into a globally renowned institution.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar was killed. He died on **October 16, 2024**, during an Israeli military operation in the Tel al-Sultan neighborhood of Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip.

Key details:

- **How it happened:** His death was not the result of a pre-planned targeted assassination. Israeli soldiers encountered a group of militants during what was described as a routine operation, and a firefight and tank fire followed. Sinwar was wounded, and a tank shell struck the building where he was located. A drone subsequently filmed him—badly injured, sitting in a chair in a destroyed apartment—and he threw a stick at the drone in his final moments. That footage was widely circulated.

- **Confirmation:** Is…

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r:
Quincy Jones has died. He passed away on November 3, 2024, at the age of 91, at his home in Los Angeles, surrounded by his family.

Jones was one of the most influential figures in 20th-century music, known for his work as a producer, composer, and arranger. His career spanned jazz, pop, film, and television, and he was perhaps best known for producing Michael Jackson's albums *Off the Wall*, *Thriller*, and *Bad*, as well as organizing the "We Are the World" charity recording in 1985. Over his career, he won 28 Grammy Awards and was nominated for many more.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
In the most recent House of Representatives general election that I'm aware of—held on October 27, 2024—the LDP-Komeito coalition **lost its majority** in the lower house.

Key details:
- The election was widely seen as a punishment for the LDP over a political funds scandal involving undisclosed kickbacks from faction fundraising events.
- The LDP won roughly 191 seats and Komeito about 24, giving the coalition around 215 seats—well short of the 233 needed for a majority in the 465-seat chamber.
- This was the first time the coalition lost its lower house majority since 2009.
- The main opposition Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan (CDP) made significant gains, winning around 148 seat…

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024, at age 26. The San Francisco Office of the Chief Medical Examiner ruled his death a suicide.

Balaji was a former OpenAI researcher who had left the company in 2024 and become a whistleblower, publicly arguing that training AI models on copyrighted data likely did not qualify as fair use. He had been named in copyright litigation involving OpenAI, including the New York Times lawsuit, and his death came shortly after that court filing.

His parents have publicly disputed the official ruling of suicide and called for further investigation into his death, which attracted significant public attention …

2024-11-office-trump-election.r:
The most recent U.S. presidential election took place in November 2024, and Donald Trump won it, defeating Kamala Harris. Trump, the Republican nominee, secured 312 electoral votes to Harris's 226 and also won the national popular vote. He was inaugurated as the 47th president on January 20, 2025, making him the second president in U.S. history (after Grover Cleveland) to serve non-consecutive terms.

Harris, the Democratic nominee, had become her party's candidate after President Joe Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024.

Note: My knowledge has a cutoff date, so if an election has occurred since then, I wouldn't be aware of it.

2024-11-death-west.r:
Timothy West has died. The British actor passed away on 12 November 2024, at the age of 89. His death was announced by his family, who said he died peacefully in his sleep.

West had a long and distinguished career spanning theatre, film, and television, and was known for roles such as Bradley Hardacre in *Brass*, as well as portraying historical figures like Winston Churchill and Joseph Stalin. He was married to actress Prunella Scales, with whom he appeared in the canal travel series *Great Canal Journeys*.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
Donald Trump has been president-elect twice, so there are two answers depending on which transition you're asking about:

- **2016 transition:** Trump nominated retired Marine Corps General **James Mattis**, who served as Secretary of Defense from 2017 to 2019.

- **2024 transition:** Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth**, a Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran. His nomination was controversial, and he was confirmed by the Senate in January 2025 (with Vice President JD Vance breaking a tie vote).

If you're asking about the most recent nomination, the answer is Pete Hegseth.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on November 3, 2024, at her home in New York City, at the age of 91. Her death followed a stroke she had suffered shortly before.

Bradford was born on May 10, 1933, in Leeds, England, and became one of the world's bestselling authors. *A Woman of Substance* (1979), her debut novel, launched her career and became a global phenomenon, spawning the Emma Harte saga and selling tens of millions of copies worldwide. She wrote more than 30 novels over her career and lived in New York City with her husband, Robert Bradford, whom she married in 1963.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
This depends on which transition period you mean, since Donald Trump was elected president twice:

**2016 transition:** Trump's first nominee for Attorney General was Senator **Jeff Sessions** of Alabama. Yes, he did hold the office — he was confirmed by the Senate in February 2017 and served until November 2018, when he resigned at Trump's request after Trump repeatedly criticized his recusal from the Russia investigation.

**2024 transition:** Trump's first nominee was Representative **Matt Gaetz** of Florida. No, he did not hold the office — Gaetz withdrew his name from consideration in November 2024 amid scrutiny over a House Ethics Committee investigation into allegations of sexual misc…

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Following Mauritius's general election on 10 November 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became prime minister, returning to office after his Alliance du Changement coalition won a landslide victory. He replaced **Pravind Jugnauth**, who had served as prime minister since 2017 (initially succeeding his father, Anerood Jugnauth) and whose Alliance Lepep coalition suffered a heavy defeat. Ramgoolam was sworn in on 13 November 2024, beginning his fourth term as prime minister, having previously held the office in 1995–2000 and 2005–2014.

Note that this reflects my knowledge as of my last update; if another election has occurred since then, I may not be aware of it.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
Jimmy Carter died on **December 29, 2024**, at his home in Plains, Georgia. He was 100 years old, making him the longest-lived U.S. president in history. He had entered hospice care in February 2023.

His state funeral included services in Atlanta and Washington, D.C., with a national funeral service at the Washington National Cathedral on January 9, 2025. He was buried in Plains, Georgia, alongside his wife Rosalynn Carter, who had died in November 2023.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson has died. He passed away on December 20, 2024, at the age of 65, in Oakland, California, after a brief illness (reported as pneumonia). His death came just days before his 66th birthday.

Henderson is widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter and base stealer in baseball history. He holds the MLB records for career stolen bases (1,406) and runs scored (2,295), and was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 2009. He played 25 seasons in the majors, most notably with the Oakland Athletics, and also had stints with the Yankees, Padres, Mets, and several other teams.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
Christian Lindner was dismissed as Germany's finance minister by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on November 6, 2024, in a dramatic escalation of a long-running dispute over budget and economic policy.

The core conflict centered on how to fill a multi-billion-euro budget gap for 2025. Lindner and his Free Democratic Party (FDP) insisted on upholding Germany's constitutional "debt brake" and rejected tax increases, while Scholz and the SPD wanted more fiscal flexibility, including to fund aid for Ukraine and domestic investment. The immediate trigger was a policy paper Lindner circulated calling for a sharp change of economic course, which Scholz viewed as an attempt to undermine the government from …

2024-12-death-giovanni.r:
Nikki Giovanni has died. She passed away on December 10, 2024, at the age of 81. She died at her home in Blacksburg, Virginia, where she had long been associated with Virginia Tech as a University Distinguished Professor.

Giovanni was one of the most celebrated American poets of her generation, known for works like "Black Feeling, Black Talk" and "Nikki-Rosa," and was a prominent voice in the Black Arts Movement of the 1960s and 1970s.

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Manmohan Singh has died. He passed away on **December 26, 2024**, at the age of 92. He was admitted to AIIMS hospital in New Delhi after a sudden loss of consciousness at his home, and he died later that evening.

Singh served as India's Prime Minister for two terms, from 2004 to 2014, as a member of the Indian National Congress-led UPA government. Before that, he was widely credited as the architect of India's 1991 economic liberalization during his tenure as Finance Minister under Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao. He also previously served as Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
Greg Gumbel has died. He passed away on December 27, 2024, at the age of 78, after a battle with cancer. His death was announced by CBS Sports, where he had been a fixture for decades.

Gumbel was one of the most respected sportscasters in American television. He was known for his long tenure at CBS Sports, where he hosted the network's NFL studio coverage ("The NFL Today") and served as the studio host for NCAA March Madness coverage for many years. He also made history as the first Black play-by-play announcer to call a major U.S. sports championship on network television when he called Super Bowl XXXVIII in 2004. He was the older brother of fellow broadcaster Bryant Gumbel.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby resigned as Archbishop of Canterbury in November 2024, stepping down earlier than he had originally planned, following a damning report on the Church of England's handling of abuse.

**Background:** Welby became the 105th Archbishop of Canterbury in 2013, succeeding Rowan Williams. He led the Church of England for over a decade, navigating debates over sexuality, the COVID-19 pandemic, and declining attendance.

**The resignation:** In November 2024, the Makin Review was published, an independent investigation into the abuse carried out by John Smyth, a barrister who physically and sexually abused young men and boys at Christian summer camps over decades. The review concluded th…

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
Ghana's most recent presidential election was held on December 7, 2024, and was won by **John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC). He defeated Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), who was the sitting vice president. Bawumia conceded defeat relatively quickly after the vote, and Mahama was inaugurated in January 2025.

This marked Mahama's return to the presidency—he previously served as Ghana's president from 2012 to 2017, having lost the 2016 election and unsuccessfully contested the 2020 election against Nana Akufo-Addo.

Note that my information has a knowledge cutoff, so if an election has occurred since then, I may not be aware of it. Ghana's next sc…

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, has died. He was fatally shot on **December 4, 2024**, in Midtown Manhattan, New York City.

Key details:

- **How it happened:** Thompson, age 50, was shot in the back and leg by a gunman as he walked toward the New York Hilton Midtown hotel, where UnitedHealth Group was holding its annual investor conference. The shooting occurred early in the morning, around 6:45 a.m.
- **The suspect:** After a days-long manhunt, Luigi Mangione was arrested on December 9, 2024, at a McDonald's in Altoona, Pennsylvania. He was found with a firearm (reportedly a "ghost gun" made partly with 3D-printed parts) and writings critical of the health insuran…

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96. He died in a care facility in the Paris region (Garches), where he had been living after his health declined in his final years.

Le Pen founded the National Front (Front National, now renamed National Rally) in 1972 and led the far-right party until 2011, when his daughter Marine Le Pen succeeded him. He was a highly controversial figure in French politics, known for provocative statements and multiple convictions for Holocaust denial and inciting racial hatred. He reached the second round runoff of the French presidential election in 2002, losing to Jacques Chirac.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier's government was toppled by a vote of no confidence in the National Assembly on **December 4, 2024**, making it the first French government to fall to a censure motion since 1962 (under Georges Pompidou).

**Background and what happened:**

- Barnier, a veteran conservative politician and former EU Brexit negotiator, was appointed Prime Minister by President Emmanuel Macron in September 2024, after snap legislative elections produced a hung parliament with no clear majority.

- His minority government struggled to pass a budget for 2025. In late November 2024, he invoked **Article 49.3** of the Constitution to force the social security financing bill through without a parliame…

2024-12-office-romania.r:
On December 6, 2024, Romania's Constitutional Court annulled the first round of the presidential election, which had been held on November 24, 2024, and canceled the runoff that was scheduled for December 8. The court ordered the entire electoral process to be restarted.

The decision came after President Klaus Iohannis declassified intelligence documents indicating that the surprise first-round winner, far-right independent candidate Călin Georgescu, had benefited from a coordinated social media campaign (particularly on TikTok) linked to Russian interference, as well as undeclared campaign financing. Notably, the court had initially rejected annulment requests in late November, but reverse…

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards has died. She passed away on January 20, 2025, at the age of 67, after battling glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. She had publicly revealed her diagnosis in 2024.

Richards served as president of Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018, and was also known as a Democratic activist, co-founder of the organization Supermajority, and the daughter of former Texas Governor Ann Richards.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad's government collapsed in December 2024, ending more than 24 years of his rule and 54 years of Assad family control over Syria.

**The fall:** On November 27, 2024, a rebel coalition led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), commanded by Ahmed al-Sharaa (also known as Abu Mohammad al-Jolani), launched a surprise offensive in northwestern Syria. The offensive moved with stunning speed—Aleppo fell within days, followed by Hama on December 5 and Homs on December 7. On December 8, 2024, rebels entered Damascus with minimal resistance, and Assad's government collapsed. The entire campaign lasted roughly two weeks.

**Assad's fate:** Assad fled Syria and was granted asylum in Russia, wher…

2025-01-death-lynch.r: David Lynch has died. The acclaimed filmmaker, known for works such as *Eraserhead*, *Blue Velvet*, *Mulholland Drive*, and the TV series *Twin Peaks*, passed away on January 15, 2025, at the age of 78. His death came shortly after he had publicly disclosed in 2024 that he had been diagnosed with emphysema.

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
Bob Uecker has died. The longtime Milwaukee Brewers radio broadcaster and former Major League catcher passed away on January 16, 2025, at the age of 90, just shy of his 91st birthday. After his death, it was revealed he had been privately battling small cell lung cancer.

Uecker, affectionately known as "Mr. Baseball," had called Brewers games since 1971 and was also widely known for his self-deprecating humor on Johnny Carson's Tonight Show, his role as Harry Doyle in the Major League films, and the sitcom Mr. Belvedere. He was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame's broadcasters wing (Ford C. Frick Award) in 2003.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore died on January 17, 2025, at the age of 89. He reportedly passed away following complications from a surgery he had undergone. 

Moore was the surviving half of the duo Sam & Dave (his partner Dave Prater died in a car accident in 1988), and was celebrated for classics like "Soul Man" and "Hold On, I'm Comin'." He was often referred to as one of the greatest voices in soul music, and his influence extended widely — Bruce Springsteen, who performed with him, was among the many artists who paid tribute after his death.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r:
Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at his home in Manhattan, New York, at the age of 86. His death followed a battle with cancer.

Yarrow co-founded the folk trio Peter, Paul and Mary in 1961 with Noel Paul Stookey and Mary Travers. The group was known for hits like "Puff, the Magic Dragon," "Blowin' in the Wind," and "Leaving on a Jet Plane." With Yarrow's death, Paul Stookey became the last surviving member of the trio, as Mary Travers died in 2009.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
Marianne Faithfull has died. The British singer, songwriter, and actress passed away on January 30, 2025, in London at the age of 78.

Faithfull was best known for her 1964 hit "As Tears Go By" (written by Mick Jagger and Keith Richards), her association with the Rolling Stones in the 1960s, and her acclaimed later career, including the 1979 album *Broken English*. She had faced numerous health challenges over the years, including breast cancer, emphysema, and a severe case of COVID-19 in 2020.

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
As of my last update, the President of Lebanon is **Joseph Aoun**, who was elected by the Lebanese parliament on January 9, 2025. He is a former commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces (no relation to former President Michel Aoun). His election ended a presidential vacancy that lasted more than two years, following the end of Michel Aoun's term in October 2022, during which Lebanon's parliament repeatedly failed to agree on a successor.

Please note that political situations can change, so if you need the most current information, I'd recommend verifying with an up-to-date source.

On December 3, 2024, Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in a surprise late-night televised address, accusing the opposition-controlled National Assembly of "anti-state activities" and sympathizing with North Korea. - Lawmakers climbed fences to enter the National Assembly building as military forces tried to block them. The Assembly voted 190–0 to demand the lifting of martial law.
- Within about six hours, Yoon complied and lifted the decree in the early morning of December 4.

**Impeachment**
- A first impeachment vote on December 7 failed after ruling …

control-alive-messi.r:
Yes, Lionel Messi is alive. As of my last update, the Argentine footballer — widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time — was playing for Inter Miami in Major League Soccer, having joined the club in 2023 after stints at Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain. He also captained Argentina to victory at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar.

Note that my information has a cutoff date, so I can't confirm events after that point, but there's nothing to suggest otherwise.

2025-01-office-salam.r:
**Nawaf Salam** was designated to form a new government as Prime Minister of Lebanon in January 2025. He was chosen on January 13, 2025, shortly after Joseph Aoun was elected President of Lebanon on January 9, 2025, ending a more than two-year presidential vacancy.

At the time of his designation, Salam was serving as President (chief judge) of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague. He received the backing of a majority of members of parliament during binding consultations, and he succeeded Najib Mikati, who had been serving in a caretaker capacity. Salam went on to form a government in February 2025.

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Aga Khan) has died. He passed away on February 4, 2025, in Lisbon, Portugal, at the age of 88. He had served as the 49th Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957, when he succeeded his grandfather at the age of 20.

Following his death, he was succeeded as Imam by his eldest son, Prince Rahim Aga Khan, who became the 50th Imam (Aga Khan V), in accordance with the terms of his will.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler has died. He passed away on February 20, 2025, at the age of 85 at his home in Chicago. He had been battling Parkinson's disease for several years.

Butler was a founding member of the Impressions, singing lead on their 1958 hit "For Your Precious Love," before launching a successful solo career that earned him the nickname "The Iceman" for his smooth, cool vocal delivery. His solo hits included "Only the Strong Survive," "Make It Easy on Yourself," and "Hey, Western Union Man." Later in life, he served for over three decades as a Cook County Board Commissioner in Illinois.

2025-02-death-flack.r:
Roberta Flack has died. She passed away on February 24, 2025, at the age of 88. She died at home, surrounded by family.

Flack had been diagnosed with ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) in 2022, a condition that had ended her singing career. She was one of the most celebrated vocalists of her era, known for hits such as "The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face," "Killing Me Softly with His Song," "Feel Like Makin' Love," and duets with Donny Hathaway including "Where Is the Love" and "The Closer I Get to You." She made history as the first artist to win the Grammy Award for Record of the Year in consecutive years (1973 and 1974).

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
David Johansen has died. He passed away on February 28, 2025, at the age of 75 at his home on Staten Island, New York.

Earlier in February 2025, it had been revealed that he was battling stage 4 cancer—a brain tumor and liver cancer—and had also been recovering from a broken back suffered in a fall. His family had shared his diagnosis publicly in connection with a fundraiser through the Sweet Relief Musicians Fund to help cover his care.

Chita Rivera died on **January 30, 2024**, at the age of 91. She passed away in New York after a brief illness, just one week after her birthday (she was born January 23, 1933).

Rivera was one of Broadway's most celebrated performers, best known for originating iconic roles such as Anita in *West Side Story* (1957), Velma Kelly in *Chicago* (1975), and Aurora in *Kiss of the Spider Woman* (1992). Mário Zagallo has died. He passed away on **January 5, 2024**, in Rio de Janeiro, at the age of 92.

Zagallo was one of the most important figures in Brazilian football history. He won four World Cups with Brazil:

- **1958 and 1962** as a player (part of the legendary teams alongside Pelé and Garrincha)
- **1970** as head coach of what many consider the greatest national team ever
- **1994** as an assistant coach

He was famously the first person ever to win the World Cup both as a player and as a coach, a distinction later matched by Franz Beckenbauer and Didier Deschamps.

2024-01-death-soul.r:
David Soul has died. He passed away on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of 80, in London, England, where he had lived for many years. His death was announced by his wife, Helen Snell, who said he died "after a valiant battle for life in the loving company of family." He had reportedly been dealing with health issues, including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), in his later years.

Soul was best known for his role as Detective Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson opposite Paul Michael Glaser's Dave Starsky in the hit 1970s series *Starsky & Hutch*. He also had a successful music career, most notably with the 1977 number-one hit "Don't Give Up on Us."

2024-01-death-musser.r:
Alec Musser has died. He passed away on **January 13, 2024**, at his home in Del Mar, California. He was 50 years old.

His fiancée, Paige Press, announced his death, and the San Diego County Medical Examiner's Office later ruled it a suicide.

Musser was best known for playing Del Henry on the soap opera *All My Children* (a role that won him a Daytime Emmy in 2007 for Outstanding Younger Actor) and for his memorable appearance in the 2010 comedy *Grown Ups*. Before acting, he had a career as a fitness model.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
**Bernardo Arévalo** is the president you're asking about. He won Guatemala's 2023 presidential election as the candidate of the Movimiento Semilla (Seed Movement), defeating former First Lady Sandra Torres in the August 2023 runoff.

His inauguration, scheduled for January 14, 2024, was delayed for hours amid efforts by opponents—including members of the outgoing Congress and the attorney general's office—to prevent him from taking office, following months of legal attempts to undermine his party's registration. He was ultimately sworn in during the early hours of January 15, 2024, after Congress reorganized and certified the results.

Arévalo, a sociologist, diplomat, and the son of former…

2024-01-office-drcongo.r:
**Félix Tshisekedi** was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Following the presidential election held on December 20, 2023, Tshisekedi was declared the winner with a decisive majority (officially over 70% of the vote). He was inaugurated for his second five-year term on January 20, 2024, in a ceremony in the capital, Kinshasa.

A few points of context:

- Tshisekedi first took office in January 2019, succeeding longtime president Joseph Kabila after the December 2018 election.
- The 2023 election results were contested by several opposition candidates, who alleged irregularities, though Tshisekedi was certified as the winner by the electoral commiss…

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, the chair and CEO of Foremost Group, has died. She passed away on February 11, 2024 (the accident occurred late on the night of February 10) at her ranch in Blanco County, Texas, near Johnson City. She was 50 years old.

**How she died:** Chao was killed in a car accident on her ranch property. According to the sheriff's investigation and media reports, she inadvertently shifted her Tesla Model X into reverse instead of drive while attempting to execute a multi-point turn, causing the vehicle to back over an embankment and into a pond. Despite efforts by neighbors to rescue her, the vehicle became fully submerged and she was unable to escape; she died of drowning. The incident w…

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No, Claudine Gay is no longer president of Harvard University.

**When she left:** Gay resigned on January 2, 2024, after roughly six months in office—the shortest tenure of any Harvard president. She stepped down amid intense controversy over two issues: her widely criticized testimony at a December 2023 congressional hearing on campus antisemitism (where she declined to say definitively that calls for the genocide of Jews would violate Harvard's conduct rules) and plagiarism allegations concerning her scholarly work. She remains a tenured professor of government and of African and African American Studies at Harvard.

**Who took over:** Alan Garber, Harvard's provost, was named interim pre…

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds that role. He resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings and from the TKO board of directors on January 26, 2024.

**Why he left:** His resignation came one day after Janel Grant, a former WWE employee, filed a lawsuit against McMahon, WWE, and John Laurinaitis alleging sexual assault and sex trafficking, along with claims that McMahon used hush money payments to cover it up. In his resignation statement, McMahon said he was stepping down "out of respect for the WWE Universe, the extraordinary TKO business and its board members and shareholders, partners and constituents, and all of the employees." This followed his earlier mid-2022 retirement (ove…

2024-02-death-brehme.r:
Andreas Brehme has died. He passed away on **20 February 2024** at the age of 63. He died suddenly in Munich after suffering cardiac arrest, according to statements from his family and his former club, Bayern Munich.

Brehme is best remembered for scoring the decisive penalty in the 85th minute of the 1990 World Cup final in Rome, giving West Germany a 1–0 victory over Argentina. He was also famous for being equally adept with both feet, and had a successful club career with teams including Kaiserslautern, Bayern Munich, and Inter Milan.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
Toby Keith has died. He passed away on **February 5, 2024**, at the age of 62.

He had been battling stomach cancer, which he announced publicly in June 2022 (saying he'd been diagnosed in the fall of 2021). He underwent treatment, including chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery, and even performed a few shows during that period, but his health ultimately declined. His death was announced on his official website and social media, stating that he died peacefully, surrounded by his family.

Keith was known for hits like "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)," "Should've Been a Cowboy," "How Do You Like Me Now?!", and "Red Solo Cup."

2024-02-death-weathers.r:
Carl Weathers has died. He passed away on **February 1, 2024**, at his home in Los Angeles, California, at the age of 76. His family announced his death the following day, and his death certificate later indicated the cause was atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

Weathers was best known for portraying Apollo Creed opposite Sylvester Stallone in the first four *Rocky* films. His other notable roles included Dillon in *Predator* (1987), Chubbs Peterson in *Happy Gilmore* (1996), and Greef Karga in the Star Wars series *The Mandalorian*, for which he received an Emmy nomination. Before acting, he played linebacker in the NFL for the Oakland Raiders.

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
Eric Carmen has died. He passed away in early March 2024 at the age of 74. His wife, Amy, announced his death on March 11, 2024, saying he died peacefully in his sleep at his home in Ohio over that weekend (around March 9–10). No specific cause of death was publicly disclosed at the time.

Carmen was best known as the frontman of the Raspberries ("Go All the Way") and for his solo hits "All By Myself" (1975), "Hungry Eyes" (from *Dirty Dancing*), and "Make Me Lose Control."

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died. He was killed in a road traffic accident in Kenya on **February 11, 2024**, at the age of 24.

Details of the crash:
- It occurred at night (around 11 p.m. local time) on the Eldoret–Kaptagat road in the Rift Valley region of Kenya.
- The vehicle he was in reportedly lost control and hit a tree.
- His coach, **Gervais Hakizimana** of Rwanda, also died in the crash. A third occupant, a woman, survived with injuries.

Kiptum had set the men's marathon world record of **2:00:35** at the Chicago Marathon in October 2023, breaking Eliud Kipchoge's previous mark. His death came just months later, and shortly before he was scheduled to attempt to become the first person to r…

2024-02-office-finland.r:
**Alexander Stubb** won the most recent Finnish presidential election, held in early 2024. He defeated Pekka Haavisto in the second-round runoff on February 11, 2024, and took office on March 1, 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö, who was term-limited after serving two six-year terms.

Stubb, a member of the National Coalition Party (Kokoomus), previously served as Prime Minister of Finland (2014–2015) and held several other ministerial posts, including Finance and Foreign Affairs.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On **February 28, 2024**, Mitch McConnell announced on the Senate floor that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in **November 2024**, when his caucus would elect a successor. He said he would remain in the Senate to finish his current term, which runs through January 2027.

Key points from the announcement:
- McConnell had served as the Senate Republican leader since 2007, making him the **longest-serving Senate party leader in U.S. history**.
- He framed the decision as a moment of transition, noting it was "time for a new generation" of leadership, and referenced the recent death of his wife Elaine Chao's younger sister as a moment that prompted reflection.
- He was 82 years ol…

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
**Prabowo Subianto** won Indonesia's most recent presidential election, held on February 14, 2024. He won decisively with roughly 58–59% of the vote, avoiding a runoff, and was inaugurated as president on October 20, 2024.

Key details:
- His running mate was **Gibran Rakabuming Raka**, the eldest son of outgoing President Joko Widodo (Jokowi).
- He defeated two rivals: former Jakarta governor **Anies Baswedan** and former Central Java governor **Ganjar Pranowo**.
- This was Prabowo's third run for the presidency, after losing to Jokowi in 2014 and 2019. He previously served as Indonesia's defense minister.

If you're asking after a date beyond my knowledge cutoff, it's worth double-checking…

2024-03-death-gossett.r:
Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on **March 29, 2024**, at the age of 87, in Santa Monica, California. Reports indicated he had been dealing with health issues in his later years, having been diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2010.

Gossett Jr. was a pioneering actor best known for:
- Winning the **Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor** for his role as Gunnery Sergeant Emil Foley in *An Officer and a Gentleman* (1982), becoming the first Black man to win in that category
- Winning an **Emmy Award** for his performance as Fiddler in the landmark miniseries *Roots* (1977)
- Roles in films such as *Enemy Mine* (1985), the *Iron Eagle* series, and *A Soldier's Story* (1984)

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of 90. He passed away at his home in Connecticut.

Kahneman, born March 5, 1934, was an Israeli-American psychologist who won the 2002 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences (shared with Vernon Smith) for his pioneering work on the psychology of judgment and decision-making, developed largely with his longtime collaborator Amos Tversky. Their research on cognitive biases and heuristics laid the foundation for behavioral economics. His 2011 book *Thinking, Fast and Slow* brought these ideas to a broad audience and became a major bestseller.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down as chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, after pressure from Donald Trump and poor results in the 2022 and 2023 elections. She was the longest-serving chair in recent RNC history, having held the post since 2017.

Her successor is **Michael Whatley**, the former chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party. He was elected RNC chair on March 8, 2024, at the RNC's winter/general meeting in Houston. At the same time, **Lara Trump** (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) was elected co-chair.

As of my knowledge cutoff in early 2025, Whatley remained in the role, but you may want to verify the current status in case anything has changed since then…

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on **March 1, 2024**, at the age of 68. According to the announcement made by his studio (Bird Studio) on March 8, 2024, the cause of death was an acute subdural hematoma — a buildup of blood on the brain, typically caused by head trauma.

His death was announced about a week after it occurred, as his family held private funeral services first. The news prompted an outpouring of tributes from around the world, including statements from fans, fellow artists, and even government officials, reflecting his enormous global influence through *Dragon Ball*, *Dr. Slump*, and his character designs for the *Dragon Quest* video game series.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped aside from both roles.

**Key timeline:**

- **20 March 2024**: Varadkar unexpectedly announced his resignation as Taoiseach and leader of Fine Gael, citing "personal and political reasons" and saying he was no longer "the best person for the job." The announcement came as a surprise, as there had been little prior indication he was planning to leave.

- **24 March 2024**: Simon Harris was elected unopposed as the new leader of Fine Gael.

- **9 April 2024**: Simon Harris formally succeeded Varadkar as Taoiseach after being nominated by the Dáil and receiving the seal of office from President Michael D. Higgins.

- **November 2024**: Varadkar did not contest the gene…

2024-03-office-rnc.r:
**Michael Whatley** was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel. At the time, Whatley was serving as chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party and was a close ally of Donald Trump. His election came after McDaniel announced she would step down following Trump's public call for changes in RNC leadership.

Alongside Whatley, Lara Trump (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) was elected as co-chair, and Chris LaCivita took on the role of chief of staff.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh has died. He passed away on **March 19, 2024**, at the age of 88, at a hospital in St. Albans, Vermont, where he had been living. His manager said the cause was cardiac arrest. His death came just three days before his 89th birthday (he was born March 22, 1935, in Oskaloosa, Iowa).

Walsh was one of Hollywood's most prolific character actors, with more than 200 film and TV credits over six decades. Beyond *Blade Runner* (1982), where he played Captain Bryant, and *Blood Simple* (1984), where he played the sleazy private detective Loren Visser, his memorable roles included *Slap Shot*, *Fletch*, *Raising Arizona*, *Christmas Vacation*, *My Best Friend's Wedding*, and, late in h…

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Chris Mortensen has died. The longtime ESPN NFL insider passed away in early March 2025 (ESPN announced his death on March 3, 2025). He was 72 years old.

Mortensen had battled throat cancer since announcing his diagnosis in 2016, and he retired from ESPN in 2023 after more than 30 years with the network, where he was one of the most respected NFL reporters and insiders in the business.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
Alexei Navalny died on **February 16, 2024**, at the age of 47.

He died at the "Polar Wolf" penal colony (IK-3) in Kharp, in Russia's Arctic north, where he had been transferred in December 2023. Russian prison authorities claimed he lost consciousness after a walk and could not be revived, and his death certificate reportedly listed "natural causes."

However, his death is widely disputed and viewed with deep suspicion:

- His widow, Yulia Navalnaya, and his team accused the Kremlin of murdering him, arguing he was killed because of his political activity.
- Western leaders, including U.S. President Joe Biden, directly blamed Russian President Vladimir Putin for his death.
- Navalny had su…

2024-03-death-lieberman.r:
Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He passed away on **March 27, 2024**, in New York City at the age of 82. According to his family, the cause was complications from a fall.

Lieberman was a Democratic senator from Connecticut who served from 1989 to 2013. He was also the Democratic Party's vice-presidential nominee in 2000, running alongside Al Gore — making him the first Jewish candidate on a major party's presidential ticket. Later in his career, he became an independent and notably endorsed Republican John McCain for president in 2008.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry resigned as prime minister of Haiti in 2024. Key details:

- **Resignation announcement (March 11, 2024):** Henry announced he would step down once a transitional governing body was established. Notably, he made the announcement while stranded in Puerto Rico, as gangs in Port-au-Prince had attacked the airport and made his return to Haiti impossible. His trip abroad had been to Kenya to finalize an agreement for a Kenyan-led multinational security mission.

- **Context:** The announcement came amid a major escalation in gang violence in early 2024, with gangs launching coordinated attacks on government buildings and prisons, freeing thousands of inmates, and explicitly demanding …

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024, at his home in Florence, Italy, at the age of 83. He had been in declining health for some time. Cavalli was known for his glamorous, flamboyant designs, particularly his signature animal prints and stretch jeans, and he founded his fashion house in the 1970s.

2024-04-death-simpson.r:
O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76, in Las Vegas, Nevada. His family announced his death the following day via a post on social media.

The cause of death was prostate cancer. Simpson had been diagnosed with the disease and had undergone chemotherapy treatment in the months leading up to his death. A few weeks before he died, reports emerged that he had been hospitalized, though his family had not publicly confirmed details at the time.

Simpson was famously a Heisman Trophy-winning NFL running back and later an actor and broadcaster, but he was best known for the 1995 "Trial of the Century," in which he was acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicol…

2024-04-death-graham.r:
Bob Graham died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87. He passed away in Gainesville, Florida.

Graham had a long career in Florida and national politics: he served as governor of Florida from 1979 to 1987 and as a U.S. senator from Florida from 1987 to 2005, including a stint as chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee. He also made a brief run for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2004.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson died on **April 21, 2024**, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, at the age of 76. He had been diagnosed earlier that year with an aggressive form of prostate cancer.

Anderson, who had been kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985 and held for 2,454 days (nearly seven years) — the longest of any American hostage in Lebanon — was released in December 1991. He later taught journalism at several universities, including Ohio University and the University of Kentucky.

2024-04-death-betts.r:
Dickey Betts is dead. He died on **April 18, 2024**, at his home in Osprey, Florida, at the age of 80. According to his family, he passed away peacefully in his sleep following a battle with cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Betts was a founding member of the Allman Brothers Band and was widely regarded as one of the greatest rock guitarists of all time. He wrote and sang some of the band's most beloved songs, including "Ramblin' Man," "Blue Sky," and "Jessica," and composed the instrumental "In Memory of Elizabeth Reed."

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024**, at the age of 94, at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland. The University of Edinburgh announced his death on 10 April 2024, noting that he had been in poor health for some time.

Higgs, who proposed the existence of the Higgs boson in 1964, lived to see the particle's discovery at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012 and shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics with François Englert for the theoretical prediction.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No, Bob Bakish is no longer CEO of Paramount Global. He stepped down on April 29, 2024, during the company's negotiations with Skydance Media.

His role was initially replaced by a three-person **"Office of the CEO"**, consisting of:

- **George Cheeks** – President and CEO of CBS
- **Chris McCarthy** – President and CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios
- **Brian Robbins** – President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

This arrangement served as the interim leadership structure while the Skydance merger was pending. That merger ultimately closed in August 2025, creating Paramount Skydance Corporation, with **David Ellison** (Skydance's founder) becoming the new chairman and …

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
**Simon Harris** succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach. Varadkar announced his resignation as Taoiseach and leader of Fine Gael in March 2024, and Harris was elected Fine Gael leader, becoming Taoiseach on 9 April 2024. At 37, Harris was the youngest person ever to hold the office.

However, it's worth noting that this wasn't the end of the story: after the general election in November 2024, a new coalition government was formed, and **Micheál Martin** (Fianna Fáil) became Taoiseach again in January 2025, with Simon Harris serving as Tánaiste under a further rotation arrangement.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye** became president of Senegal after winning the March 24, 2024 presidential election. He took office on April 2, 2024.

Key details about the election and transition:

- **Faye's background**: He was a little-known former tax inspector who ran as the replacement candidate for Ousmane Sonko, whose party PASTEF (Patriots of Senegal for Work, Ethics and Fraternity) had been dissolved by the government. Faye himself had been imprisoned on charges widely seen as politically motivated and was released just weeks before the election under a general amnesty.

- **Victory**: He won in the first round with roughly 54% of the vote, defeating the governing coalition's candidate, …

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ resigned as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly on April 26, 2024. His resignation came amid Vietnam's sweeping anti-corruption campaign ("blazing furnace"), with official statements saying he took responsibility for violations and shortcomings committed by subordinates, though he was not personally accused of specific crimes in the public announcement.

He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected Chairman of the National Assembly in May 2024.

Vương Đình Huệ had held the position since March 2021. His departure was one of the most high-profile casualties of the anti-graft purge that also saw President Võ Văn Thưởng resign in March 2024 and two previous preside…

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye** won Senegal's most recent presidential election, held on March 24, 2024.

Key details:
- Faye won in the **first round** with roughly 54% of the vote, defeating Amadou Ba, the candidate of the ruling coalition under then-President Macky Sall.
- Faye ran as the candidate of the dissolved opposition party PASTEF, stepping in after his mentor **Ousmane Sonko** was disqualified from running.
- Remarkably, Faye was **released from prison** just days before the election, having been jailed on charges widely seen as politically motivated.
- At age 44, he became the **youngest elected president in Africa** and was inaugurated on April 2, 2024. He subsequently appointed Ousm…

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin has died. He passed away in May 2025 at the age of 58. He was found dead in an apartment in Brussels, Belgium, where he had been house-sitting for a friend while working as a songwriter and producer. Reports indicated he had apparently slipped and fallen in the shower and was discovered several days later after he could not be reached. His death was widely reported around May 21–22, 2025.

Colin was a founding member of Train in the mid-1990s and played bass on their early hits, including "Meet Virginia" and "Drops of Jupiter," before leaving the band in 2004.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No. Humza Yousaf stepped down as First Minister of Scotland in May 2024. He announced his resignation on 29 April 2024 after ending the power-sharing agreement (the Bute House Agreement) with the Scottish Greens, which left him facing likely votes of no confidence. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became SNP leader and was elected First Minister on 7 May 2024.

Yousaf had served as First Minister since March 2023, having succeeded Nicola Sturgeon. He remains a Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) for Glasgow Pollok.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of 79.

Hill was born on December 17, 1944, in Manchester, England. He was best known for two iconic roles: Captain Edward John Smith in *Titanic* (1997) and King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers* (2002) and *The Return of the King* (2003). He was also well known in the UK for his role as Yosser Hughes in the acclaimed 1982 television drama *Boys from the Blackstuff*.

His death was announced by his agent in early May 2024, and tributes followed from colleagues and fans, including from the *Lord of the Rings* community. At the time of his death, he had been set to appear in the upcoming BBC drama series *Th…

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
As of my knowledge cutoff in January 2025, **John Swinney** is the First Minister of Scotland. He is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP) and took office in May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf.

If it's been a while since my knowledge was last updated, you may want to verify this with a current source, as political leadership positions can change.

2024-05-office-peloton.r:
**John Foley**, Peloton's co-founder, stepped down as chief executive officer in February 2022 amid a major restructuring. He transitioned to the role of executive chairman.

He was succeeded by **Barry McCarthy**, a former CFO of Spotify and Netflix. The restructuring announcement also included plans to cut roughly 2,800 jobs (about 20% of Peloton's workforce) and reduce manufacturing capacity, as the company struggled with declining demand following its pandemic-era surge.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**To Lam** was elected President of Vietnam following Vo Van Thuong's resignation.

Vo Van Thuong resigned on March 20, 2024, after less than a year in office, amid an anti-corruption campaign. He was the shortest-serving president in Vietnam's modern history. Following the vacancy, To Lam—who was serving as Minister of Public Security—was elected as the new President by the National Assembly on May 22, 2024.

Notably, To Lam's tenure as president was relatively brief as well. In August 2024, he became General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam following the death of Nguyen Phu Trong, and later in October 2024 he relinquished the presidency to Luong Cuong while retaining the top par…

2024-06-death-mays.r:
Willie Mays has died. He passed away on **June 18, 2024**, at the age of 93, in Palo Alto, California.

His death came just days before a scheduled tribute game at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama — the historic ballpark where Mays began his professional career with the Birmingham Black Barons of the Negro Leagues. The game went ahead as a celebration of his life and legacy.

Mays, known as "The Say Hey Kid," is widely regarded as one of the greatest baseball players of all time, with 660 career home runs, two National League MVP awards, and a famous over-the-shoulder catch in the 1954 World Series among his many highlights.
