Christian Oliver, born Christian Klepser, died on **January 4, 2024**, at age 51. He was killed when a small private plane crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after taking off from **Bequia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**, en route to Saint Lucia.

His two daughters and the pilot were also killed. The precise cause of the crash was investigated by aviation authorities.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum died on **11 February 2024**, aged 24. He was killed in a **car crash near Kaptagat in Kenya’s Elgeyo-Marakwet County** after the vehicle he was driving left the road and struck a tree. His coach, **Gervais Hakizimana**, also died; another passenger survived.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen died on **March 3, 2024**, at age 72. The longtime ESPN NFL reporter had been diagnosed with stage 4 throat cancer in 2016.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama died on **March 1, 2024**, at age 68. The cause was an **acute subdural hematoma**. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at age 88. The cause was cardiac arrest.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at age 83.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at age 87.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. The Allman Brothers Band guitarist died on April 18, 2024, at age 80.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s March 2024 presidential election and became president-elect. He was inaugurated on April 2, 2024.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down on March 8, 2024, and was succeeded by Michael Whatley. Whatley was later succeeded by Florida state senator Joe Gruters in August 2025, making Gruters the current RNC chair.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at age 82. His family said he died from complications after a fall.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024**, aged 94, following a short illness.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76. His family said he died of cancer.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died on **May 7, 2024**, at age 61. He suffered a **heart attack** at his recording studio, Electrical Audio, in Chicago.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye became president of Senegal following the 2024 election, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson is dead. The former Associated Press correspondent and Lebanon hostage died on **April 20, 2024**, at age 76, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York. His daughter said the cause was complications from recent heart surgery.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland in May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became First Minister on 8 May 2024.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped aside. He resigned as Fine Gael leader on **20 March 2024** and ceased being Taoiseach on **9 April 2024**, when **Simon Harris** succeeded him. Varadkar also did not contest the 2024 general election, so he is no longer a TD.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No. Vương Đình Huệ stepped down and was dismissed as Chairman of Vietnam’s National Assembly in May 2024. Trần Thanh Mẫn was elected to replace him on May 20, 2024.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin died in May 2024 at age 58. The founding Train bassist was found dead at a friend’s home in Brussels, Belgium, after apparently slipping and falling in the shower. His exact date of death was not publicly confirmed.

2024-05-death-murray.r: PGA Tour golfer **Grayson Murray died on May 25, 2024, at age 30**. His family later confirmed that he died by suicide.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia in May 2024.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach in April 2024. He was later succeeded by **Micheál Martin** on 23 January 2025, who is the current Taoiseach.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**, leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP). He took office on 8 May 2024.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. Amid escalating gang violence, he announced in March 2024 that he would resign once a transitional governing council was established. His resignation took effect on April 25, 2024, when Haiti’s Transitional Presidential Council was sworn in. He had been unable to return to Haiti after traveling abroad.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi has died. He was killed on **May 19, 2024**, when the helicopter carrying him crashed in mountainous terrain near **Varzaqan in Iran’s East Azerbaijan province**, amid poor weather and heavy fog.

Iranian authorities confirmed his death on **May 20, 2024**, after rescuers located the wreckage. Foreign Minister **Hossein Amir-Abdollahian** and other officials aboard were also killed.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill died on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of **79**. He was best known for playing **King Théoden** in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy and **Captain Edward Smith** in *Titanic*.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on **May 27, 2024**, at age 71, after a battle with cancer. He was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 1993.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish stepped down as Paramount Global’s CEO on April 29, 2024. He was initially replaced by an **“Office of the CEO”** consisting of three executives:

- George Cheeks  
- Chris McCarthy  
- Brian Robbins  

After Paramount’s merger with Skydance Media closed in August 2025, **David Ellison became chairman and CEO of the combined company, Paramount Skydance Corporation**.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao died in Texas on the night of February 10–11, 2024, at age 50.

Her Tesla Model X went backward into a pond on a private ranch in Blanco County. She became trapped inside and drowned despite rescue efforts. Authorities ruled the death an accident; toxicology results showed her blood-alcohol level was about 0.23%, nearly three times Texas’s legal driving limit.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée died on June 18, 2024, at age 92.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024, at age 80, after a long illness.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at age 88, in Miami, Florida, after a long illness.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at age 93.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Character actor **Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024**, at age 90.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as Peloton’s chief executive officer amid the company’s restructuring and layoffs.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at age 86. The Basketball Hall of Famer and NBA legend died at his home in Los Angeles.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico’s 2024 presidential election, becoming the country’s first woman elected president.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Tô Lâm was elected President of Vietnam in May 2024, following Võ Văn Thưởng’s resignation.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime Minister after India’s 2024 general election. His Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) did **not** win an outright majority on its own; it secured 240 of 543 seats and formed the government with its National Democratic Alliance partners.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former prime minister of the Netherlands, was selected to succeed Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General. He took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Actress Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at age 75. Her death was due to complications from diabetes.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected president by South Africa’s parliament. No—the African National Congress (ANC) lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994 and formed a coalition government.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74, after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall died on July 22, 2024, at age 90. He died at his home in California.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at age 94, after a series of short illnesses.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Former NFL player Jacoby Jones died on **July 14, 2024**, at the age of **40**.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Former England cricketer Graham Thorpe has died. He died on **4 August 2024**, aged 55.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, replacing Rishi Sunak after Labour won the July 2024 general election.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing **New Popular Front (NFP)** coalition won the most seats in France’s July 2024 snap National Assembly election, though it fell short of an absolute majority.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland’s most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She took office on August 1, 2024.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki died on August 9, 2024, at age 56, after living with non-small-cell lung cancer for two years. She was the former CEO of YouTube.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran’s 2024 presidential election, defeating Saeed Jalili in the runoff held on July 5, 2024.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024. He endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to replace him as the Democratic nominee.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was killed in Tehran, Iran, on **July 31, 2024**, shortly after attending the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. His bodyguard was also killed.

Hamas and Iran blamed Israel. Israel later publicly acknowledged responsibility. The precise method remains disputed: Iranian accounts described a short-range projectile or airstrike, while other reports said an explosive device had been planted in the guesthouse where Haniyeh was staying.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean, the former MLB player and league diversity executive, died on **August 6, 2024**, at age 60, after battling acute myeloid leukemia.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus leads Bangladesh’s interim government as its chief adviser.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar was chosen to lead Hamas’s political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was killed in July 2024.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, at age 76. He was best known for playing Detective Sergeant John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at age 93.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol, formerly chairman and CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at his home in Maui, Hawaii. He was 88 years old.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, died on August 30, 2024, at age 53.

He collapsed while performing at Town Center Park in Hamden, Connecticut. Emergency personnel administered CPR and took him to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Connecticut’s medical examiner later determined that he died from hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and classified the death as natural.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r: Paetongtarn Shinawatra became Thailand’s prime minister after the Constitutional Court removed Srettha Thavisin in August 2024.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024, aged 89. Her sons announced that she died peacefully in a London hospital.

2024-09-office-barnier.r: Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France, succeeding Gabriel Attal, on **5 September 2024**.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become Nike, Inc.’s CEO, replacing John Donahoe. He assumed the role on October 14, 2024.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024, at age 79, from complications of multiple sclerosis.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez resigned as U.S. senator from New Jersey effective August 20, 2024.

He left after a federal jury convicted him on corruption-related charges, including bribery, extortion, obstruction of justice, and acting as an agent of Egypt while serving in the Senate. He resigned while facing strong pressure from fellow senators and the possibility of expulsion. He was not formally expelled.

His seat is now held by Senator Andy Kim.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Maithripala Sirisena won Sri Lanka’s 2015 presidential election, defeating incumbent President Mahinda Rajapaksa.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh died on October 25, 2024, at age 84. His family announced that he died peacefully, surrounded by family.

2024-10-death-salmond.r: Alex Salmond has died. The former First Minister of Scotland died on **12 October 2024**, aged 69, after suffering a heart attack in **Ohrid, North Macedonia**.

2024-09-death-jackson.r: Tito Jackson of the Jackson 5 died on **September 15, 2024**, at age **70**, in **Gallup, New Mexico**. He suffered a **fatal heart attack (acute myocardial infarction)** while traveling by car. He also had underlying cardiovascular disease.

2024-10-death-payne.r: Liam Payne died on **October 16, 2024**, at age 31. He died after **falling from a third-floor hotel balcony** at the CasaSur Palermo hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina. An autopsy found that he died from **multiple traumatic injuries and internal and external bleeding** caused by the fall.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on **September 27, 2024**, in a large **Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s underground headquarters** in the Dahiyeh area of southern Beirut, Lebanon.

The Israeli military announced his death, and Hezbollah confirmed it on **September 28, 2024**. The strike used heavy bombs to destroy the underground command complex where he and other senior Hezbollah officials were meeting.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on **October 9, 2024**, at age 86, in Mumbai, India.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor died on October 17, 2024, at age 93. The *South Pacific* star died of natural causes in Los Angeles.

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill is the president and chief executive officer of Nike, succeeding John Donahoe in October 2024.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party leadership election on September 27, 2024, positioning him to become Japan’s prime minister.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He died at his Los Angeles home on **July 13, 2024**, one day after his 76th birthday.

His death was ruled **accidental**, caused by complications from **blunt traumatic injuries related to recent falls**. **Arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease** was listed as a contributing condition.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison died on **November 9, 2024**, at age 81, in New York City. She had served as artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Former Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024, at age 63.

2024-11-death-west.r: British actor Timothy West died on **12 November 2024**, aged 90. His family announced his death the following day.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at age 91. He died at his home in Bel Air, Los Angeles.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Poet Nikki Giovanni died on **December 9, 2024**, at age 81.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: The governing Liberal Democratic Party–Komeito coalition **lost its parliamentary majority** in the October 2024 House of Representatives election. It won 215 of 465 seats, short of the 233 needed for a majority.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida in October 2024.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at age 100, at his home in Plains, Georgia.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, defeating Democratic nominee Kamala Harris.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on **November 26, 2024**, at age 26.

San Francisco authorities ruled his death a **suicide by a self-inflicted gunshot wound**, though his family publicly disputed that conclusion and sought further investigation.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth**, a former Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran, to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam became prime minister of Mauritius following the November 2024 general election, replacing Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar is dead. He was killed on **October 16, 2024**, during an encounter with Israeli forces in **Tel al-Sultan, Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip**.

Israeli troops encountered Sinwar and two other militants during a routine operation, without initially knowing he was present. After exchanges of fire, Israeli forces fired on the building where he had taken refuge, including with tank fire. His body was discovered and identified the following day through DNA, fingerprints, and dental records. An Israeli autopsy official said the immediate cause of death was a gunshot wound to the head, although he had also suffered injuries from shelling.

Israel announced his death on **October 17**…

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Sportscaster **Greg Gumbel died on December 27, 2024, at age 78**. His family said he died after a battle with **cancer**; the specific type was not publicly disclosed.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh died on **26 December 2024**, at age 92, in New Delhi.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina ceased being Bangladesh’s prime minister on **5 August 2024**.

After weeks of student-led protests escalated into a nationwide uprising—and a deadly government crackdown—she resigned under intense pressure and fled by helicopter to **India**. Bangladesh’s parliament was dissolved, and an interim government headed by Nobel laureate **Muhammad Yunus** was sworn in on 8 August 2024.

Hasina has since remained outside Bangladesh, reportedly in India. Bangladeshi authorities have pursued criminal cases against her, including allegations connected to the protest crackdown, and have requested her extradition. She denies wrongdoing.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Finance Minister Christian Lindner on 6 November 2024 after a bitter dispute over Germany’s budget and economic policy. Lindner, leader of the pro-business Free Democratic Party, resisted Scholz’s demands for more government borrowing and spending, citing Germany’s constitutional “debt brake.”

His removal prompted the FDP to leave the three-party coalition with Scholz’s Social Democrats and the Greens, stripping the government of its parliamentary majority and leading to an early federal election.

2024-12-office-mahama.r: John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress won Ghana’s most recent presidential election, held in December 2024. He took office in January 2025.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealthcare, died on December 4, 2024. He was fatally shot outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan while walking to an investor conference. Authorities described the shooting as a targeted attack. He was 50 years old.

2024-12-office-romania.r: Romania’s Constitutional Court annulled the first round of the 2024 presidential election and ordered the entire election process to be rerun. The decision followed declassified intelligence alleging coordinated online manipulation and possible foreign interference that benefited far-right candidate Călin Georgescu.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: Baseball Hall of Famer Rickey Henderson died on **December 20, 2024**, at age 65. He died five days before his 66th birthday.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier’s French government was toppled by a parliamentary no-confidence vote on **4 December 2024**. The motion passed by **331 votes**, after Barnier used constitutional powers to push a social-security budget through without a vote. The left-wing New Popular Front and Marine Le Pen’s National Rally joined forces to remove him.

Barnier resigned the next day, making his government the first French government defeated by no confidence since 1962 and one of the shortest-lived of the Fifth Republic. President Emmanuel Macron subsequently appointed **François Bayrou** as prime minister on 13 December 2024.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby’s tenure as Archbishop of Canterbury ended in resignation following criticism of the Church of England’s handling of abuse allegations against barrister John Smyth.

An independent review published in November 2024 found that after Welby learned of the allegations in 2013, he failed to ensure they were promptly reported to police. Welby said he had wrongly believed others had made the report and accepted personal and institutional responsibility. Amid growing pressure from survivors, clergy and bishops, he announced his resignation on 12 November 2024.

Welby formally left office on 6 January 2025, ending a tenure that began in 2013. Smyth, accused of violently abusing numerous …

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad’s government collapsed on **December 8, 2024**, after a rapid rebel offensive led by **Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS)** captured Aleppo, Hama, Homs, and finally Damascus. The Syrian military largely disintegrated or withdrew, ending more than **five decades of Assad-family rule**.

Assad fled Syria with his family and was granted asylum in **Russia**, according to Russian officials. His prime minister initially transferred state functions to the new authorities.

A transitional administration then took power. HTS leader **Ahmed al‑Sharaa**, formerly known as Abu Mohammad al‑Julani, became Syria’s interim president in January 2025. The old constitution and parliament were dissolve…

2024-11-office-gaetz.r: President-elect Donald Trump first chose former Rep. **Matt Gaetz of Florida** for U.S. attorney general in November 2024. **No**, Gaetz withdrew before taking office and was never formally confirmed. Trump then selected **Pam Bondi**, who became attorney general.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford died on **November 24, 2024**, at age 91, following a short illness.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
After President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law on December 3, 2024:

- South Korea’s National Assembly voted to reject the decree, forcing Yoon to lift it roughly six hours later.
- Parliament impeached him on December 14, suspending him from office.
- Investigators arrested him in January 2025, making him the first sitting South Korean president to be arrested. He was indicted on charges of leading an insurrection, though he denied wrongdoing.
- On April 4, 2025, the Constitutional Court unanimously upheld his impeachment and formally removed him from office.
- He subsequently faced criminal proceedings related to the martial-law attempt. Lee Jae-myung won the ensuing presidential elect…

2026-07-control_alive-scottie-scheffler.r: Yes. American professional golfer Scottie Scheffler is alive.

2026-07-death-louise-lasser.r: Louise Lasser, born April 11, 1939, is alive. There are no reliable reports of her death.

2026-07-death-sam-neill.r: Sam Neill is alive. As of March 2026, there has been no credible report of his death. He was diagnosed with stage 3 blood cancer in 2022 and has undergone treatment.

2026-07-death-james-woolsey.r: R. James Woolsey Jr., former CIA director (1993–1995), is alive. There is no reported date of death.

2026-07-death-arlene-smith.r: Arlene Smith, founding lead singer of the Chantels, is alive. She was born on October 5, 1941, and no credible death has been reported.

2026-07-death-kaylee-hottle.r: Kaylee Hottle is alive. There are no credible reports that she has died. She was born on May 1, 2012, and played Jia in *Godzilla vs. Kong* (2021) and *Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire* (2024).

2026-07-death-bonnie-tyler.r: Bonnie Tyler is alive. She was born on June 8, 1951.

2026-07-death-lindsey-graham.r: Lindsey Graham, the U.S. senator from South Carolina, is alive.

2026-08-death-hayden-panettiere.r: Hayden Panettiere is alive. As of March 2026, there are no credible reports that she has died.

2026-08-death-nancy-kassebaum.r: Nancy Kassebaum Baker is alive. The former U.S. senator from Kansas was born July 29, 1932.

2026-07-office_change-ukraine-koretskyi.r: No one, as far as I’m aware—Yuliia Svyrydenko remains Ukraine’s prime minister. Parliament appointed her on 17 July 2025 after Denys Shmyhal left the post.

2026-08-death-ben-jones.r: Ben Jones, who played Cooter Davenport on *The Dukes of Hazzard*, is alive. He was born August 30, 1941. There is no reported date of death.

2026-07-office_change-uk-burnham.r: No one has succeeded Keir Starmer; he remains prime minister of the United Kingdom as of my latest reliable information.

2026-07-office_change-moldova-munteanu.r: The prime minister would be **Dorin Recean**. However, July 2026 is a future date, so I cannot verify that the resignation occurred.

2026-08-death-tommy-john.r: Tommy John is alive. He was born May 22, 1943, and is 82 years old as of March 2026.

2026-08-death-bill-rasmussen.r: Bill Rasmussen, co-founder of ESPN, is deceased. He died on **February 25, 2025**, at age 92.

2026-08-fake_event-jensen-huang.r: No. Jensen Huang has not stepped down. He remains NVIDIA’s founder, president, and CEO; there has been no official announcement of his resignation or replacement.

2026-09-control_alive-carlos-alcaraz.r: Yes. Carlos Alcaraz, the Spanish professional tennis player, is alive.

2026-08-death-zhu-rongji.r: Zhu Rongji, China’s former premier, is **alive according to available public records**. Born on **October 23, 1928**, he is 97 years old as of March 2026. There is no confirmed report of his death.

2026-09-death-bob-mackie.r: Bob Mackie is alive. The American costume designer, known for his longtime work with Cher, was born on March 24, 1939.

2026-08-death-yayoi-kusama.r: Yayoi Kusama is alive. She was born on March 22, 1929, in Matsumoto, Japan.

2026-08-office_change-tanzania-ndejembi.r: No one. Emmanuel Nchimbi became Tanzania’s vice president in November 2025 and, as of 2026, has not been succeeded.

2026-09-death-barry-melrose.r: Barry Melrose is alive. He retired from ESPN in October 2023 after being diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease. There is no credible report of his death.

2026-09-death-bob-pettit.r: Bob Pettit is alive. Born December 12, 1932, the former St. Louis Hawks star and first NBA MVP is 93 years old as of March 2026.

2026-09-death-cassandra-wilson.r: Cassandra Wilson is alive. The Grammy-winning jazz singer was born on December 4, 1955, in Jackson, Mississippi, and there are no credible reports of her death.

2026-08-office_change-bangladesh-mirza.r: A. F. M. Ahsanuddin Chowdhury was sworn in as president of Bangladesh after Hafiz Uddin Ahmad’s brief tenure as acting president.

2026-09-death-catherine-ringer.r: Catherine Ringer is alive. She was born on October 18, 1957. Her Les Rita Mitsouko bandmate and partner, Fred Chichin, died on November 28, 2007.

2026-09-death-gloria-steinem.r: Gloria Steinem is alive. She was born on March 25, 1934.

2026-10-death-dolores-huerta.r: Dolores Huerta is alive. She was born on April 10, 1930.

2026-10-death-eric-bauza.r: Eric Bauza is alive. The Canadian voice actor, born December 7, 1979, continues to perform as Bugs Bunny and other Looney Tunes characters.

2026-09-death-dennis-haskins.r: Dennis Haskins, who played Mr. Belding on *Saved by the Bell*, is alive. He was born November 18, 1950, and there are no credible reports of his death.

2026-10-death-rj-mitte.r: RJ Mitte is alive. As of March 2026, there are no credible reports that he has died.

2026-10-death-walter-koenig.r: Walter Koenig is alive. He was born on September 14, 1936.

2026-08-office_change-nz-goldsmith.r: Judith Collins took over the defence portfolio.

2026-10-death-tom-skerritt.r: Tom Skerritt is alive. Born August 25, 1933, he is 92 years old as of March 2026. There is no credible report of his death.

2026-10-death-mike-ditka.r: Mike Ditka is alive. The former Chicago Bears player and head coach was born October 18, 1939. There are no credible reports of his death.

2026-10-fake_event-lisa-su.r: No. Lisa Su has not stepped down as AMD’s CEO. She has served as CEO since October 2014 and remains AMD’s chair and CEO according to the company’s latest public information.

2026-10-death-yasuo-fukuda.r: Yasuo Fukuda, former prime minister of Japan, is alive. He was born on July 16, 1936.

2026-09-office_change-indonesia-nazara.r: The premise appears reversed: Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa was appointed Indonesia’s finance minister on September 8, 2025, replacing Sri Mulyani Indrawati after she was dismissed. Purbaya was not the minister dismissed in that reshuffle.

2026-09-office_change-south-sudan-adeng.r: Awut Deng Acuil was named South Sudan’s caretaker foreign minister.

2026-10-office_change-romania-niculescu.r: October 2026 has not happened yet, so no Romanian prime minister can be identified based on such a confidence vote. The date may be a typo.

2026-10-office_change-kosovo-shiroka-pul.r: Albin Kurti succeeded Albulena Haxhiu in 2018 as president of the Vetëvendosje party—not as president of Kosovo.

2026-10-office_change-morocco-lekjaa.r: No Moroccan national government has been led by Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri. In Aziz Akhannouch’s government, appointed in October 2021, **Nadia Fettah Alaoui** took the Economy and Finance portfolio.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a second term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on January 20, 2024, following the December 2023 presidential election.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Chita Rivera died on January 30, 2024, at age 91.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers, who played Apollo Creed in the *Rocky* films, died on February 1, 2024, at age 76.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum died on February 11, 2024, at age 24. He was driving near Kaptagat, Kenya, when his car left the road and struck a tree. His coach, Gervais Hakizimana, also died in the crash.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at age 62, from stomach cancer.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer died on January 7, 2024, at age 78.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: On February 28, 2024, Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024 but would remain in the Senate.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis died on February 27, 2024, at age 76.

2024-01-office-harvard.r: No. Claudine Gay resigned as president of Harvard University on January 2, 2024. Alan Garber, then Harvard’s provost, took over as interim president that day.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny died on February 16, 2024, at age 47 while imprisoned in a Russian Arctic penal colony.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won Finland’s 2024 presidential election, defeating Pekka Haavisto in the runoff. He succeeded Sauli Niinistö on 1 March 2024.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo died on January 5, 2024, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, at age 92.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme died on 20 February 2024 in Munich, Germany, at the age of 63.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Bhutan’s prime minister on January 28, 2024, after his People’s Democratic Party won the parliamentary elections.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r: Bernardo Arévalo took office as president of Guatemala on January 15, 2024, after congressional delays pushed his inauguration past midnight.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Alec Musser died on January 12, 2024, at his home in Del Mar, California. He was 50.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia’s most recent presidential election on February 14, 2024. He and his vice-presidential running mate, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, received about 58.6% of the vote.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen, the longtime ESPN NFL reporter, died on March 3, 2024, at age 72.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at age 90.

2024-02-death-chao.r: Angela Chao died on February 11, 2024, at age 50. She accidentally reversed her SUV into a pond on a private ranch in Blanco County, Texas, and drowned. The Blanco County Sheriff’s Office ruled her death an accident.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped aside from both roles. He announced his resignation on 20 March 2024. Simon Harris succeeded him as Fine Gael leader on 24 March 2024 and as Taoiseach on 9 April 2024.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r: No. Vince McMahon resigned as executive chairman of TKO Group on January 26, 2024, one day after former WWE employee Janel Grant filed a civil lawsuit accusing him of sexual abuse and sex trafficking. McMahon denied the allegations and said he was stepping down out of respect for WWE, TKO and their stakeholders.

2024-01-death-oliver.r: Christian Oliver died on January 4, 2024, at age 51. The small plane carrying him and his two daughters crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after takeoff from Bequia, an island in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. All four people on board, including the pilot, were killed.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli died on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at age 83.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson died on April 21, 2024, at age 76.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at age 82.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul, who played Ken “Hutch” Hutchinson in *Starsky & Hutch*, died on January 4, 2024, at age 80.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs died on 8 April 2024 in Edinburgh, Scotland, at the age of 94.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee on March 8, 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024, at age 87.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Allman Brothers Band guitarist Dickey Betts died on April 18, 2024, at age 80.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf left office on 7 May 2024. John Swinney succeeded him and was sworn in as First Minister of Scotland on 8 May 2024.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. In March 2024, after gang violence prevented him from returning to Haiti, he announced he would step down once a transitional presidential council was in place. His resignation took effect on April 25, 2024, when the council was sworn in.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach on 9 April 2024.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama, the creator of *Dragon Ball*, died on March 1, 2024, at age 68 from an acute subdural hematoma. His death was announced on March 8, 2024.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s March 24, 2024 presidential election. He was sworn in as president on April 2, 2024.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, in St. Albans, Vermont. He was 88.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at age 61. He suffered a heart attack at his recording studio, Electrical Audio, in Chicago.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham died on April 16, 2024, at age 87.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Michael Whatley succeeded Ronna McDaniel as chair of the Republican National Committee on March 8, 2024.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s 2024 presidential election and succeeded Macky Sall on April 2, 2024.

2024-05-death-murray.r: PGA Tour golfer Grayson Murray died on May 25, 2024, at age 30.

2024-04-office-paramount.r: No. Bob Bakish stepped down as Paramount Global’s CEO on April 29, 2024. Rather than appoint a single successor, the company created an **Office of the CEO**, with George Cheeks, Chris McCarthy, and Brian Robbins sharing his responsibilities.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at age 88.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen died in March 2024 at age 74. His wife announced his death on March 11, saying he had died in his sleep over the weekend.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée died on June 18, 2024, in Paris. She was 92.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No. Vietnam’s National Assembly formally relieved Vương Đình Huệ of his post as chairman on May 2, 2024. It elected Trần Thanh Mẫn to succeed him on May 20, 2024.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia on May 12, 2024.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands on 2 May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Vietnam’s National Assembly elected Tô Lâm as president on May 22, 2024, following the resignation of Võ Văn Thưởng.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on May 27, 2024, at age 71 from cancer.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at age 93.

2024-05-death-raisi.r: Ebrahim Raisi died on May 19, 2024, when the helicopter carrying him crashed in Iran’s East Azerbaijan province. He was Iran’s president at the time. Iranian authorities confirmed his death on May 20.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill died on **5 May 2024**, at the age of 79.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland’s most recent presidential election on June 1, 2024, with 34.3% of the vote.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, Train’s founding bassist, died in May 2024 after slipping in a shower while house-sitting in Brussels, Belgium. His death was publicly reported on May 22, 2024.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at age 86.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024, and endorsed then–Vice President Kamala Harris for the Democratic nomination.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024, at age 90.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024, at age 80.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: John Swinney is the First Minister of Scotland. He took office on 8 May 2024.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Jacoby Jones died on July 14, 2024, at age 40, three days after his birthday.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall died on July 22, 2024, at age 90.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at age 94.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at age 75.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former prime minister of the Netherlands, succeeded Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran’s presidential election, defeating Saeed Jalili in the July 5, 2024 runoff.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as Peloton’s CEO in May 2024.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at age 88.

2024-07-death-simmons.r: Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, one day after his 76th birthday. The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner ruled his death accidental. He died from blunt-force injuries sustained in a fall at his home, with cardiovascular disease listed as a contributing factor.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in for a third consecutive term as India’s prime minister after the 2024 general election. No—his Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won 240 Lok Sabha seats, short of the 272 needed for a majority, and relied on its National Democratic Alliance partners to form the government.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing New Popular Front (NFP) won the most seats in France’s 2024 snap National Assembly election, but it fell short of an outright majority.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: South Africa’s Parliament re-elected Cyril Ramaphosa as president in June 2024. No, the ANC did not keep its parliamentary majority: it won 159 of 400 seats, losing its majority for the first time since 1994.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean died on August 6, 2024, at age 60 from acute myeloid leukemia.

2025-12-death-brigitte-bardot.r: Brigitte Bardot died on December 28, 2025, at the age of 91.

2025-11-office-mamdani-nyc-mayor.r: Zohran Mamdani won the New York City mayoral election on November 4, 2025.

2025-12-death-frank-gehry.r: Frank Gehry died on December 5, 2025, at age 96.

2025-11-death-spencer-lofranco.r: Canadian actor Spencer Lofranco died on November 18, 2025, at age 33.

2025-12-death-chris-rea.r: British musician Chris Rea died on 22 December 2025, aged 74.

2025-11-death-tom-stoppard.r: Sir Tom Stoppard died on 29 November 2025 at his home in Dorset, England. He was 88.

2025-12-death-cary-hiroyuki-tagawa.r: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, who played Shang Tsung in *Mortal Kombat*, died on **December 4, 2025**, at age 75 from complications of a stroke.

2025-11-death-james-watson.r: James D. Watson, the co-discoverer of DNA’s double-helix structure, died on November 6, 2025, at age 97.

2025-12-death-elden-campbell.r: Elden Campbell died on December 1, 2025, at age 57.

2025-12-office-honduras-president-asfura.r: Nasry Asfura of the National Party was declared the winner of Honduras’s 2025 presidential election.

2026-01-death-bela-tarr.r: Béla Tarr died on January 6, 2026, at the age of 70.

2025-11-death-marshawn-kneeland.r: Marshawn Kneeland died on November 6, 2025, at age 24. Police in Frisco, Texas, said he was found dead from an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound after a vehicle pursuit and crash.

2025-12-death-peter-greene.r: Peter Greene, the actor who played Zed in *Pulp Fiction* and Dorian Tyrell in *The Mask*, died in December 2025 at age 60. He was found dead in his Manhattan apartment on December 12, 2025.

2025-12-office-chile-president-kast.r: José Antonio Kast won Chile’s most recent presidential election, defeating Jeannette Jara in the December 14, 2025 runoff.

2026-01-death-ames.r: Aldrich Ames died in federal prison on January 5, 2026, at age 84.

2026-01-death-ahn-sung-ki.r: Ahn Sung-ki died on January 5, 2026, at age 74.

2025-12-death-steve-cropper.r: Steve Cropper, guitarist and songwriter for Booker T. & the M.G.’s, died on December 3, 2025, at age 84.

2026-01-death-forte.r: John Forté died at age 50. He was found dead at his home in Chilmark, Massachusetts, on Martha’s Vineyard, on January 12, 2026.

fake-death-schwarzenegger.r: No. As far as I know, Arnold Schwarzenegger is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death, though I can’t verify breaking news in real time.

2025-10-office-madagascar-randrianirina.r: Colonel Michael Randrianirina is Madagascar’s head of state. He took power in an October 2025 military coup after weeks of youth-led protests. His army unit sided with the protesters, and President Andry Rajoelina fled the country. On October 14, parliament voted to impeach Rajoelina, and Randrianirina announced that the military had taken control. He was sworn in as transitional president on October 17.

2026-01-office-texas-senate.r: Democrat Taylor Rehmet won the January 31, 2026, special election runoff for Texas Senate District 9, defeating Republican Leigh Wambsganss.

2025-11-office-guinea-bissau-coup.r:
General Horta N’Tam is Guinea-Bissau’s de facto head of state. He was sworn in as transitional president on 27 November 2025, after the military ousted President Umaro Sissoco Embaló in a coup the day before.

Soldiers detained Embaló while the country was awaiting the results of its presidential election. He was subsequently released and taken to Senegal.

2025-10-office-peru-president-jeri.r: As of February 2026, **José María Balcázar** was Peru’s interim president. He took office on February 18 through constitutional succession, not a national presidential election. Congress had removed the previous interim president, José Jerí, and elected Balcázar as its new president. With no vice president available to take over, the head of Congress was next in line to lead the country.

2025-12-death-rob-reiner.r: Rob Reiner died on December 14, 2025, at age 78. He and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, were found dead at their home in Brentwood, Los Angeles. The Los Angeles County medical examiner determined that both died from multiple sharp-force injuries and ruled their deaths homicides.

fake-resign-musk-tesla.r: No. As far as I know, Elon Musk remains Tesla’s CEO. He stepped down as **chairman of Tesla’s board** in 2018 as part of a settlement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, but he did not step down as CEO.

2026-01-death-ohara.r: Catherine O’Hara died on January 30, 2026, at age 71.

2026-01-death-scott-adams.r: Scott Adams, the creator of *Dilbert*, died on January 13, 2026, at age 68.

2026-02-death-carradine.r: Robert Carradine died by suicide on February 23, 2026, at age 71. His family said he had lived with bipolar disorder for nearly two decades.

2026-01-death-yeison-jimenez.r: Yeison Jiménez died on January 10, 2026, at age 34. He was one of six people killed when a small plane crashed shortly after takeoff from Paipa, in Colombia’s Boyacá department.

2026-01-office-nyc.r: Zohran Mamdani is the current mayor of New York City. He took office on January 1, 2026.

2026-02-death-dane.r: Eric Dane died on February 19, 2026, at age 53, from complications of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease.

2026-02-office-paypal.r: Enrique Lores, former president and CEO of HP Inc., was named PayPal’s president and CEO.

2026-02-death-taylor.r: Ebo Taylor died on **7 February 2026**, at the age of 90.

fake-resign-pichai-google.r: No. As of my latest information, Sundar Pichai remains CEO of both Google and Alphabet. He became Google’s CEO in August 2015 and succeeded Larry Page as Alphabet’s CEO on December 3, 2019.

2026-02-death-moore.r: Rondale Moore died on February 21, 2026, at age 25. Police in his hometown of New Albany, Indiana, said he was found in a garage with what they described as an apparently self-inflicted gunshot wound.

2026-02-office-bangladesh.r: The **Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP)** won the February 2026 general election, and its leader, **Tarique Rahman**, was set to become prime minister.

2026-03-office-dhs.r: President Trump chose U.S. Senator Markwayne Mullin of Oklahoma to replace Kristi Noem as secretary of homeland security.

2026-02-death-ranken.r: Andrew Ranken, the drummer for The Pogues, died on 10 February 2026, aged 72.

2026-01-office-venezuela.r:
No. Nicolás Maduro is no longer exercising the powers of Venezuela’s presidency. On January 3, 2026, U.S. forces captured him in Caracas and took him to New York to face federal criminal charges.

Venezuela’s Supreme Tribunal of Justice treated his absence as temporary rather than declaring the presidency vacant. Vice President Delcy Rodríguez was sworn in as acting president on January 5. So Maduro did not resign or formally transfer the office; Rodríguez took over its duties in his absence.

2026-03-death-norris.r: Chuck Norris died on March 19, 2026, at age 86. His family announced his death the following day.

2026-02-death-khamenei.r: Ali Khamenei died on **February 28, 2026**, when an Israeli airstrike hit his compound in Tehran as part of a joint U.S.–Israeli military operation. Iranian state media confirmed his death on March 1.

2026-03-death-larijani.r: Ali Larijani died on March 17, 2026. He was killed in an Israeli airstrike near Tehran. Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, which he served as secretary, confirmed his death.

2026-03-death-tolkan.r: James Tolkan died on March 26, 2026, at age 94.

2026-04-office-hungary.r: The Tisza Party (Respect and Freedom Party), led by Péter Magyar, defeated Viktor Orbán’s Fidesz and ended Orbán’s 16-year run as prime minister.

2026-04-death-lucescu.r: Mircea Lucescu died on 7 April 2026 in Bucharest, Romania. He was 80.

2026-04-death-muldoon.r: Patrick Muldoon died on **April 19, 2026**, at age 57. According to his family, he suffered a heart attack.

2026-04-office-apple.r: Apple named John Ternus, its senior vice president of hardware engineering, to succeed Tim Cook as CEO.

2026-03-death-hanabusa.r: As far as I know, former Hawaii congresswoman Colleen Hanabusa is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of her death.

2026-03-office-nepal.r: Balendra Shah, commonly known as Balen Shah, is Nepal’s prime minister. He took office on March 27, 2026.

2026-03-death-campbell.r: Phil Campbell, the longtime Motörhead guitarist, died on March 13, 2026, at age 64.

2026-04-office-iraq.r: Iraq’s parliament elected Abdul Latif Rashid president on October 13, 2022, succeeding Barham Salih.

2026-02-death-peplowski.r: Ken Peplowski died on February 1, 2026, at age 66, aboard a jazz cruise ship in the Caribbean.

2026-03-office-iran.r: Mojtaba Khamenei is Iran’s Supreme Leader. He succeeded his father, Ali Khamenei, in March 2026.

2026-04-death-mason.r: Dave Mason died on **April 19, 2026**, at age 79.

2026-05-death-hadi.r: Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi is alive as far as I know. I’m not aware of any credible report confirming his death.

2026-04-death-bambaataa.r: Afrika Bambaataa died on April 9, 2026, at age 68. The reported cause was complications from cancer.

2026-02-office-peru.r: José María Balcázar is serving as Peru’s interim president. After removing José Jerí, Congress elected Balcázar as its own president on February 18, 2026. With no vice president in office, the head of Congress was next in the constitutional line of succession, so Balcázar was sworn in as Peru’s president that same day.

2026-04-death-kharazi.r: Kamal Kharazi died on April 9, 2026, from injuries he sustained in an April 1 U.S.–Israeli airstrike on his home in Tehran, according to Iranian state media. His wife was killed in the same strike.

2026-04-office-bestbuy.r: Best Buy named Jason Bonfig to succeed Corie Barry as chief executive officer.

2026-05-death-reed.r: As far as I know, film critic Rex Reed is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death.

2026-04-office-nascar.r: Steve O’Donnell was named NASCAR’s chief executive officer, succeeding Jim France.

2026-05-death-suzuki.r: As far as I know, Koji Suzuki, the Japanese novelist who wrote *Ring*, is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death.

2026-05-death-clarke.r: As far as I know, Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report that he has died, though I can’t verify breaking news in real time.

2026-05-death-busch.r: As far as I know, two-time NASCAR Cup Series champion Kyle Busch is alive. There is no credible report that he has died.

fake-resign-dimon-jpmorgan.r: No. As of the latest information I have, Jamie Dimon remains CEO of JPMorgan Chase. He took the role on January 1, 2006, and has not announced a departure date.

2026-06-death-bryson.r: As far as I know, R&B singer Peabo Bryson is alive. He survived a heart attack in 2019.

2026-06-death-adelman.r: As far as I know, Hall of Fame NBA coach Rick Adelman is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report that he has died.

2026-03-death-oddsson.r: Davíð Oddsson died on **1 March 2026**, at the age of 78.

2026-06-death-tree.r: As far as reliable public information indicates, Oliver Tree is alive. There is no credible report that he has died.

2026-07-control_alive-scottie-scheffler.r: Yes. To the best of my knowledge, American golfer Scottie Scheffler is alive.

2026-05-death-turner.r: Ted Turner, the founder of CNN, died on May 6, 2026, at age 87.

2026-05-office-starbucks-korea.r: Son Jung-hyun lost his position as Starbucks Korea’s chief executive. He was held responsible for the “Tank Day” promotion, which coincided with the anniversary of the May 18 Gwangju Uprising.

2026-06-death-willis.r: Victor Willis, the founding lead singer of the Village People, is alive as far as I know. There is no credible report of his death.

2026-07-death-bonnie-tyler.r: As far as I know, Bonnie Tyler is alive.

2026-07-death-kaylee-hottle.r: Kaylee Hottle, who played Jia in *Godzilla vs. Kong*, is alive. There are no credible reports of her death.

2026-06-office-uk.r: I’m not aware of any verified announcement by Keir Starmer that he will step down as British prime minister. I can’t check live news, so I can’t rule out a very recent announcement or confirm a date.

2026-07-death-james-woolsey.r: R. James Woolsey Jr., the former CIA director, is alive as of the latest information I have.

2026-06-death-head.r: As far as I know, Anthony Head, who played Rupert Giles on *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*, is alive. There has been no credible report of his death.

2026-07-death-lindsey-graham.r: Lindsey Graham, the U.S. senator from South Carolina, is alive.

2026-05-death-zanardi.r: Alex Zanardi died on May 1, 2026, at age 59. His family announced his death the following day.

2026-06-death-dalin.r: As far as I know, Charlie Dalin is alive. He publicly disclosed a cancer diagnosis after winning the 2024–25 Vendée Globe, but I’m not aware of any credible report that he has died.

2026-07-death-louise-lasser.r: As far as I know, Louise Lasser is alive. She was born on April 11, 1939, and played the title role in *Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman*.

2026-03-death-crofts.r: Dash Crofts died on March 25, 2026, at age 87. His Seals & Crofts bandmate, Jim Seals, died on June 6, 2022.

2026-06-death-guerrero.r: Héctor Guerrero Flores (“Niño Guerrero”) is presumed alive. I’m not aware of any credible report confirming his death. He was already gone when Venezuelan authorities raided Tocorón prison in September 2023, and in July 2024 the U.S. State Department offered up to $5 million for information leading to his arrest or conviction. His whereabouts remain unconfirmed.

2026-05-office-bp.r: Albert Manifold chairs BP’s board. He succeeded Helge Lund on October 1, 2025.

2026-08-fake_event-jensen-huang.r: No. As far as I know, Jensen Huang remains NVIDIA’s CEO, a role he has held since he co-founded the company in 1993.

2026-08-death-tommy-john.r: Tommy John, the former Major League Baseball pitcher for whom Tommy John surgery is named, is alive.

2026-05-office-fanduel.r: Amy Howe is FanDuel Group’s chief executive. She succeeded Matt King in 2021, serving as interim CEO before taking the role permanently that October.

2026-06-death-handy.r: James Handy appears to be alive. I’m not aware of any reliable report that the actor has died, so there’s no confirmed date or cause of death.

2026-08-death-zhu-rongji.r: As far as I know, Zhu Rongji is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death.

2026-09-death-bob-pettit.r: Bob Pettit is alive as far as I know. He was born on December 12, 1932.

2026-10-death-eric-bauza.r: Eric Bauza, the Canadian voice actor who voices Bugs Bunny, is alive.

2026-10-death-rj-mitte.r: RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Jr. on *Breaking Bad*, is alive.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo died on January 5, 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Broadway star Chita Rivera died on January 30, 2024, at age 91.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer died on January 7, 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul, who played Ken “Hutch” Hutchinson in *Starsky & Hutch*, died on January 4, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Bhutan’s prime minister on January 28, 2024, after his People’s Democratic Party won the parliamentary elections.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme died on February 20, 2024, at the age of 63.

2024-01-death-oliver.r: Christian Oliver died on January 4, 2024, at age 51. The small plane he was traveling in crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after taking off from Bequia, in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. His two daughters and the pilot also died in the crash.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Alec Musser died on January 12, 2024, at the age of 50.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at age 62.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r: Bernardo Arévalo took office as president of Guatemala on January 15, 2024, after his inauguration was delayed by a dispute in Congress. He won the 2023 presidential election.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a second term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on January 20, 2024, following the December 2023 presidential election.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis died on February 27, 2024, at age 76.

2024-01-office-harvard.r: No. Claudine Gay resigned as president of Harvard University on January 2, 2024. Alan M. Garber, then Harvard’s provost, took over as interim president.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon resigned as TKO Group Holdings’ executive chairman and stepped down from its board on January 26, 2024.

He resigned a day after former WWE employee Janel Grant filed a federal lawsuit accusing him of sexual assault, sex trafficking, and abuse. McMahon denied the allegations and said he was stepping down out of respect for TKO, WWE, and their stakeholders.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won Finland’s 2024 presidential election and succeeded Sauli Niinistö on March 1, 2024.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny died on February 16, 2024, at age 47, while imprisoned in a Russian penal colony in the Arctic.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers, who played Apollo Creed in the *Rocky* films, died on February 1, 2024, at age 76.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Actor Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024, at age 87.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down as chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024. Michael Whatley succeeded her.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum died on February 11, 2024, at age 24. He was driving near Kaptagat, Kenya, when his car veered off the road and struck a tree. His coach, Gervais Hakizimana, also died in the crash.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen, the longtime ESPN NFL reporter, died on March 3, 2024, at age 72.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: On February 28, 2024, Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024 but remain in the Senate.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman, the Nobel laureate and author of *Thinking, Fast and Slow*, died on March 27, 2024, at age 90.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia’s most recent presidential election, held on February 14, 2024. He and his running mate, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, received about 58.6% of the vote.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at age 82.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama, the creator of *Dragon Ball*, died on March 1, 2024, at age 68.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-02-death-chao.r: Angela Chao, the chair and CEO of Foremost Group, died on February 11, 2024, at age 50. She drowned after accidentally backing her Tesla into a pond on a private ranch in Blanco County, Texas. Authorities ruled her death an accident.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts, guitarist and co-founder of the Allman Brothers Band, died on April 18, 2024, at age 80.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. He announced in March 2024 that he would step down once a transitional council was in place, and his resignation took effect on April 25, 2024. Michel Patrick Boisvert took over as acting prime minister.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen died on March 9, 2024, at age 74. His death was announced on March 11.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent held hostage in Lebanon, died on April 21, 2024, at age 76.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs died on April 8, 2024, at the age of 94.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach of Ireland on 9 April 2024.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham died on April 16, 2024, at age 87.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s March 24, 2024 presidential election. He was sworn in as president on April 2, 2024.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli died on April 12, 2024, at the age of 83.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped down from both roles. He announced his resignation on 20 March 2024 and remained Taoiseach until Simon Harris took over on 9 April 2024. Harris had already succeeded him as Fine Gael leader on 24 March.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s 2024 presidential election and succeeded Macky Sall on April 2, 2024.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on May 27, 2024, at age 71.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as Scotland’s First Minister in May 2024 and was succeeded by John Swinney.

2024-05-death-murray.r: PGA Tour golfer Grayson Murray died on May 25, 2024, at age 30.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became North Macedonia’s first female president when she took office on May 12, 2024.

2024-05-death-raisi.r: Ebrahim Raisi, Iran’s then-president, died on May 19, 2024, when his helicopter crashed in a mountainous area of northwestern Iran in heavy fog. His death was confirmed the following day. Iran’s foreign minister, Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and the other people aboard were also killed.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill died on May 5, 2024, at the age of 79. He played King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected prime minister of the Solomon Islands on May 2, 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée died on June 18, 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish stepped down as president and CEO of Paramount Global in April 2024. Rather than appointing a single successor, Paramount created a three-person **Office of the CEO** led by George Cheeks, Chris McCarthy, and Brian Robbins.

After Paramount Global merged with Skydance in August 2025, David Ellison became chairman and CEO of the combined company, Paramount Skydance.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No. Vietnam’s National Assembly formally relieved Vương Đình Huệ of his duties as chairman on May 2, 2024. Trần Thanh Mẫn was elected to succeed him on May 20, 2024.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died of a heart attack on May 7, 2024. He was 61.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: John Swinney is the First Minister of Scotland. He took office on 8 May 2024.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Tô Lâm was elected President of Vietnam on May 22, 2024, following Võ Văn Thưởng’s resignation.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as Peloton’s CEO in May 2024, as the company announced a restructuring and plans to cut about 15% of its workforce.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024, at age 90.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico’s June 2024 presidential election, becoming the country’s first woman elected president.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall died on July 22, 2024, at the age of 90.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former prime minister of the Netherlands, was selected to succeed Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General. He took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland’s most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She took office on August 1, 2024.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected president by South Africa’s parliament in June 2024. No, the African National Congress (ANC) lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994, winning 159 of 400 seats.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in as India’s prime minister for a third term after the 2024 general election. His Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won 240 of the 543 seats in the Lok Sabha, short of the 272 needed for an outright majority, so it relied on its National Democratic Alliance partners to form the government.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Former NFL player Jacoby Jones died on July 14, 2024, at age 40.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024, and endorsed his vice president, Kamala Harris, for the Democratic nomination.

2024-08-death-delon.r: French actor Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing New Popular Front (NFP) won the most seats in France’s July 2024 snap National Assembly election, but fell short of an absolute majority.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh, the head of Hamas’s political bureau, was assassinated on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran. He was staying at a guesthouse after attending the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

Reports differ on how he was killed. *The New York Times* reported that a bomb had been planted in the guesthouse, while Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said a short-range projectile struck it. Israel publicly acknowledged in December 2024 that it had killed Haniyeh.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran’s presidential election to replace Ebrahim Raisi, defeating Saeed Jalili in the July 2024 runoff.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Sir Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, succeeding Rishi Sunak after Labour won the general election.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean, the former MLB player and Major League Baseball diversity executive, died on August 6, 2024, at age 60.

2024-07-death-simmons.r: Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, at age 76, one day after his birthday. The Los Angeles County medical examiner ruled his death an accident caused by blunt-force injuries from a fall, with heart disease as a contributing factor.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki, the former CEO of YouTube, died on August 9, 2024, at age 56.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Former England cricketer Graham Thorpe died on 4 August 2024, aged 55. His death was announced the following day.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar was chosen to lead Hamas’s political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was killed.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Muhammad Yunus became the chief adviser of Bangladesh’s interim government after Sheikh Hasina’s fall in August 2024.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol, then CEO of Chipotle, was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan.

2024-08-office-menendez.r: No. Bob Menendez, a Democrat from New Jersey, resigned from the U.S. Senate effective August 20, 2024. He stepped down after a federal jury convicted him in July 2024 on 16 felony counts, including bribery and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. He resigned rather than being expelled by the Senate.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, a founding member and former bassist of Train, died in May 2024 at age 58. His death was reported on May 22, but the exact date he died was not publicly confirmed.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, who played Detective Sergeant John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, died on September 26, 2024, at age 76.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at age 88.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r: Paetongtarn Shinawatra succeeded Srettha Thavisin as Thailand’s prime minister. Parliament elected her on August 16, 2024, two days after the Constitutional Court removed Srettha from office.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024 at the age of 89.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose, Major League Baseball’s all-time hits leader, died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-09-office-barnier.r: Emmanuel Macron appointed Michel Barnier as Prime Minister of France on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor, who starred as Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film *South Pacific*, died on October 17, 2024, at age 93.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024, at the age of 79.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to succeed John Donahoe as CEO of Nike, Inc.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r: Hassan Nasrallah, Hezbollah’s longtime leader, was killed on September 27, 2024, in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s headquarters in Beirut’s southern suburbs. Hezbollah confirmed his death the following day.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina was ousted as Bangladesh’s prime minister on August 5, 2024, after weeks of student-led protests grew into a nationwide uprising. She fled to India, and an interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus took office three days later.

In November 2025, a Bangladeshi tribunal convicted her in absentia of crimes against humanity over the deadly crackdown on protesters and sentenced her to death. She was last reported to be in India.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh, the Grateful Dead’s bassist and co-founder, died on October 25, 2024, at age 84.

2024-10-death-salmond.r: Alex Salmond died on 12 October 2024, aged 69.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata, the former chairman of Tata Sons, died on October 9, 2024, in Mumbai. He was 86.

2024-09-death-jackson.r: Tito Jackson, a founding member of the Jackson 5, died on **September 15, 2024**, at age 70. He suffered an apparent heart attack while traveling through Gallup, New Mexico, and was pronounced dead at a local hospital.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, died on August 30, 2024, after collapsing onstage during a concert in Hamden, Connecticut. He received emergency treatment at the venue and was taken to a hospital, where he died.

Connecticut’s chief medical examiner determined that he died of hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease—heart disease associated with high blood pressure and plaque buildup in the arteries. His death was ruled natural.

2024-10-death-payne.r: Liam Payne died on October 16, 2024, at age 31. He fell from the third-floor balcony of his hotel room in Buenos Aires, Argentina. An autopsy found that he died from multiple traumatic injuries and internal and external bleeding caused by the fall.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024, at age 63.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka’s 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent Ranil Wickremesinghe, who finished third. If you mean the 2015 election, Maithripala Sirisena defeated incumbent Mahinda Rajapaksa.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan on October 1, 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida.

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill succeeded John Donahoe as Nike’s president and chief executive officer on October 14, 2024.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison died on November 9, 2024, at age 81.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at the age of 91.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: The governing LDP–Komeito coalition **lost its majority** in Japan’s October 2024 House of Representatives election. It won 215 of 465 seats, short of the 233 needed for a majority.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r: Sanae Takaichi won the October 2025 Liberal Democratic Party leadership election and went on to become Japan’s prime minister. If you mean the September 2024 election, the winner was Shigeru Ishiba.

2024-11-death-west.r: British actor Timothy West died on 12 November 2024, aged 90.

2024-11-death-balaji.r: Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024, at age 26.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Chancellor Olaf Scholz fired Finance Minister Christian Lindner on November 6, 2024, after a dispute over the federal budget and whether to suspend Germany’s constitutional debt brake. Lindner’s Free Democratic Party then withdrew from the three-party coalition, leaving Scholz’s Social Democrats and the Greens to govern without a parliamentary majority.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar was killed on **October 16, 2024**, by Israeli troops in **Rafah, in southern Gaza**. Israeli forces encountered him during a patrol and did not initially know they had found the Hamas leader. An Israeli autopsy found that he died from a gunshot wound to the head.

Israel announced his death on October 17 after identifying his body, and Hamas confirmed it on October 18.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam became prime minister of Mauritius after the November 2024 general election, replacing Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Nikki Giovanni died on December 9, 2024, at the age of 81.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, defeating Kamala Harris.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford, author of *A Woman of Substance*, died on November 24, 2024, at the age of 91.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at age 100.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: In 2024, President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth** to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense. In 2016, Trump nominated retired Marine Gen. **James Mattis** for the same role.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:

After the **2016 election**, Trump’s first pick was **Jeff Sessions**, who was confirmed and served as attorney general from February 2017 to November 2018.

The shooting was a targeted attack; he was struck by multiple gunshots and later pronounced dead. A suspect (Luigi Mangione) was later arrested and charged in connection with the killing.

This is based on widely reported public facts from the time of the incident.

**Bashar al-Assad fled Syria and his government collapsed in December 2024 after a rapid rebel offensive.**

In late November–early December 2024, opposition forces led primarily by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), along with other groups, launched a major offensive from northwestern Syria. They quickly captured Aleppo, then advanced south through Hama and Homs, and entered Damascus with little resistance from regime forces. On 8 December 2024, Assad’s government fell; he and members of his family fled the country and were granted asylum in Russia.
