2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme died on 20 February 2024 (aged 63) from cardiac arrest.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r:
Tshering Tobgay (People's Democratic Party) 

He was sworn in on 28 January 2024 following the January 2024 National Assembly election.

2024-01-death-musser.r:
**No, Alec Musser has died. He passed away on January 12, 2024, at age 50.**

He was known for playing Del Henry on *All My Children* (2005–2007) and a supporting role in *Grown Ups* (2010). His death was reported as a suicide.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
**No. Claudine Gay resigned as Harvard president on January 2, 2024 (effective immediately after about six months in the role).** Alan M. Garber (then-provost) was appointed interim president by Harvard’s governing boards.

Gay’s tenure ended amid congressional testimony on campus antisemitism, subsequent plagiarism allegations in her academic work, and related pressure. Garber later became the permanent president.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
**Richard Lewis died on February 27, 2024, at age 76.**

The comedian and *Curb Your Enthusiasm* actor (who played a fictionalized version of himself) passed away at his home in Los Angeles from a heart attack. He had publicly disclosed a Parkinson’s disease diagnosis in 2023 and had other health issues in his later years. He was a longtime friend and frequent collaborator of Larry David.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers died on February 1, 2024, at age 76.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
**No. Vince McMahon resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings (WWE/UFC parent) on January 26, 2024, and no longer holds that role.**

He stepped down the day after a former WWE employee, Janel Grant, filed a lawsuit alleging sexual assault, trafficking, and related misconduct involving McMahon (and others). TKO’s board accepted the resignation amid the allegations and related scrutiny; McMahon also left the board. He retains a significant ownership stake in TKO but has no executive or board position.

This followed earlier 2022 WWE board/CEO issues tied to similar misconduct reports and a hush-money investigation. As of the latest public information, he has not returned to the rol…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
**Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at age 62.**

He had publicly announced a stomach cancer diagnosis in 2022 and underwent treatment (including chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery). His death was confirmed by his family and widely reported at the time. He is not alive.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
**Kelvin Kiptum has died.** He was killed in a car accident on 11 February 2024 in Kenya (near Kaptagat/Eldoret area), at age 24, along with his coach Gervais Hakizimana. He had set the men's marathon world record (2:00:35) at the 2023 Chicago Marathon.

The vehicle he was driving left the road and crashed. This is widely reported and confirmed by official sources, athletics bodies, and news outlets.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
**Prabowo Subianto (with running mate Gibran Rakabuming Raka).**

He won the February 14, 2024, presidential election (the most recent one) with a majority in the first round, as certified by Indonesia’s General Elections Commission (KPU). He was inaugurated as president on October 20, 2024. The previous election was in 2019 (won by Joko Widodo).

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
**Alexei Navalny died on 16 February 2024.**

He was a prominent Russian opposition politician and anti-corruption activist who had been imprisoned since 2021 after returning to Russia following Novichok poisoning in 2020. Russian authorities reported his death in the IK-3 penal colony (Polar Wolf) in the Arctic; the official explanation cited sudden death or natural causes (later listed as a blood clot or similar), though his team, family, and many governments and observers have stated they believe he was murdered, possibly by poisoning. His death was widely confirmed by independent reporting, his widow Yulia Navalnaya, and subsequent events including his funeral. He is not alive.

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
**No, Eric Carmen died on March 11, 2024, at age 74.**

He was the lead singer of the Raspberries and had a successful solo career, best known for the 1975 hit "All By Myself" (later covered by Celine Dion) as well as songs like "Never Gonna Fall in Love Again" and "Hungry Eyes." His death was announced by his wife Amy Carmen via social media; no official cause was immediately specified, though he had been dealing with health issues. He was 74 (born August 11, 1949).

2024-03-death-lieberman.r:
**Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024.**

The former U.S. senator from Connecticut (1989–2013) and 2000 Democratic vice-presidential nominee passed away at age 82 in New York from complications following a fall. He had been hospitalized after the incident.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at age 90.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
**No, Christian Oliver (born Christian Klepser; 3 March 1972) died on 4 January 2024 at age 51.**

He, his two daughters (Madita, 12, and Annik, 10), and the pilot died when a small Britten-Norman Islander aircraft crashed into the sea shortly after takeoff from Bequia in St. Vincent and the Grenadines (Caribbean). The crash occurred off the coast; there were no survivors. Oliver was a German actor known for roles including Brian Keller on *Saved by the Bell: The New Class* and Snake Oiler in *Speed Racer* (2008), among other film and TV work.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
**No, Akira Toriyama died on March 1, 2024.**

He passed away at age 68 from an acute subdural hematoma. His studio (Bird Studio) announced it on March 8, 2024. He is best known as the creator of *Dragon Ball* (and *Dr. Slump*).

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
**He died on March 3, 2024 (age 72).**

Longtime ESPN NFL insider/reporter Chris Mortensen passed away after a years-long battle with cancer (initially throat cancer, diagnosed around 2016). ESPN and multiple outlets reported the news at the time.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced on February 28, 2024, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024 (at the end of the 118th Congress) and would not seek another term in that role. He planned to remain in the Senate through the end of his term in 2027.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
**No, M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024 (age 88), from cardiac arrest.**

He was a prolific character actor known for roles including Bryant in *Blade Runner* (1982) and Loren Visser in *Blood Simple* (1984). He passed away at a hospital in St. Albans, Vermont, a few days before his 89th birthday.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar announced his resignation as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach on 20 March 2024 and formally left office on 9 April 2024 (succeeded by Simon Harris). He no longer holds either role.

2024-02-death-chao.r: **Angela Chao (CEO of Foremost Group) died on February 11, 2024, at age 50.** She drowned after her Tesla entered a pond on her ranch property in Johnson City, Texas (a single-vehicle incident; she was found deceased in the submerged vehicle). This was publicly reported shortly afterward, including via family statements and news coverage. She was the sister of Elaine Chao.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
**No. Michael Whatley succeeded her as RNC chair in March 2024.**

Ronna McDaniel (Ronna Romney McDaniel) served as Republican National Committee chair from 2017 until early 2024. She stepped down amid a leadership change after Donald Trump’s primary victories; the RNC elected Michael Whatley (previously North Carolina GOP chair) as her successor, with Lara Trump as co-chair. Whatley has remained in the role since then.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
**Dead; he died on April 21, 2024, at age 76.**

Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent kidnapped in Beirut in 1985 and held for nearly seven years (the longest-held American hostage of that era), died at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York. Reports indicated it followed recent heart surgery/complications. He was released in December 1991.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye (March 2024 election).**

He won Senegal’s presidential election on 24 March 2024 in the first round (with about 54% of the vote) after the Constitutional Council confirmed the results. Faye, a relatively little-known tax inspector and close ally of opposition figure Ousmane Sonko (who had been barred from running), became president-elect and was inaugurated on 2 April 2024. This followed political turmoil, including an attempted delay of the vote by then-President Macky Sall. No later presidential election has occurred (the next is due in 2029).

2024-04-death-graham.r:
**Dead. He died on April 16, 2024 (age 87).**

Daniel Robert “Bob” Graham (born November 9, 1936) was a Democratic politician who served as Florida’s governor (1979–1987) and U.S. senator (1987–2005). He died at a retirement community in Gainesville, Florida, from complications related to a stroke.

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
**Dead; he died on 8 April 2024 (aged 94).**

Peter Higgs (born 29 May 1929) was the British theoretical physicist who predicted the Higgs boson (and the associated Higgs field/mechanism) in 1964. The particle was experimentally confirmed at CERN in 2012, and he shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics. He died peacefully at home in Edinburgh.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on 12 April 2024.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: **No.** Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister (and SNP leader) in late April 2024 after ending the Bute House Agreement with the Scottish Greens, which triggered a no-confidence motion. John Swinney succeeded him as First Minister in May 2024 and remains in the role.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76 from prostate cancer.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer died on 7 January 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul died on January 4, 2024, at age 80.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
**No, Bernard Hill died on 5 May 2024, at age 79.**

He was a British actor best known for roles including King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* films and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*. Reports indicated he passed after a short illness; no further official details on the cause were widely specified at the time.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on May 27, 2024, at age 71 after a battle with cancer.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, founding bassist of Train, died on May 17, 2024, at age 58.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
**No, Grayson Murray has died.** He passed away on May 25, 2024, at age 30.

He was a PGA Tour professional golfer (born October 1, 1993) who had recently withdrawn from the Charles Schwab Challenge. His death was later confirmed by his family as suicide; he had publicly discussed his struggles with mental health and alcohol.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye.**

He won Senegal’s presidential election on 24 March 2024 (held after a delay and constitutional controversy) with a first-round majority and was inaugurated on 2 April 2024, succeeding Macky Sall. Ousmane Sonko, his close ally, became prime minister.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
**No. Bob Bakish stepped down as President and CEO of Paramount Global in April 2024.**

His role was replaced by a three-person “Office of the CEO” (George Cheeks, Chris McCarthy, and Brian Robbins) that has been running the company on an interim basis. A pending merger with Skydance (announced later in 2024) is expected to install David Ellison as Chairman and CEO of the combined company once it closes, subject to regulatory approval and other conditions.

This is based on Paramount’s public announcements and subsequent reporting on the Skydance transaction. Leadership and deal status can change, so check recent official filings or news for the latest.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
**Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at age 61, of a heart attack.**

He was a musician (Big Black, Rapeman, Shellac) and recording engineer known for work with Nirvana, Pixies, and many others, as well as his analog studio Electrical Audio in Chicago. Reports indicated he suffered a heart attack and was found unresponsive.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: **No.** Vương Đình Huệ resigned as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly in late April 2024 (resignation accepted amid Vietnam's anti-corruption campaign); Trần Thanh Mẫn was subsequently elected to the role. He no longer holds the position.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry resigned as Haiti's prime minister in April 2024. He had been unable to return to the country after gangs seized control of the airport in Port-au-Prince, and he formally stepped down once a transitional presidential council was installed. A new prime minister was later appointed by that council.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
**Ebrahim Raisi died on 19 May 2024 in a helicopter crash.**

He was Iran’s president at the time. The helicopter, carrying Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and others, crashed in foggy, mountainous terrain in East Azerbaijan province (northwestern Iran) while returning from a visit to the Azerbaijan border. Wreckage was located the following morning; there were no survivors. Iran’s government confirmed the deaths, and Raisi was succeeded (after interim arrangements and an election) by Masoud Pezeshkian.

This is a well-documented public event reported by Iranian state media, international outlets, and official statements at the time.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
**Simon Harris (Fine Gael leader; took office 9 April 2024).**

Leo Varadkar announced his resignation as Taoiseach and Fine Gael leader in March 2024. Harris was elected Fine Gael leader unopposed and was nominated/appointed Taoiseach by the Dáil Éireann shortly afterward, succeeding Varadkar directly. (A later general election and government formation in early 2025 led to a change, with Micheál Martin returning as Taoiseach in a new coalition.)

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at age 93.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
**Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024, at age 90.**

He was a veteran American character actor (born June 16, 1934) known for roles in films such as *The Bodyguard*, *The Hudsucker Proxy*, *Night at the Museum*, and many others, plus extensive TV work. Reports confirmed his death in California.

2024-06-death-aimee.r:
**No, Anouk Aimée (born Nicole Françoise Florence Dreyfus) died on 18 June 2024 in Paris at age 92.**

She was a prominent French actress known for roles in films such as *La Dolce Vita* (1960), *Lola* (1961), and *A Man and a Woman* (*Un homme et une femme*, 1966). Her death was widely reported at the time.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
**He died on June 27, 2024, at age 80.**

Martin Mull (born August 18, 1943) was an American actor, comedian, and musician known for roles in *Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman*, *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne*, *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, *Clue*, *Veep*, and *The Cool Kids*. His death was announced by his wife; reports cited a long illness, and he died at home in Los Angeles.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at age 88.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum (Morena party), who won the June 2024 election and took office on 1 October 2024.

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
**John Swinney** (SNP) has been First Minister of Scotland since 8 May 2024.

He succeeded Humza Yousaf after Yousaf’s resignation. Swinney previously served as Deputy First Minister (2014–2023) and has been an MSP since 1999.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**To Lam (Tô Lâm)**

Vo Van Thuong resigned as President of Vietnam on 20 March 2024. Vietnam’s National Assembly then elected To Lam (then Minister of Public Security) as the new President on 22 May 2024. (Vice President Vo Thi Anh Xuan served in an acting capacity in the interim.)

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte (former Prime Minister of the Netherlands)

2024-06-death-west.r:
**Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at age 86.**

He was a Hall of Fame NBA player (primarily with the Lakers), coach, and executive, widely known as “The Logo” because the NBA’s official logo is based on his silhouette. News outlets including the NBA, ESPN, and major papers reported his death after a period of declining health.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi (for a third term, after the 2024 election). No, the BJP fell short of a majority on its own (winning 240 seats) and relied on NDA allies.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected president by South Africa's National Assembly in June 2024. The ANC lost its parliamentary majority (winning ~40% of the vote).

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
**John Mayall died on 22 July 2024 at age 90.**

He was a pioneering British blues musician (often called the “Godfather of British Blues”), bandleader of John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, and a key figure who launched or featured many notable guitarists including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor. He passed away at his home in California.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r:
**She died on July 19, 2024.**

U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee (D-TX), who represented Houston-area districts in Congress since 1995, died at age 74 after a public battle with pancreatic cancer (announced in June 2024). She was in her 15th term at the time.

2024-07-death-newhart.r:
**Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at age 94.**

He passed away at his home in Los Angeles following a series of short illnesses. Newhart (born George Robert Newhart on September 5, 1929) was a comedian and actor known for his deadpan style, Grammy-winning comedy albums such as *The Button-Down Mind of Bob Newhart*, and starring roles in the sitcoms *The Bob Newhart Show* and *Newhart*.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
**Jacoby Jones died on July 14, 2024, at age 40.**

The former NFL wide receiver and return specialist (Houston Texans, Baltimore Ravens, and others), known for his Super Bowl XLVII kickoff return, was found unresponsive at his home in New Orleans. He had turned 40 just days earlier (born July 11, 1984). The specific cause was not immediately detailed in initial reports.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 U.S. presidential race on July 21, 2024, and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
**Dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at age 60 from acute myeloid leukemia.**

Billy Bean (the former MLB outfielder and later MLB’s senior vice president for diversity, equity and inclusion / ambassador for inclusion) is distinct from Billy Beane (the longtime Oakland A’s executive). Bean publicly came out as gay after his playing career and worked in MLB’s inclusion efforts for years. News of his death was widely reported at the time.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing New Popular Front (NFP) alliance.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
**Ismail Haniyeh died on 31 July 2024.** He was killed in an explosion at a residence in Tehran, Iran, where he was staying for the inauguration of Iran’s new president. Hamas and Iranian officials attributed the attack to Israel (which did not officially claim responsibility). He was Hamas’s political bureau chief at the time.

This is confirmed by contemporaneous reporting from multiple outlets and official statements from Hamas. There have been no credible reports of him being alive since then.

2024-08-death-delon.r:
**He died on August 18, 2024, at age 88.**

Alain Delon (born 1935), the iconic French actor known for films such as *Purple Noon*, *Le Samouraï*, and *The Leopard*, passed away at his home in Douchy, France, after years of declining health (including a 2019 stroke). This is confirmed by multiple contemporary news reports from the time of his death.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Graham Thorpe died on 4 August 2024, aged 55.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
**No, Susan Wojcicki died on August 9, 2024.**

She was the former CEO of YouTube (2014–2023) and a longtime Google executive. Her family announced she passed away at age 56 after a two-year battle with non-small cell lung cancer.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian (reformist) won the July 2024 runoff.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
**No, Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, at age 76.**

He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles. The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner determined the cause of death to be hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (a form of heart disease), classified as natural. A recent fall was noted as a contributing factor in some reports, but the primary cause was heart-related.

He had largely withdrawn from public life years earlier. There was no indication of foul play.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
**No. Sheikh Hasina resigned as Prime Minister of Bangladesh on 5 August 2024 and fled the country amid a student-led uprising.**

Mass protests that began over a government job quota system in July 2024 rapidly expanded into a broader anti-government movement. Security forces used lethal force, resulting in hundreds of deaths. Facing the collapse of her authority, Hasina resigned and left for India. An interim government led by Muhammad Yunus was then installed.

She remains in exile (primarily reported in India) and faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh related to the crackdown and other allegations. She has not returned to office.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton (the actor who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films) died on September 26, 2024, at age 76.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at age 93.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
**No, Bob Menendez is not still a U.S. Senator.**

He resigned effective August 20, 2024, after a federal jury convicted him in July 2024 on 16 felony counts. These included bribery, honest services wire fraud, extortion under color of official right, and acting as an unregistered agent of a foreign government (primarily Egypt). Prosecutors presented evidence of cash, gold bars, a luxury car, and other benefits allegedly received in exchange for official acts.

Menendez initially said he would not resign and would appeal, but he stepped down amid the conviction, Democratic pressure, and the prospect of Senate expulsion proceedings. (He was later sentenced to 11 years in prison.) His New Jers…

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
**Paetongtarn Shinawatra (Pheu Thai Party).**

Srettha Thavisin was removed by Thailand’s Constitutional Court on 14 August 2024 over an ethics violation tied to a cabinet appointment. Parliament then elected Paetongtarn Shinawatra (daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra) as his successor on 16 August 2024; she was formally endorsed by the king shortly afterward and remains Prime Minister. She is Thailand’s youngest PM and the second woman to hold the office.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
**Fatman Scoop (Isaac Freeman III) died on August 30, 2024, at age 53.**

He collapsed onstage while performing at an event in Hamden, Connecticut, was taken to Yale New Haven Hospital, and was pronounced dead. Reports indicated the cause was a stroke (hemorrhagic stroke per some accounts). He was a well-known rapper and hype man, recognized for tracks like “Be Faithful” and high-energy features/collaborations.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at age 88.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024, aged 89.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024, at age 79 from complications of multiple sclerosis.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Anura Kumara Dissanayake (NPP) won Sri Lanka's September 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent Ranil Wickremesinghe.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
**Mitzi Gaynor died on October 17, 2024, at age 93.**

She was an American actress, singer, and dancer best known for starring as Ensign Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film adaptation of *South Pacific*. Born Francesca Marlene de Czanyi von Gerber on September 4, 1931, she had a long career in film, television, and stage, including other notable roles in movies like *There's No Business Like Show Business* (1954) and *Les Girls* (1957), plus later TV specials and live performances. She passed away at her home in Los Angeles.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
**Tito Jackson (Toriano Adaryll Jackson) of the Jackson 5 died on September 15, 2024, at age 70 from a heart attack.**

He was found unresponsive after a medical emergency while driving in Gallup, New Mexico (he had pulled over). News of his death was widely reported the following day. He was born October 15, 1953, and was the third-oldest of the Jackson siblings (after Rebbie and Jackie). He remained active as a musician and performer in the years after the Jackson 5/Jacksons era.

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
**Michel Barnier (appointed September 2024).**

After the July 2024 snap legislative elections produced a hung parliament, Gabriel Attal remained as caretaker PM. Macron then named Barnier (a veteran conservative and former Brexit negotiator) as his successor. Barnier’s government later fell to a no-confidence vote in December 2024 and was itself succeeded by François Bayrou.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
**Hassan Nasrallah died on 27 September 2024.** He was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s underground headquarters/bunker complex in the Dahiyeh (southern suburbs) of Beirut.

Israel announced the strike and later confirmed Nasrallah was the target and had been killed. Hezbollah officially confirmed his death the next day (28 September). Multiple governments, intelligence assessments, and news organizations corroborated the reports. He has not been seen or heard from since, and Hezbollah named successors (initially an acting leadership, later Naim Qassem as secretary-general).

This is the established public record; there is no credible evidence he survived.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
**Ratan Tata died on 9 October 2024.**

He was 86 and passed away in a Mumbai hospital after being treated for age-related health issues. He had stepped down as chairman of Tata Sons in 2012 (with a brief return as interim chairman in 2016–2017) and remained a highly respected figure in Indian industry.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024, at age 63.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh died on October 25, 2024, at age 84.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
**Shigeru Ishiba**

He won the LDP presidential election on 27 September 2024 (defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff) and subsequently became prime minister. This followed Fumio Kishida’s decision not to seek another term as party leader.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
**Liam Payne has died.** He passed away on 16 October 2024 at age 31 after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palacio hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The fall caused multiple traumatic injuries, which were the official cause of death. Argentine authorities investigated the incident; reports indicated he had been under the influence of alcohol and other substances and had been behaving erratically beforehand. It was treated as an accidental death rather than foul play. He was a former member of One Direction.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r:
**Shigeru Ishiba**

He won the LDP leadership election in late September 2024 and was formally elected Prime Minister by the Diet on 1 October 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
**She died on November 24, 2024 (age 91).**

Barbara Taylor Bradford (born May 10, 1933), the British-American author of the bestselling novel *A Woman of Substance* (1979) and many other books, passed away at her home in New York. This has been widely reported in obituaries from major outlets.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
**She died on November 9, 2024 (age 81).**

Judith Jamison (born May 10, 1943) was a renowned dancer, choreographer, and the artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011 (succeeding founder Alvin Ailey). She remained associated with the company afterward as artistic director emerita. Her death was widely reported at the time.

2024-11-death-balaji.r: Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: The LDP–Komeito coalition lost its majority in the 27 October 2024 House of Representatives election (winning 215 of 465 seats).

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
**No, Yahya Sinwar is not alive; he was killed on 16 October 2024.**

Israeli forces killed him during a firefight in the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah, southern Gaza. IDF troops from the 828th Bislamach Brigade encountered three militants in a building; Sinwar was among them and died from gunshot wounds (including to the head). His body was later identified via DNA matching and other forensic methods. Israel publicly confirmed the death the following day, and Hamas subsequently acknowledged it.

This is based on official Israeli announcements, forensic confirmation, and subsequent reporting from multiple outlets. There have been no credible reports of him surviving.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at age 91.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, defeating Kamala Harris.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Christian Lindner as finance minister on 6 November 2024 after a breakdown in talks over the 2025 budget, the debt brake, and economic policy. This ended the SPD–Greens–FDP coalition.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam (following the November 2024 election); he replaced Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
**Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at age 100.**

He was the 39th U.S. President (1977–1981) and the longest-lived president in U.S. history. He entered hospice care in February 2023 and died at his home in Plains, Georgia.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh died on 26 December 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: **He has died.** Brian Thompson, CEO of UnitedHealthcare, was fatally shot on December 4, 2024, outside a Hilton hotel in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, while attending an investor conference. He was struck by multiple gunshots and died from his wounds. The suspect, Luigi Mangione, was later arrested.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
**Greg Gumbel is alive.** He is a longtime American sportscaster (born 1946) known for work with CBS, NBC, and others covering the NFL, NCAA basketball, and more; there is no record of his death. 

(He has reduced his on-air schedule in recent years but remains living.)

2024-11-office-gaetz.r: President-elect Donald Trump first nominated Matt Gaetz. Gaetz withdrew and did not hold the office.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
**Rickey Henderson died on December 20, 2024, at age 65.**

He was a Hall of Fame outfielder (inducted 2009), widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter and basestealer in MLB history (all-time leader in stolen bases and runs scored). Reports indicated he had been dealing with health issues, including pneumonia.

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
**John Dramani Mahama (NDC)**

Ghana’s most recent presidential election was held on 7 December 2024. John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) defeated Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP). Mahama, who previously served as president (2012–2017), was declared the winner and inaugurated in January 2025. (Nana Akufo-Addo was term-limited and could not run.)

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
**Jean-Marie Le Pen died on 7 January 2025 at age 96.**

He founded France’s National Front (now National Rally) in 1972 and remained a prominent far-right figure for decades. He had been in declining health and was hospitalized in late 2024. His death was widely reported by French and international media.

2024-11-office-welby.r:

The report was highly critical of institutional failures. Welby announced his resignation on 12 November 2024 and formally stepped down on 6 January 2025. This ended his tenure prematurely amid the scandal; Archbishops of …

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
**David Lynch died on January 16, 2025, at age 78.**

He passed away at his home in Los Angeles from cardiac arrest, with contributing factors including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)/emphysema (which he had publicly discussed in 2024) and dehydration. He had been a longtime smoker and had limited his public appearances in his final years due to health issues.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
**Marianne Faithfull died on 30 January 2025, at age 78.**

She was a British singer, songwriter, and actress known for 1960s hits like “As Tears Go By,” her association with the Rolling Stones, and later albums such as *Broken English*. Reports indicated she died in London after a period of illness.

2024-12-office-romania.r:

The 6 December 2024 ruling (unanimous) cited serious irregularities, including undeclared/illegal campaign financing, coordinated social-media amplification (especially on TikTok) that violated electoral rules, and evidence of foreign interference (intelligence reports pointed to Russian-linked operations boosting independent far-right candidate Călin Georgescu, who unexpectedly led the first round). Michel Barnier (Les Républicains) was appointed prime minister by President Emmanuel Macron on 5 September 2024, following the hung parliament produced by the June–July snap legislative elections. His minority government lasted only about three months—the shortest of the Fifth Republic.

It fell when the National Assembly adopted a motion of no confidence (331 votes) after Barnier used Article 49.3 to force through a social-security financing bill containing spending cuts and tax measures aimed at reducing France’s deficit. Both the New Popular Front (left) and National Rally supported the censure motion. Barni…

2025-01-death-richards.r: Cecile Richards is alive. She has not died. (She publicly disclosed a glioblastoma diagnosis in 2023 and has continued public activity since then.)

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow died on January 7, 2025, at age 86.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
**Bashar al-Assad fled Syria in December 2024 as rebel forces overran Damascus, ending his family's 53-year rule and collapsing the government after more than 13 years of civil war.**

Opposition groups led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) launched a rapid offensive from Idlib in late November 2024, capturing Aleppo, Hama, and Homs with little effective resistance from Syrian Arab Army units. Rebels entered Damascus on 8 December; Assad departed for Russia (which granted him and his family asylum), and remaining regime elements dissolved or surrendered. Russia and Iran, his primary backers, did not mount a decisive intervention.

control-alive-messi.r:

He is an active professional footballer (currently with Inter Miami CF in MLS) as of the latest available information. There are no credible reports of his death.

2025-02-death-flack.r: Roberta Flack died on February 24, 2025, at age 88.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
**Sam Moore (of Sam & Dave) has died; he passed away on January 10, 2025, at age 89.**

He was the surviving member of the duo (Dave Prater died in 1988). Moore continued performing and recording after the duo’s peak years and was known for hits including “Soul Man” and “Hold On, I’m Comin’.” Reports indicated he died after a brief illness.

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
**Yes, Bob Uecker has died. He passed away on January 16, 2025, at age 90.**

He had been battling small-cell lung cancer (privately diagnosed in 2023). Uecker was the longtime radio voice of the Milwaukee Brewers, a former MLB catcher, actor (*Mr. Belvedere*, *Major League* films), and comedian known as “Mr. Baseball.”

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
**No, Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Al Hussaini) died on 4 February 2025 in Lisbon, Portugal, at age 88.**

He had served as the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957. His eldest son, Prince Rahim Al Hussaini, succeeded him as Aga Khan V. Official announcements came from the Ismaili Imamat and were widely reported by major news outlets.

2025-02-death-paquita.r:
**Paquita la del Barrio (Francisca Viveros Barradas) died on February 17, 2025, at age 77.**

She passed away in Veracruz, Mexico. Reports indicated it was due to cardiac issues/health complications. She was a well-known Mexican ranchera singer famous for songs like “Rata de Dos Patas.”

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
**Yes, David Johansen has died. He passed away on February 28, 2025, at age 75.**

He was the lead singer of the New York Dolls and later performed as Buster Poindexter. He had been dealing with stage 4 cancer and a brain tumor. He died at his home in Staten Island, New York.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
**Yoon Suk Yeol declared emergency martial law late on 3 December 2024 (citing alleged anti-state forces, North Korean threats, and opposition obstruction); it lasted only hours before he lifted it, after which he was impeached, arrested, and later removed from office.**

The National Assembly convened overnight, voted 190–0 to demand an end to martial law, and he rescinded the decree around 4:30 a.m. on 4 December. The move triggered massive protests, a political crisis, and impeachment proceedings. A first impeachment vote on 7 December failed due to a boycott by members of his People Power Party (insufficient attendance). A second motion passed on 14 December (204–85), suspending him from…

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
**Jerry Butler (the "Iceman") died on February 20, 2025, at age 85.**

He was a founding member of The Impressions (with Curtis Mayfield) before a successful solo career and later served as a Cook County (Illinois) commissioner. He had Parkinson's disease in his later years.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r:
**Michelle Trachtenberg died on February 26, 2025, at age 39.**

She was found unresponsive in her New York City apartment. The official cause of death was later reported as complications related to a liver transplant (she had publicly discussed health issues in prior years). She was best known for roles including Dawn Summers in *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*, Harriet in *Harriet the Spy*, and Georgina Sparks in *Gossip Girl*.

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
**Joseph Aoun (elected January 9, 2025).**

Lebanon’s presidency was vacant from the end of Michel Aoun’s term (October 31, 2022) until parliament elected Lebanese Armed Forces commander Joseph Aoun after more than two years of deadlock. He is the current head of state.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
**No, he announced he would step down (Jan. 6, 2025) and remains PM/leader only until a successor is chosen.**

Justin Trudeau announced on January 6, 2025, that he would resign as Liberal Party leader and Prime Minister after the party selects a successor. He is still serving in both roles in the interim while the Liberal leadership race proceeds (candidates have included figures such as Mark Carney and others). He is not remaining “firmly” in the position long-term.

This followed internal party pressure, poor polling, and related political developments in late 2024/early 2025. The new Liberal leader will become Prime Minister.

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:
**Angie Stone died on March 1, 2025, at age 63, in a car crash in Alabama.**

She was an American R&B/soul singer known for hits such as “No More Rain (In This Cloud)” and “Wish I Didn’t Miss You,” as well as earlier work with groups like The Sequence and Vertical Hold. News reports confirmed her death following a multi-vehicle accident on Interstate 65 near Montgomery.

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r:
**Yes, Richard Chamberlain has died. He passed away on March 29, 2025, at age 90 (two days before his 91st birthday) in Waimānalo, Hawaii, from complications of a stroke.**

He was a well-known American actor, often called the “king of the miniseries,” famous for roles in *Dr. Kildare*, *Shōgun*, *The Thorn Birds*, and films such as *The Towering Inferno*.

2025-03-death-dequenne.r:
**Yes, she has died: Belgian actress Émilie Dequenne died on 16 March 2025 at age 43 from cancer.**

She was best known for her Palme d'Or-winning debut in the 1999 film *Rosetta*. She had publicly shared her cancer diagnosis in prior years.

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
**Yes, Gene Hackman has died.** He passed away on February 18, 2025, at age 95 from hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (with Alzheimer's as a contributing factor). His wife, Betsy Arakawa, died about a week earlier (February 11) from hantavirus; their bodies were discovered on February 26 in their Santa Fe home.

This is based on official reports from authorities and subsequent autopsy findings.

2025-03-death-foreman.r:
**George Foreman is alive.** He has not died.

He was born January 10, 1949, and remains a well-known public figure (former two-time heavyweight boxing champion and entrepreneur associated with the George Foreman Grill). No credible reports indicate his death.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r:
**Eddie Jordan has died; he passed away on 20 March 2025 at age 76.**

The Irish former F1 team principal (Jordan Grand Prix), commentator, and businessman died after a battle with cancer (reports commonly note prostate cancer or a related illness). He was born 30 March 1948. This is confirmed by contemporary news coverage from major outlets around that date.

2025-02-office-german-election.r: The most recent German federal election was the snap election held on 23 February 2025. The CDU/CSU alliance (Union) won the largest share of votes and seats. Its chancellor candidate was Friedrich Merz.

2025-02-death-spassky.r:
**Boris Spassky is alive.**

He was born on 30 January 1937 and is a former World Chess Champion (1969–1972). As of the latest available information, there is no record of his death; he has lived in France for many years (after earlier periods in the Soviet Union and a brief time in the United States). He suffered a stroke in 2010 but recovered sufficiently to remain active in chess-related events and interviews in subsequent years.

If you have seen a specific report claiming otherwise, it is likely inaccurate or outdated.

fake-death-keanu-reeves.r:
**No, Keanu Reeves has not passed away.** He is alive.

Death hoaxes about him (and many other celebrities) have circulated online for years, often via fake news sites, social media, or manipulated images. These are not true. Reeves continues to work in film (including the *John Wick* series and other projects) and make public appearances.

If you saw a specific claim, it was almost certainly a hoax or outdated rumor. Reliable sources (major news outlets, his verified social media, recent interviews or premieres) confirm he is living.

2025-03-office-carney.r:
**Mark Carney**

He won the Liberal Party leadership election in March 2025 and was sworn in as Prime Minister shortly afterward, succeeding Justin Trudeau in both roles.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r:
**Roy Ayers has died; he passed away on March 4, 2025, at age 84.**

He was a prominent jazz-funk vibraphonist, composer, and producer (born September 10, 1940), known for work including “Everybody Loves the Sunshine” and collaborations across jazz, funk, and soul. Reports confirmed his death in early March 2025.

2025-04-death-jean-marsh.r:
**Jean Marsh has died; she passed away on 13 April 2025 at age 90.**

She was a British actress and writer best known for co-creating and starring as Rose Buck in the original *Upstairs, Downstairs* (and its later revival). She also appeared in *Doctor Who*, *The House of Eliott*, and many other productions. Born 1 July 1934, she died after a period of ill health (including a stroke some years earlier). Reports of her death were widely covered in April 2025.

2025-04-death-giuffre.r:
**Virginia Giuffre died by suicide on April 25, 2025, at age 41.**

She was found at her farm in Neergabby, Western Australia. Giuffre (née Roberts) was a central accuser in the Jeffrey Epstein/Ghislaine Maxwell sex-trafficking cases; she alleged she was recruited as a minor and later settled civil claims (including against Prince Andrew). Her death was widely reported by major outlets at the time.

2025-03-office-namibia.r:
**Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah (SWAPO) is the current President of Namibia.**

She won the November 2024 presidential election and was inaugurated on 21 March 2025, becoming Namibia’s first female president. She succeeded Nangolo Mbumba, who had served as acting/interim president after Hage Geingob’s death in February 2024. 

(This reflects the most recent publicly reported information; always cross-check official Namibian government sources for any very recent changes.)

2025-04-death-max-romeo.r:
**Max Romeo (born Maxwell Livingston Smith) has died. He passed away on April 11, 2025, at age 80.**

He was a pioneering Jamaican reggae singer known for tracks such as “Wet Dream,” “Chase the Devil,” and work with Lee “Scratch” Perry. Reports indicated he died at home in St. Andrew, Jamaica, after a period of illness (often described as heart-related).

2025-03-death-mia-love.r:
**Mia Love is alive.** She is a former U.S. Representative (R-UT, 2015–2019) who has been publicly battling glioblastoma (an aggressive brain cancer) since a 2022 diagnosis and surgery, with ongoing treatment and updates, but she has not died.

She remains active in public life and advocacy related to her health and other issues as of the latest available information. (Health status can change; check recent reliable news for any updates.)

2025-04-death-martindale.r:
**Wink Martindale is alive.** He was born December 4, 1933, and there is no record of his death.

He remains a well-known figure from his long career hosting game shows such as *Tic-Tac-Dough*, *Gambit*, and others, as well as his earlier work as a radio DJ. As of the latest available information, he has not passed away.

2025-04-death-kilmer.r:
**Val Kilmer is alive.** He has not died.

He is an American actor (born 1959) known for films including *Top Gun*, *The Doors*, *Tombstone*, and *Batman Forever*. He publicly discussed a throat cancer diagnosis (around 2015) that required a tracheostomy and affected his voice; he later appeared in *Top Gun: Maverick* (2022). As of current knowledge he remains living.

2025-04-death-pope-francis.r:
**Pope Francis is alive.** He has not died.

He remains the current Pope (elected in 2013) and continues to carry out papal duties, though he has had well-publicized health challenges in recent years (including respiratory issues and hospitalizations). No official announcement of his death has been made.

fake-death-morgan-freeman.r:
**No, Morgan Freeman did not die recently and is still alive.**

He was born in 1937 and remains active (occasional public appearances, voice work, and projects). Celebrity death hoaxes about him have circulated online for years, which is likely the source of the rumor. Always check reliable sources (major news outlets, his verified social media, or official statements) rather than unverified posts.

2025-04-death-vargas-llosa.r: Mario Vargas Llosa died on 13 April 2025 (aged 89) in Lima, Peru.

2025-04-office-gabon.r:
**Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema**

He led the August 2023 military coup that ousted Ali Bongo Ondimba, served as transitional president, and won the April 2025 presidential election.

2025-03-office-greenland.r:
**Demokraatit (Democrats)**

In Greenland’s most recent general election (11 March 2025) for the 31-seat Inatsisartut, the centre-right Demokraatit party won the most seats with 10. Naleraq came second with 8, followed by Inuit Ataqatigiit (7), Siumut (4) and Atassut (2). This reversed the 2021 result, in which Inuit Ataqatigiit had been the largest party.

2025-04-office-canada-election.r:
**Liberal Party (led by Prime Minister Mark Carney).**

The most recent Canadian federal election was held on April 28, 2025 (the 45th). The Liberal Party won the most seats and formed the government, with Mark Carney as Prime Minister (he had become Liberal leader earlier in 2025 after Justin Trudeau’s resignation). This followed the 2021 election, which the Liberals also won under Trudeau (a minority government).

Results can involve minority governments or later confidence arrangements, but the Liberals held the plurality of seats and the premiership after the 2025 vote. For the latest seat counts or any subsequent developments, check official Elections Canada or parliamentary sources.

2025-05-death-irsay.r:
**Jim Irsay died on May 21, 2025, at age 65.**

He was the owner and CEO of the Indianapolis Colts (having taken over after his father Robert Irsay's death in 1997). The team and family announced his passing; no official cause was immediately detailed in public reports, though he had a well-documented history of health issues, including addiction struggles and related legal matters in prior years. His daughters (notably Carlie Irsay-Gordon) have been involved in team operations and are expected to play key roles going forward.

2025-05-death-salgado.r:
**Sebastião Salgado is alive.** He has not died.

The Brazilian documentary photographer and photojournalist (born 8 February 1944) remains active; there is no credible report of his death.

2025-05-death-rangel.r:
**He is alive.**

Former U.S. Representative Charles B. Rangel (D-NY), who represented Harlem and surrounding areas from 1971 to 2017, has not died. He was born June 11, 1930, and remains living as of the latest available information. He retired from Congress after a long career that included chairing the House Ways and Means Committee and later faced ethics issues, but he has continued to appear in public commentary and events in subsequent years. 

No credible reports indicate his death. If you have a specific recent rumor or source in mind, that can be checked against official records or news.

2025-05-death-swit.r: **Loretta Swit is alive.** She was born November 4, 1937, and remains living as of the latest available information (no death has been reported). She is best known for playing Major Margaret “Hot Lips” Houlihan on *M*A*S*H*.

2025-05-death-wendt.r:
**George Wendt is alive.** He has not died.

He is best known for playing Norm Peterson on *Cheers* (1982–1993) and has continued acting in film, TV, and theater since then. Born October 17, 1948, he remains active as of the latest available information.

2025-04-office-ecuador.r:
**Daniel Noboa (re-elected in the April 2025 runoff).**

The most recent Ecuadorian presidential election was the 2025 general election. The first round was held on 9 February 2025; incumbent Daniel Noboa and Luisa González advanced to a runoff on 13 April 2025, which Noboa won.

(This followed the 2023 snap election, also won by Noboa over González, after then-President Guillermo Lasso invoked *muerte cruzada*.)

2025-05-office-pope-leo.r:
**Pope Francis (Jorge Mario Bergoglio).**

He has been the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City since his election in March 2013. He remains the current pope as of the latest available information.

2025-05-office-merz.r:
**Friedrich Merz (CDU).**

He has served as Chancellor of Germany since May 2025, following the February 2025 federal election in which the CDU/CSU alliance won the most seats. (Olaf Scholz of the SPD held the office from 2021 until then.)

2025-06-death-moyers.r:
**Bill Moyers is alive.**

He is a longtime American journalist, former White House Press Secretary (under Lyndon B. Johnson), and PBS host (including *Bill Moyers Journal*). Born in 1934, he remains living as of the latest available information; there are no reports of his death.

2025-06-death-schifrin.r:
**Lalo Schifrin is alive** (born June 21, 1932). There are no reports of his death.

He remains a well-known living composer (Mission: Impossible theme, film scores, etc.). Prominent figures of his stature have widely reported obituaries if they pass, and none exist for him.

2025-06-death-forsyth.r:
**Frederick Forsyth is alive.**

He is a British author (born 25 August 1938) best known for thrillers such as *The Day of the Jackal*. There is no record of his death; he remains living as of the latest available information. (He is sometimes confused with other authors of similar vintage, such as John le Carré, who died in 2020.)

2025-06-death-burrell.r:
**Anne Burrell is alive.** There is no credible report of her death.

She remains a well-known Food Network personality (known for shows like *Worst Cooks in America*, *Secrets of a Restaurant Chef*, and appearances on *Chopped* and *Iron Chef America*). As of the latest available information, she has not passed away. Occasional online rumors or mix-ups with other public figures sometimes circulate, but they are unfounded.

2025-06-death-sly-stone.r:
**Sly Stone (Sylvester Stewart) has died. He passed away on June 9, 2025, at age 82.**

He had longstanding health issues, including COPD. This is based on contemporaneous news reports following his death.

2025-05-office-romania.r:
**Nicușor Dan (independent, 2025 election).**

The most recent completed Romanian presidential election was the 2025 contest (first round 4 May, runoff 18 May), held after the Constitutional Court annulled the November 2024 first-round results over irregularities and alleged foreign interference. Nicușor Dan, the independent mayor of Bucharest, defeated George Simion (AUR) in the runoff and is the winner. (Klaus Iohannis won the prior regular election in 2019; his term ended amid the 2024–25 process.) 

Presidential terms last five years, so the next regular election is due in 2030.

2025-06-death-bobby-sherman.r:
**He has died; Bobby Sherman (born Robert Cabot Sherman Jr.) passed away on June 24, 2025, at age 81 after a battle with stage 4 cancer.**

He was a 1960s–1970s teen idol, singer (“Little Woman,” “Julie, Do Ya Love Me”), and actor (notably on *Here Come the Brides*). Later in life he worked as a paramedic and deputy sheriff and was involved in charity work. His death was widely reported by family and news outlets.

2025-06-office-mamdani.r:
**Zohran Mamdani** (a New York State Assembly member) won the 2025 Democratic primary for Mayor of New York City.

The primary used ranked-choice voting and was held on June 24, 2025. Mamdani defeated former Governor Andrew Cuomo (who finished second) and other candidates including Brad Lander. He is the Democratic nominee for the November 2025 general election. (Incumbent Mayor Eric Adams, a Democrat, did not win the party primary.)

2025-05-office-australia.r:
**The Australian Labor Party (ALP), led by Anthony Albanese.**

The most recent federal election was held on 3 May 2025. Labor won a majority of seats in the House of Representatives and formed government for a second term, with Albanese remaining Prime Minister. (The prior election was in May 2022, also won by Labor.)

Results can be confirmed via the Australian Electoral Commission.

2025-06-death-brian-wilson.r:
**Brian Wilson is alive.**

He was born June 20, 1942, and as of the most recent reliable information, the Beach Boys co-founder, singer, and songwriter has not died. (He has faced well-publicized health challenges, including a 2024 conservatorship related to a major neurocognitive disorder, but he remains living.)

If this changes, official announcements from his family or representatives would be the source to check.

2025-06-office-poland.r: Karol Nawrocki (Law and Justice) won the most recent Polish presidential election, defeating Rafał Trzaskowski in the June 1, 2025 runoff.

2025-07-death-chuck-mangione.r:
**Chuck Mangione is alive.** He was born November 29, 1940, and there is no record of his death.

He is the jazz flugelhorn player, trumpeter, and composer best known for the 1977 instrumental hit “Feels So Good.” He has continued to be referenced in music and popular culture into the 2020s with no reports of his passing.

2025-07-death-connie-francis.r:
**Connie Francis is alive.** She was born Concetta Rosa Maria Franconero on December 12, 1937, and remains living as of the latest available information (no death has been reported).

She is a well-known American pop singer from the late 1950s–1960s with hits including “Who’s Sorry Now?,” “Lipstick on Your Collar,” and “Where the Boys Are.” She has faced health challenges over the years but continues to be referenced as living.

2025-07-death-diogo-jota.r:

He and his brother André Silva died in a car crash in Spain (on the A-52 motorway in Zamora province). Their Lamborghini left the road, crashed, and caught fire; both died at the scene. Jota was 28 and had recently married.

This is confirmed by official reports, club statements (including from Liverpool), and contemporary news coverage.

2025-07-death-ozzy-osbourne.r:

He remains a living public figure (born 3 December 1948), though he has dealt with well-documented health issues including Parkinson’s disease (announced 2020), spinal problems, and related surgeries. 2025-07-death-hulk-hogan.r:
**Hulk Hogan (Terry Bollea) is alive.** He has not died.

He was born in 1953 and remains a public figure, with occasional appearances, interviews, and involvement in wrestling-related events or media. Death rumors or hoaxes about celebrities like him circulate periodically but are unfounded in this case. No credible reports exist of his death.

2025-07-office-ukraine-pm-svyrydenko.r:
**Denys Shmyhal** (as of late 2024; he has held the office since March 2020).

2025-07-death-malcolm-jamal-warner.r:
**Malcolm-Jamal Warner died on July 20, 2025, at age 54, from drowning in Costa Rica.**

He was swimming in the ocean (reports describe a strong current or undertow) while on vacation with family. He was pulled from the water and taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. This was widely reported by major outlets at the time.

He was best known for playing Theo Huxtable on *The Cosby Show*. He was born August 18, 1970.

2025-08-death-terence-stamp.r:
**He died on 17 August 2025 (aged 87).**

Terence Stamp (born 22 July 1938), the British actor known for General Zod in *Superman II* (and many other roles), passed away at that time.

2025-06-office-south-korea.r:

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
The president is **Bernardo Arévalo** — full name **César Bernardo Arévalo de León** — of the **Semilla** party.

He won Guatemala’s most recent presidential election (the 2023 runoff in August) and was scheduled to be inaugurated on **January 14, 2024**. His swearing-in was delayed for hours amid political and legal disputes, including attempts to block his party’s status, and he was finally sworn in in the early hours of **January 15, 2024**, succeeding outgoing president **Alejandro Giammattei**.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He won the December 2023 presidential election and was inaugurated for a second term on January 20, 2024.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer has died. He passed away on January 7, 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Chita Rivera has died. She died on **January 30, 2024**, at the age of **91** (she was born January 23, 1933). Her death was reported as happening in New York after a brief illness.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul has died. He passed away on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of **80** (he was born August 28, 1943). He died in London after a battle with cancer.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan after the most recent parliamentary elections. He is the leader of the People’s Democratic Party (PDP), which won the 2024 National Assembly election (30 of 47 seats in the 9 January 2024 general round, following the 30 November 2023 primary). Tobgay was sworn in on 28 January 2024, succeeding Lotay Tshering.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo has died. He passed away on January 5, 2024, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, at the age of 92.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon is no longer Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings, the parent company of WWE.

He resigned on **January 26, 2024**, stepping down as TKO’s Executive Chairman and from the TKO board of directors, and also resigning from all positions at WWE. His resignation came one day after former WWE employee **Janel Grant** filed a federal lawsuit against McMahon, WWE, and former WWE executive John Laurinaitis, alleging sexual assault, sex trafficking, and other misconduct.

McMahon **denied the allegations**, but said he was resigning to avoid distraction and out of respect for WWE, TKO, its employees, fans, shareholders, and business partners. TKO said the board did not request his…

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny died on February 16, 2024, while serving a prison sentence in Russia. The Russian prison service announced his death, stating he had lost consciousness after a walk and died.

2024-02-death-chao.r: Angela Chao, the CEO of Foremost Group, died in February 2024. The circumstances of her death involved a tragic accident at a ranch in Boerne, Texas, where her vehicle became submerged in water. Reports indicate she was found unresponsive in the submerged car, and the cause of death was determined to be accidental drowning. The incident occurred on or around February 11, 2024.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver has died.

He was killed on **Thursday, January 4, 2024**, at the age of **51**, in a **plane crash off the coast of Bequia**, an island in **Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**.

Details of his death:
- Oliver was a **passenger** aboard a small private plane (reported as a **Piper PA-34 Seneca**) that had just taken off from Bequia’s **J. F. Mitchell Airport**, reportedly en route to Saint Vincent, when it crashed into the sea.
- Preliminary reports said the **pilot reported engine trouble/failure** and was attempting to return to the airport when the aircraft went down. The exact cause was under investigation.
- Also killed were Oliver’s two daughters, **Annik, 12**, and **…

2024-01-death-musser.r: Alec Musser has died. He died on **January 11, 2024**, at the age of **50**. His family announced his death the next day, January 12, 2024, and reported that he passed away in **Austin, Texas**. His family also noted that he had been battling depression.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme has died. He died on **19 February 2024**, at the age of **63** (born 9 November 1960). His death was announced by his family and former clubs; he passed away in Munich.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith has died. He died on **February 5, 2024**, at the age of **62**, after a battle with **stomach cancer**. He had been diagnosed in late 2021 and announced his diagnosis publicly in 2022. According to a family statement, he died peacefully surrounded by family.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers has died. He died on **February 1, 2024**, at age **76**.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the most recent Finnish presidential election, held in January–February 2024, and succeeded Sauli Niinistö as President of Finland on 1 March 2024. He defeated Pekka Haavisto in the runoff.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024, and **Prabowo Subianto** won. He was officially declared the winner by Indonesia's General Elections Commission (KPU) in March 2024 and was inaugurated as president in October 2024. His running mate was Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis has died. He died on **February 27, 2024**, at the age of **76**. His publicist said he suffered a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles. Lewis, known for playing a fictionalized version of himself on *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, had previously revealed he had Parkinson’s disease and had retired from stand-up in 2023.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen has died. He died on **March 10, 2024**, at the age of **74** (he was born August 11, 1949). His death was announced the next day; reports said he passed away in his sleep at his home in Ohio.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died.

He was killed on the night of **Sunday, 11 February 2024**, at the age of **24**, in a **road accident in Kenya**. According to police and news reports, the car he was driving veered off the road near **Kaptagat, Uasin Gishu County** (near Eldoret) and **hit a tree**. He died in the crash; his coach, **Gervais Hakizimana**, was also killed, and a third person in the vehicle was injured.

At the time of his death, Kiptum was the men’s marathon world record holder, having run **2:00:35** at the Chicago Marathon in October 2023.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of **82**. According to a statement from his family, he suffered a fall at his home earlier that month and died from complications from his injuries.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No. Ronna McDaniel is no longer chair of the Republican National Committee. She announced in February 2024 that she would step down, and she formally left the post on **March 8, 2024**, when the RNC elected **Michael Whatley** as her successor.

Whatley—previously the chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party—has served as RNC chair since then. Based on my latest information, he was reelected to a full two-year term in **January 2025** and remains the current RNC chair. (At the same March 2024 meeting, Lara Trump was elected RNC co-chair.)

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On **February 28, 2024**, Mitch McConnell announced on the Senate floor that he would **step down as Senate Republican leader** (the GOP conference leader) **effective November 2024**. In practical terms, he said he would **not seek another term as leader** when Senate Republicans chose their leadership after the 2024 elections, ending his record tenure as the longest-serving Senate party leader in U.S. history; he had led Senate Republicans since 2007.

He remained a U.S. senator from Kentucky for the rest of his term, which runs through January 2027. (This was separate from his later announcement, in February 2025, that he would not seek reelection to the Senate in 2026.)

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on **March 1, 2024**, at the age of **68**. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024; the reported cause was an **acute subdural hematoma**.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel. (Lara Trump was elected co-chair at the same time.)

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s most recent presidential election, held on **24 March 2024**, and became the country’s **president-elect**.

He ran as the candidate of the PASTEF party (backed by Ousmane Sonko) and won about **54% of the vote in the first round**, defeating former Prime Minister Amadou Ba. He was inaugurated as president on **2 April 2024**, so he is now Senegal’s sitting president rather than president-elect.

To my knowledge, no presidential election has taken place in Senegal since the March 2024 vote.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. He died on **April 18, 2024**, at the age of **80**.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Chris Mortensen has died. He died on **March 3, 2024**, at age **72**. 

He was a longtime ESPN NFL reporter/insider, joining the network in 1991 and working there for more than three decades before retiring in 2023. He had been diagnosed with stage IV throat cancer in 2019 and had battled the disease in the years before his death.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman has died. He died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of **90** (he was born March 5, 1934).

Initial obituaries reported that he died at his home in Manhattan; later reporting indicated he had traveled to Switzerland and died there by assisted suicide. In any case, he is not alive, and the date of death was March 27, 2024.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: He is dead. Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent who was held hostage in Lebanon from 1985 to 1991, died on **April 21, 2024**, at the age of **76**. His death was announced by his daughter, journalist Sulome Anderson; he died at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped aside from both roles. He announced his resignation as Taoiseach and Fine Gael leader in March 2024, and formally resigned as Taoiseach on April 8, 2024. He was succeeded as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach by Simon Harris, who took office on April 9, 2024. Varadkar remains a Teachta Dála (TD) for the Dublin West constituency.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on **12 April 2024**, at the age of **83**, in Florence, Italy.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No, Humza Yousaf does not still serve as First Minister of Scotland. He announced his resignation in late April 2024 and formally left office in early May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became the First Minister of Scotland in May 2024.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye became president of Senegal after winning the March 24, 2024 election. He was sworn in on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024**, at the age of **94**, in Edinburgh, Scotland.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No, Vương Đình Huệ no longer serves as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly. He was relieved of his duties in April 2024, and Trần Thanh Mẫn was subsequently elected as the new Chairman in May 2024.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on **June 16, 2024**, at the age of **87**, at his home in Gainesville, Florida.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76, after a battle with cancer.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin has died. He died on **May 17, 2024**, at the age of **58**, in **Brussels, Belgium**. The band Train confirmed his passing; the cause of death was not publicly disclosed.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia. She was inaugurated on 12 May 2024.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Simon Harris became Taoiseach immediately following Leo Varadkar’s departure, taking office on 9 April 2024.  

However, after the November 2024 general election and the formation of a new coalition government, **Micheál Martin** was elected Taoiseach on 23 January 2025 and is the current Taoiseach. (Simon Harris now serves as Tánaiste.)  

So: Varadkar’s immediate successor was **Simon Harris**, while the present Taoiseach is **Micheál Martin**.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. The British actor died on **5 May 2024**, at the age of **79**. He was born on 17 December 1944 and was best known for roles such as King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*.

2024-05-death-raisi.r: Ebrahim Raisi, the President of Iran, died on May 19, 2024, in a helicopter crash in the Varzaqan region of East Azerbaijan province, Iran. His death was confirmed on May 20, 2024. The crash was attributed to bad weather conditions, including heavy fog and rain.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. He left the position in 2024 after intense pressure and a severe security crisis.

Key points:

- Henry had served as prime minister (and, because the presidency was vacant, acting head of state) since July 2021, following the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse.
- In February–March 2024, gang violence surged while Henry was abroad (he had traveled to Kenya). He was unable to return to Haiti because gangs had shut down the Port-au-Prince airport, and protests demanding his resignation grew.
- On **March 11, 2024**, under heavy regional and international pressure, Henry announced he would resign once a transitional presidential council was…

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini has died.

He died on **May 7, 2024**, at the age of **61**. According to a statement from his Chicago recording studio, **Electrical Audio**, he died at his home in Chicago of a **heart attack**. (He had suffered a stroke in 2023, but the immediate cause of death was reported as a heart attack.)

Albini was best known as the frontman of Shellac (and earlier Big Black and Rapeman) and as an influential recording engineer/producer for artists including Nirvana, Pixies, PJ Harvey, and many others.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
Grayson Murray has died.  

- **Date of death:** May 25, 2024  
- **Age at death:** 30  
- **Born:** October 1, 1993, so he was 30 years old at the time of his death (he would have turned 31 later that year).  

His death was announced by the PGA Tour; he was found dead at his home in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. His family and the medical examiner later confirmed that he died by suicide.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The First Minister of Scotland is John Swinney. He took office on 7 May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf. Swinney is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP).

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton has died. He passed away on **May 27, 2024**, at the age of **71**, after a long battle with cancer.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: She has died. French actress **Anouk Aimée** died on **18 June 2024**, at the age of **92** (she was born on 27 April 1932).

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays has died. He passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland has died. He passed away on June 20, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish is **not** still the chief executive of Paramount Global.

He stepped down as **President and CEO** (and left the board) on **April 29, 2024**. Paramount did **not** immediately name a single successor. Instead, the board created an interim **“Office of the CEO”** made up of three division leaders who collectively took over the CEO duties:

- **George Cheeks** (CBS)
- **Chris McCarthy** (Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios)
- **Brian Robbins** (Paramount Pictures)

So, in the immediate sense, **an Office of the CEO replaced his role** rather than one new person.
