South Korean actress Kim Sae-ron has died. She was found dead at her home in the Seongdong District of Seoul on **February 16, 2025**. She was 24 years old.

Police stated there were no signs of foul play, and her death was widely reported as an apparent suicide.

Kim Sae-ron began her career as a child actress, gaining recognition for films such as *A Brand New Life* (2009) and *The Man from Nowhere* (2010), and later appeared in dramas like *Mirror of the Witch* and *Bloodhounds*. Her career had been significantly affected by a drunk-driving incident in 2022, and she had been attempting a comeback at the time of her death. Her passing prompted widespread mourning in South Korea and renewed…

2025-02-death-spassky.r:
Boris Spassky has died. The tenth World Chess Champion (who held the title from 1969 until his famous defeat by Bobby Fischer in the 1972 "Match of the Century" in Reykjavik) passed away on **February 27, 2025**, in Moscow, at the age of 88. His death was announced by FIDE and the Russian Chess Federation.

Spassky was born on January 30, 1937, in Leningrad (now St. Petersburg). Although he had lived in France for many years, he had returned to Russia in later life.

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
David Johansen has died. He passed away on **February 28, 2025**, at his home on Staten Island, New York, at the age of 75.

His death came shortly after it was publicly revealed that he had been privately battling stage 4 cancer since 2024, including a brain tumor. His family had launched a fundraiser through the Sweet Relief Musicians Fund earlier that month to help cover his medical expenses.

Johansen was the last surviving member of the original New York Dolls lineup, which had already lost Sylvain Sylvain (died 2021), Johnny Thunders (1991), Jerry Nolan (1992), Arthur "Killer" Kane (2004), and Billy Murcia (1972). Beyond the Dolls, he was known for his solo career, his lounge-singer al…

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r:
Michelle Trachtenberg has died. She passed away on **February 26, 2025**, at the age of 39. She was found unresponsive by paramedics at her apartment near Columbus Circle in Manhattan, New York City, after police responded to a 911 call. Authorities stated that criminality/foul play was not suspected.

In April 2025, the New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner ruled her death to be from natural causes, specifically **complications of diabetes mellitus**. It had also been reported that she had undergone a liver transplant shortly before her death.

Michelle Trachtenberg was known for her roles as Dawn Summers in *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*, Georgina Sparks in *Gossip Girl*, and the titl…

2025-03-death-dequenne.r:
Belgian actress Emilie Dequenne has died. She passed away on **March 16, 2025**, at the age of 43.

She had been battling adrenocortical carcinoma, a rare and aggressive cancer of the adrenal gland, which she publicly disclosed in late 2023. Her death was widely reported in Belgian and French media.

Dequenne was best known for winning the Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival in 1999 for her debut role in the Dardenne brothers' film *Rosetta*. She went on to appear in numerous films, including *The Girl on the Train* (2009), *Our Children* (2012), and *Close* (2022).

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:
Angie Stone has died. She passed away on **March 1, 2025**, at the age of 63.

She was killed in a vehicle collision on Interstate 65 in Montgomery County, Alabama, while traveling back to Atlanta with members of her band following a performance in Mobile, Alabama. Her van was reportedly struck by a large truck. Her death was confirmed by her daughter, Diamond Stone.

Angie Stone, born December 18, 1961, in Columbia, South Carolina, was a celebrated R&B and neo-soul artist known for hits like "No More Rain (In This Cloud)," "Wish I Didn't Miss You," and "Brotha." She began her career as a member of the pioneering female rap trio The Sequence in the late 1970s before later fronting the group …

As of my most recent information, actor **Richard Chamberlain is alive**. He was born on March 31, 1934, which makes him around 90 years old.

He is best known for starring as Dr. Kildare in the 1960s TV series of the same name, and for acclaimed roles in miniseries such as *Shōgun* (1980) and *The Thorn Birds* (1983), as well as films like *The Three Musketeers* and *The Towering Inferno*.

2025-03-death-mia-love.r:
Former US Representative Mia Love has died. She passed away on **March 23, 2025**, at the age of 49.

Love, a Republican who represented Utah's 4th Congressional District from 2015 to 2019 and was the first Black Republican woman elected to Congress, had been diagnosed with glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer, in 2022. She underwent various treatments, including participation in clinical trials, before her death.

The most recent German federal election was held on **February 23, 2025**. It was won by the **CDU/CSU** (the center-right union of the Christian Democratic Union and its Bavarian sister party, the Christian Social Union), which received roughly 28–29% of the vote.

Its chancellor candidate was **Friedrich Merz**, leader of the CDU. Following the election, Merz formed a coalition government with the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and became Chancellor of Germany.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r:
Eddie Jordan has died. The former Formula One team owner — founder of Jordan Grand Prix — passed away on **January 30, 2025**, at the age of 76.

He had been diagnosed with aggressive bladder and prostate cancer earlier in 2024, which he publicly disclosed in December 2024 on his "Formula For Success" podcast with David Coulthard. By the time of his death, the cancer had reportedly spread to his spine and pelvis.

Jordan founded Jordan Grand Prix in 1990, ran it until selling it in 2005, and later became a well-known F1 commentator and pundit for BBC and Channel 4.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r:
Roy Ayers has died. The pioneering jazz-funk vibraphonist — best known for classics like "Everybody Loves the Sunshine" and "Searching" — passed away on **March 4, 2025**, in New York City at the age of 84. His family announced that he died after a long illness.

Born September 10, 1940, in Los Angeles, Ayers was one of the most influential figures in jazz-funk and acid jazz, and his music has been sampled extensively in hip-hop and neo-soul for decades.

2025-03-office-namibia.r:
The current President of Namibia is **Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah**. She took office on March 21, 2025, becoming the country's first female president. She won the presidential election held in November 2024 as the candidate of the SWAPO party, which has governed Namibia since its independence in 1990.

She succeeded Nangolo Mbumba, who had been serving as president following the death of President Hage Geingob in February 2024.

Carney, a former Governor of the Bank of Canada (2008–2013) and the Bank of England (2013–2020), was elected Liberal Party leader at the party's leadership convention on March 9, 2025. He was then sworn in as Canada's 24th Prime Minister on March 14, 2025, after Trudeau formally resigned.

Since leaving office, he has remained active in public life through the Obama Foundation, book publications, and various speaking engagements and political activities.

2026-02-office-peru.r:
The current president of Peru is **Eliester Chávarri** (Eliester Chávarri Cárdenas).

He took office **by constitutional succession through the Congress leadership**, not by a popular presidential election. The sequence was:

1. **Dina Boluarte** was removed by Congress.  
2. **José Jerí**, as president of Congress, assumed the presidency.  
3. After Congress removed **José Jerí**, **Eliester Chávarri**, as first vice president of Congress and thus the new president of Congress, assumed the presidency under Peru’s line of succession.

He is often described as the **acting/incumbent president** serving until the next regular presidential transition or until Congress takes further constitution…

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny has died. Russian authorities announced that he died in prison on **February 16, 2024**, while serving a sentence in a penal colony in Russia’s Yamalo-Nenets region.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer prime minister of Haiti. He was effectively forced out amid Haiti’s escalating gang violence and political crisis while he was abroad. In March 2024 he announced he would step down once a transitional authority was created, and in April 2024 he formally resigned. Power was transferred to a Transitional Presidential Council, which then moved to appoint a new prime minister.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon no longer holds the executive chairman role at TKO Group Holdings, WWE’s parent company.

He resigned effective **January 26, 2024**. His departure came shortly after a former WWE employee filed a lawsuit alleging sexual abuse and sex trafficking, and amid intense scrutiny surrounding those claims. McMahon publicly framed his exit as retirement, saying it was “time” for him to step back, while also saying he would remain involved with WWE in a non-executive role. He has denied the allegations.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: The president of Senegal following the 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He succeeded Macky Sall after winning the presidential election.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. The British actor, known for *The Lord of the Rings* and *Titanic*, died on **5 May 2024**, at the age of 79.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi, the President of Iran, has died.

He died on **19 May 2024** when the helicopter he was traveling in crashed in northwestern Iran, near **Varzaqan in East Azerbaijan province**. The wreckage was located on **20 May 2024**, and Iranian authorities confirmed that Raisi and several other officials aboard had been killed. The crash was widely attributed to **bad weather and difficult mountainous terrain**, and Iranian officials said there was no evidence of foul play.

She is the daughter of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and, at 37, became the youngest person to hold the office in Thai history.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: As far as I know, Kris Kristofferson is alive. I’m not aware of any confirmed report of his death. He was born on June 22, 1936.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez is no longer a United States senator.

He resigned from the Senate effective **August 20, 2024**, after a federal jury convicted him in July 2024 on multiple corruption charges, including **bribery, fraud, obstruction, and conspiracy to act as a foreign agent**. He left office before the end of his term and was later sentenced to prison.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
As far as reliable public information I know goes, **Richard Simmons is alive**. There has been **no confirmed, credible report of his death**.

He has lived very privately since stepping back from public life around 2014, and recurring rumors claiming he died have generally been hoaxes or unsubstantiated. If you saw a death claim, check whether it comes from a credible news source or an official representative.

I don’t have live updates, so if something happened very recently, I may not know it.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop — real name Isaac Freeman III — has died.

He died in late August 2024 at age 53 after collapsing while performing onstage at a show in Hamden, Connecticut. Video and witness accounts showed that he received CPR before being taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Initial reports described it as a medical emergency, with suspected cardiac arrest/heart-related issues, but an officially confirmed cause was not immediately disclosed in the early coverage.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson (Toriano Adaryll Jackson), the guitarist/singer from the Jackson 5/The Jacksons, is alive as far as I know. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death, so there is no date or cause to give.

If you’ve seen a claim that he died, it may be a hoax or confusion with another Jackson—most notably Michael Jackson, who died on June 25, 2009.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr has died. She died on **October 29, 2024**, at age **77**.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata has died. He died on **9 October 2024**.

2024-10-death-payne.r: Liam Payne has died. The former One Direction singer died on **October 16, 2024**, at age 31, after **falling from a hotel balcony in Buenos Aires, Argentina**.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida. Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election in September 2024 and took office as Prime Minister on October 1, 2024.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Former Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Fernando Valenzuela has died. He died on **October 22, 2024**, at age 63.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

She left office in August 2024 after weeks of mass protests. On 5 August 2024, she resigned and fled Bangladesh, reportedly to India, as demonstrators stormed her official residence. Parliament was dissolved, and an interim government was installed, with Muhammad Yunus serving as chief adviser.

Since then, she has remained abroad and has faced legal cases and arrest warrants in Bangladesh related to the deadly crackdown during the protests, though her exact current location and status should be confirmed with the latest reports.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She died on **November 24, 2024**, at the age of 91.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, the actor who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, has died. He died on **September 26, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Christian Lindner was removed from his post as Germany’s finance minister. Chancellor Olaf Scholz asked President Frank-Walter Steinmeier to dismiss him after a bitter dispute over the budget, debt rules, and funding priorities—especially related to Ukraine. Lindner’s dismissal caused the FDP to leave the government, collapsing Scholz’s “traffic-light” coalition.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter has died. He died on **December 29, 2024**, at age 100.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r: I’m not sure about events after my knowledge cutoff in June 2024. Based on what I know up to that date, Yahya Sinwar was alive and there was no confirmed report that he had been killed. If he was killed after June 2024, I don’t have reliable information about when or how.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: As far as I know, sportscaster Greg Gumbel is alive. I have no reliable information that he has died, so there is no known date or cause of death to report.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka’s 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent President Ranil Wickremesinghe.  

If you meant the 2015 election, the winner was Maithripala Sirisena.

2024-12-death-singh.r: As of my last reliable information (June 2024), former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh was alive. I don’t have confirmed information beyond that date, so I can’t say whether he has died since then or provide a death date. He was born on 26 September 1932.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam became prime minister of Mauritius after the most recent general election in November 2024, replacing Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: I’m not sure of his current status after mid-2024. As of my last reliable knowledge, Rickey Henderson was alive, and I don’t have a death date for him.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
The French government led by Prime Minister Michel Barnier collapsed in early December 2024 after losing a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly.

The vote was triggered after Barnier used constitutional powers to push through part of the 2025 social security budget without a full parliamentary vote. Lawmakers then passed the no-confidence motion, forcing Barnier’s government to resign. President Emmanuel Macron accepted the resignation and asked Barnier to remain temporarily as caretaker prime minister. Macron later appointed François Bayrou as prime minister.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: President-elect Donald Trump nominated retired Marine Gen. James Mattis to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, has died. He was fatally shot on the morning of **December 4, 2024**, outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan, New York City. He was taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The killing was reported as a targeted shooting, and a suspect was later arrested and charged.

2024-12-office-mahama.r: Ghana’s most recent presidential election was won by **John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), in the December 2024 election.

Assuming you mean Donald Trump’s 2024 transition: his first announced choice for U.S. Attorney General was **Matt Gaetz**. Gaetz withdrew before being confirmed, so **he did not hold the office**.

If you meant Trump’s first transition in 2016, his first Attorney General nominee was **Jeff Sessions**, who **was confirmed and did serve** as U.S. Attorney General.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: As far as I know, Nikki Giovanni has not died. She was born June 7, 1943, and my latest reliable information indicates she was still living. If she died after mid-2024, I don’t have confirmation.

2025-01-death-lynch.r: As far as I know, filmmaker David Lynch is alive. I don’t have confirmed information beyond my knowledge cutoff in June 2024, but as of then he had not died, so I can’t give a death date.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad was ousted from power in early December 2024 after a rapid opposition offensive captured major cities and then Damascus.  

What happened, in brief:

- **Assad left Syria** as rebel forces entered Damascus. Widely reported accounts said he fled abroad, with Russia saying he had arrived in Moscow and been granted asylum.
- **His government collapsed.** Senior officials and security forces largely abandoned him, and the opposition declared the end of Assad’s rule.
- **Power was transferred to an opposition-led transitional administration.** Syria’s then-prime minister, Mohammed Ghazi al-Jalali, said he would cooperate with the new authorities and helped hand over governmental f…

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: As far as I know, Peter Yarrow is still alive. I don’t have reliable information that he has died, so I can’t give a death date.

2025-02-office-german-election.r: The most recent German federal election was won by the **CDU/CSU (the Union parties)**, and their chancellor candidate was **Friedrich Merz**.

2025-02-death-kim-sae-ron.r: South Korean actress Kim Sae-ron is alive as far as reliable public information I have available shows. I’m not aware of any credible report of her death.

2025-02-death-hackman.r: As far as I know, Gene Hackman has not died; he is alive in the latest reliable information I have. He was born on January 30, 1930. My knowledge may not be fully current, so I don’t have a confirmed death date.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r: As far as I know, Michelle Trachtenberg is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report of her death, at least through my latest reliable information in mid-2024.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r: No—he was not “firmly” staying on. Justin Trudeau announced on **January 6, 2025** that he would step down as **Liberal Party leader and Prime Minister** once a successor was chosen. He remained in place during the transition/leadership process, with the actual departure expected in **spring 2025**.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
After Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in early December 2024, the move collapsed almost immediately:

- The National Assembly convened and voted to end the martial-law decree.
